rows.source: From your first note to fingerstyle, blues and lead
rows.translation: Od prvog tona do sviranja prstima, bluesa i sola

rows.source: Hold it, tune it, play your first notes.
rows.translation: Drži je, ugodi je i odsviraj prve tonove.

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Najdeblja žica daje najniži ton. Dok sviraš, najbliža je tvom licu. Zovemo je žica 6.

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Svaka žica ima čiviju na glavi vrata. Okretanjem mijenjaš visinu tona. Timbre sluša i pokazuje smjer.

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (6).
rows.translation: Žice brojimo od najtanje (1) do najdeblje (6).

rows.source: Pluck the thickest string and let it ring.
rows.translation: Trzni najdeblju žicu i pusti je da zvoni.

rows.source: E A D G B E
rows.translation: E A D G B E

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G, B, E. Try: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually.
rows.translation: Od debele do tanke: E, A, D, G, B, E. Probaj: Ema Ako Dobro Gleda Broji Ekrane.

rows.source: Play strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Sviraj žice 6, 5 i 4, jednu po jednu.

rows.source: Put your fingertip just behind the metal fret, not on top of it. Press firmly enough for a clean ring.
rows.translation: Stavi vrh prsta odmah iza metalnog praga, ne na njega. Pritisni tek toliko da ton jasno zazvoni.

rows.source: Open, fret 1, fret 3: E, F, G.
rows.translation: Prazna žica, prag 1, prag 3: E, F, G.

rows.source: Between two frets, in the middle
E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: Za E-mol stavi dva prsta na prag 2, na žice 5 i 4. Sve žice zvone.

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Prijeđi preko svih šest žica od debele do tanke, jednim glatkim pokretom. Opusti zapešće.

rows.source: This challenge mixes the whole unit: the open strings, E, F and G on string 1, and E minor. Take a breath between steps.
rows.translation: Ovaj izazov spaja cijelu cjelinu: prazne žice, E, F i G na žici 1 te E-mol. Udahni između koraka.

rows.source: From thick to thin, the open strings are…
rows.translation: Od debele do tanke, prazne žice su…

rows.source: E B G D A E
rows.translation: E B G D A E

rows.source: A D G B E A
rows.translation: A D G B E A

rows.source: Every Amateur Does Get Better Eventually: E A D G B E, string 6 to string 1.
rows.translation: Ema Ako Dobro Gleda Broji Ekrane: E A D G B E, od žice 6 do žice 1.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb: three notes
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb: tri tona

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: Za Mary Had a Little Lamb trebaju tri tona: prazna žica 2 daje B, prag 2 na žici 3 daje A, a prazna žica 3 daje G. Ton A sviraš drugim prstom.

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.
rows.translation: Žica 3, prag 2, drugi prst. To je A.

rows.source: B A G A B B B: open string 2, then string 3.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: prazna žica 2, zatim žica 3.

rows.source: Notes on strings 1 and 2, reading tab, and your first two tunes.
rows.translation: Tonovi na žicama 1 i 2, čitanje tabulature i tvoje prve dvije melodije.

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: Žica 2 radi kao žica 1. Prazna daje B. Prag 1 s prvim prstom daje C. Prag 3 s trećim prstom daje D.
Trzni praznu žicu 2. To je B.

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Žica 2, prag 1, prvi prst. To je C.

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: Žica 2, prag 3, treći prst. To je D.

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: Po jedan prst za svaki prag: prag 1 dobiva prst 1, prag 2 prst 2, prag 3 prst 3.

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Nasloni palac na stražnju stranu vrata, iza drugog prsta. Prsti se tada mogu svinuti i stati na vrhove.

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: Tabulatura ima šest crta, po jednu za svaku žicu, sa žicom 1 na vrhu. Broj na crti označava prag koji pritišćeš. 0 znači svirati praznu žicu.

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
rows.translation: Što u tabulaturi znači 3 na gornjoj crti?

rows.source: The top line is string 1, the thinnest. The number is the fret.
rows.translation: Gornja crta je žica 1, najtanja. Broj označava prag.

rows.source: A 0 on the second line means…
A note that lasts two beats
A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: Polovinka traje dvije dobe. Trzni jednom, broji jedan, dva i pusti ton da traje do sljedeće note.

rows.source: How long does a half note last?
Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Polovica takta s četiri dobe traje dvije dobe. Četvrtinka traje jednu dobu.

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Prijelaz sa žice 2 na žicu 1 malen je pokret. Drži ruku s trzalicom blizu žica da bude spremna za sljedeći ton.

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: Prag 3 na žici 2, zatim prazna žica 1. Podigni prst dok trzaš.

rows.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
rows.translation: C i D na žici 2, zatim E, F i G na žici 1.

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Ova je melodija iz Beethovenove Devete simfonije. Koristi C, D, E, F i G te se uglavnom kreće po jedan stupanj.

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: Prvi redak, polako: E E F G G F E D.

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Zatim: C C D E E D D.

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Svaki redak završava ritmom: dulja nota, kratka pa zadržana. Broji jedan-i-dva i ubaci kratku notu na i.

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Ova dječja melodija ide po C, D i E, a zatim skače gore na G. Skok je s prazne žice 1 na prag 3.

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: prazna žica 1, dolje na žicu 2 i natrag.

rows.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D na žici 2, zatim E i G na žici 1.

rows.source: Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox
rows.translation: Pjesma u fokusu: Pisma u kutiji za cipele

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Pisma u kutiji za cipele izvorna je pjesma Timbre, spora balada u C-duru. Refren je na žicama 1 i 2, a motiv počinje dugim i kratkim ritmom iz Ode radosti. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: Motiv: C i D na žici 2, zatim E, F i G na žici 1, pa natrag na D.

rows.source: Does the chorus end at home?
rows.translation: Završava li refren na osnovnom tonu?

rows.source: No, it wants to go on
No new ideas: E, F and G on string 1, B, C and D on string 2. Start slow, then hold a steady tempo.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: E, F i G na žici 1, B, C i D na žici 2. Počni polako, a zatim drži ujednačen tempo.

rows.source: Did the tune go up or down?
rows.translation: Je li melodija išla gore ili dolje?

rows.source: All six notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Svih šest tonova, od niskog do visokog.

rows.source: Ode to Joy, a little faster
Mary Had a Little Lamb, faster
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb, brže

rows.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
rows.translation: Čisto odsvirani E-mol, E, A-mol i A te tvoje prve promjene akorda.

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Pritišći vrhovima prstiju, savijenima poput mosta, da ne dodiruju žicu ispod sebe. Kratki nokti to znatno olakšavaju.

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Trzaj žice jednu po jednu, od debele do tanke. Tup zvuk znači da prst dodiruje tu žicu. Namjesti ga i ponovno trzni.

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Jedna žica zvuči tupo. Što je vjerojatan uzrok?

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: Vrh prsta naslonjen na susjednu žicu zaustavlja njezin zvuk. Više svini prste.

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Zadrži hvat E-mola i dodaj prvi prst na žicu 3, prag 1. Taj jedan ton pretvara mol u dur.

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Durski akordi obično zvuče svijetlo i smireno. Molski zvuče tamnije. E i E-mol razlikuju se u samo jednom tonu.

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: A-mol je hvat E pomaknut na tanje žice: prsti 2 i 3 na pragu 2, prst 1 na žici 2, pragu 1.

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton daje akordu ime. U A-molu to je prazna žica 5, pa od nje počni potez i preskoči žicu 6.

rows.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton A-mola daje prazna žica 5. Ondje počni potez.

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: U hvatu A prsti 1, 2 i 3 stoje jedan uz drugi na pragu 2, na žicama 4, 3 i 2. Sviraj od žice 5.

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Ako su prsti stisnuti, postavi ih ukoso da svaki stoji odmah iza praga pod blagim kutom. Oslobodi žicu 1 da zvoni.

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.translation: Na kojem su pragu sva tri prsta u hvatu A?

rows.source: From E minor to A minor
Move the shape, not the fingers
From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: Iz E-mola u A-mol prsti 2 i 3 zajedno prelaze na žice 4 i 3. Zatim prst 1 slijeće na žicu 2. Ruka se jedva pomakne.

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Odsviraj jedan potez pa u ostatku takta promijeni hvat. Ciljaj novim akordom točno na prvu dobu. Brzina dolazi poslije, sama.

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.translation: Kako prsti trebaju putovati između akorda?

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Zajednički pokret prstiju brži je i daje čišći zvuk. Drži ih nisko, tik iznad žica.

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Iz A u E pomiče se svaki prst. Zamisli hvat E prije nego što ih podigneš, pa pomakni sva tri zajedno. Usmjeri prst 2 prema žici 5.

rows.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
rows.translation: Pjesma u fokusu: Prašina na armaturi

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Prašina na armaturi izvorna je pjesma Timbre: country u A-duru. Svaka strofa završava s dva takta E i dva takta A, upravo naučenom promjenom. Zamisli hvat, kreni ranije i stigni na prvu dobu. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.
Završava li ovo na osnovnom tonu?

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Uz E: prazni B, prazni E, D na pragu 3 žice 2, povišeni C na pragu 2, pa povišeni G na pragu 1 žice 3.

rows.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: E-mol, E, A-mol i A. Postavi svaki hvat čisto pa drži ujednačene promjene.

rows.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
rows.translation: Koji prst pretvara E-mol u E?

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
rows.translation: Prst 1 na žici 3, pragu 1 daje jedini ton koji stvara E-dur.

rows.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
rows.translation: Potezi dolje, osminke dolje-gore, naglasci i ruka koja nikad ne staje.

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: Četvrtinka traje jednu dobu. Sviraj dolje na svaku dobu i broji naglas: jedan, dva, tri, četiri.

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: Neka pokret dolazi iz opuštenog zapešća i podlaktice, kao da otresaš vodu s ruke. Ukočena ruka daje grub zvuk.

rows.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
rows.translation: Koliko četvrtinskih poteza stane u takt s četiri dobe?

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Podijeli svaku dobu na dva dijela. Sviraj dolje na broj, a gore na i: jedan i dva i. To je osam poteza po taktu.

rows.source: Where does the up strum fall?
Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Dolje na broj, gore na i. Ruka ide dolje i gore jednom po dobi.

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Potezi gore prirodno su tiši. Na putu gore dotakni samo tri ili četiri tanje žice. To ritmu daje polet.

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: Naglasak je malo glasnije odsviran ton. Odsviraj prvu dobu jače od ostalih. Tako svi znaju gdje počinje takt.

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: Prva doba počinje takt. Malo glasniji prvi potez drži tebe i slušatelje u ritmu.

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Na prvu dobu reci broj takta: jedan, dva, tri, četiri; dva, dva, tri, četiri. Tako uvijek znaš gdje si.

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: Ruka stalno ide dolje i gore, poput njihala. Da preskočiš potez, nastavi pokret, ali promaši žice.

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
Keeps moving and misses the strings
A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: Ruka koja ne staje održava pravilan ritam. Preskočeni potez je zamah koji ne dodirne žice.

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Ovaj obrazac pokreće brojne pjesme. Na treću dobu ruka ide dolje bez dodira žica, a zatim ih zahvati prema gore.

rows.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
rows.translation: Na kojoj dobi ovog obrasca nema poteza na broj?

rows.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
rows.translation: Na tri ruka ide dolje mimo žica, a zatim svira gore na i.
Pjesma u fokusu: Radio za oseke

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Radio za oseke izvorna je pjesma Timbre: opušteni reggae uz E-mol i A. Gitara svira samo na i. Ruka stalno ide dolje i gore, promaši žice na svaki broj i zahvati ih na svako i. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
rows.translation: Kada svira gitara u pjesmi Radio za oseke?

rows.source: Bass and drums hold the numbers. The guitar answers between them, on the ands.
rows.translation: Bas i bubnjevi drže brojeve. Gitara odgovara između njih, na i.

rows.source: No new ideas: quarters, eighths and the folk strum on the chords you know. Keep the hand swinging and lean on beat one.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: četvrtinke, osminke i folk obrazac na poznatim akordima. Ruka neka se stalno njiše, a prvu dobu naglasi.

rows.source: Down-up eighths: where are the up strums?
rows.translation: Osminke dolje-gore: gdje su potezi gore?

rows.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.
rows.translation: C, G, D i D-mol, dvije klasične progresije i jednominutna promjena.

rows.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: C se penje poput stubišta: prst 3 na žici 5, pragu 3; prst 2 na žici 4, pragu 2; prst 1 na žici 2, pragu 1.

rows.source: Which string do you skip in C?
rows.translation: Koju žicu preskačeš u hvatu C?

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton C nalazi se na žici 5, pragu 3. Ondje počni potez.

rows.source: A minor to C: one finger
rows.translation: Iz A-mola u C: jedan prst

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prsti 1 i 2 ostaju na mjestu. Samo se prst 3 pomiče sa žice 3 na žicu 5, prag 3.

rows.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
rows.translation: G se širi: prst 2 na žici 6, pragu 3; prst 1 na žici 5, pragu 2; prst 3 na žici 1, pragu 3. Svih šest žica zvoni.

rows.source: In G, which strings ring open?
rows.translation: Koje su žice prazne u hvatu G?

rows.source: When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
rows.translation: Pri promjeni prvo spusti prst na najnižu žicu. Nju potez prvu zahvaća, pa ostali prsti dobivaju trenutak više.

rows.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: D je na tri najtanje žice: prst 1 na žici 3, pragu 2; prst 3 na žici 2, pragu 3; prst 2 na žici 1, pragu 2.

rows.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?
rows.translation: Od koje žice počinje potez za akord D?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton akorda D daje prazna žica 4. Žice 5 i 6 šute.

rows.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
rows.translation: Za D-mol ton na žici 1 spušta se na prag 1. Presloži prste: prst 1 na žicu 1, prst 2 na žicu 3, prst 3 ostaje na žici 2.

rows.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
rows.translation: Tonalitet je dom pjesme. U G-duru akordi G, C i D obavljaju većinu posla. Brojne folk i rock pjesme koriste samo ta tri.

rows.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?
rows.translation: Stalno kasniš s promjenom. Što najviše pomaže?

rows.source: Slow, early changes build the habit. Speed follows on its own.
rows.translation: Spore, ranije promjene stvaraju naviku. Brzina dolazi sama.

rows.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
rows.translation: Progresija je slijed akorda koji se ponavlja. A-mol, C, G, D počinje tamno i postaje svjetliji kako se penje.

rows.source: Away from the app, pick two chords and switch for one minute, one strum each. Count your clean changes and beat that score tomorrow. Start with D and D minor.
rows.translation: Bez aplikacije odaberi dva akorda i izmjenjuj ih jednu minutu, po jedan potez. Broji čiste promjene i sutra nadmaši rezultat. Počni s D i D-molom.

rows.source: In a one-minute change, what do you count?

rows.translation: Pjesma u fokusu: Vrijeme za zmajeve

rows.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Vrijeme za zmajeve izvorna je pjesma Timbre: vedri pop uz logorsku vatru na G, D, E-mol i C, ukrug. Mijenjaj ranije i prvo spusti prst na najnižu žicu. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Which chord in Kite Weather skips strings 5 and 6?
rows.translation: Koji akord u pjesmi Vrijeme za zmajeve preskače žice 5 i 6?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton akorda D daje prazna žica 4, pa žice 5 i 6 šute.

rows.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
rows.translation: Strofa dodaje A na žici 3, pragu 2: ton koji drži prst 1 u hvatu D. Prazni G, A, pa prazni B.

rows.source: No new ideas: C, G, D and D minor join E minor, E, A minor and A. Change early, strum steady and let each chord ring.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: C, G, D i D-mol pridružuju se akordima E-mol, E, A-mol i A. Mijenjaj ranije, sviraj ujednačeno i pusti svaki akord da zvoni.

rows.source: G and A on string 3, D, E and F on string 4, the C major scale and two traditional tunes.
rows.translation: G i A na žici 3, D, E i F na žici 4, C-durska ljestvica i dvije tradicijske melodije.

rows.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.
rows.translation: Prazna žica 3 daje G. Stavi prst 2 na prag 2 i dobivaš A. Vrijedi isto pravilo: prst odgovara pragu.
Trzni praznu žicu 3. To je G.

rows.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
rows.translation: G i A na žici 3, zatim B, C i D na žici 2.

rows.source: G up to D and back
rows.translation: Od G do D i natrag

rows.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
rows.translation: Prazna žica 4 daje D. Prag 2 daje E, a prag 3 daje F. Drži palac nisko iza vrata da prsti mogu dosegnuti žice.
Trzni praznu žicu 4. To je D.

rows.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
rows.translation: Prag 2, zatim prag 3: E, pa F.

rows.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
rows.translation: Koje ime dijele prazna žica 4 i prag 3 na žici 2?

rows.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
rows.translation: Oba su D, udaljena oktavu: isto ime tona, jedan viši od drugoga.

rows.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
rows.translation: D, E i F na žici 4, zatim G i A na žici 3.

rows.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
rows.translation: Stavi prst 3 na žicu 5, prag 3. To je C, početni ton C-durske ljestvice.

rows.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Žica 5, prag 3, treći prst. To je C.

rows.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
rows.translation: Ljestvica se penje ton po ton od jednog slova do istog slova oktavu više. C-dur koristi samo osnovna slovna imena: C D E F G A B C.

rows.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
rows.translation: Žica 5 prag 3, zatim žice 4, 3 i 2. Sviraj polako.

rows.source: How many different letter names are in C major?
rows.translation: Koliko različitih slovnih imena ima C-dur?

rows.source: C D E F G A B, then C again an octave higher.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B, zatim ponovno C, oktavu više.

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.
rows.translation: Ovaj tradicijski duhovni napjev postao je jazz standard. Koristi C, D, E, F i G na žicama 5, 4 i 3.

rows.source: The opening: C, E, F, then open G.
rows.translation: Početak: C, E, F, pa prazni G.

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into a strong beat. Here beat one is silent, and C, E and F lead into a long G.
rows.translation: Predtakt je nekoliko nota koje vode u naglašenu dobu. Ovdje je prva doba tiha, a C, E i F vode u dugi G.

rows.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.
rows.translation: Refren: E E D C, zatim C E G G G F.

rows.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace je u trodobnoj mjeri: broji jedan, dva, tri, s naglaskom na jedan. Tonovi su na žicama 4, 3 i 2.

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar here?
rows.translation: Koliko doba ima svaki takt ovdje?

rows.source: A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
rows.translation: Takt s tri dobe nježno se njiše: jaka, slaba, slaba.

rows.source: The opening: D, G, B G, B, A. Open strings 4, 3 and 2, plus A.
rows.translation: Početak: D, G, B G, B, A. Prazne žice 4, 3 i 2, uz A.

rows.source: Then down: G, E, D, D.
rows.translation: Zatim dolje: G, E, D, D.

rows.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.
rows.translation: Visoki dio: od praznog B do D na pragu 3, pa dolje kroz B, G i A.

rows.source: Halogen is a Timbre Original: desert rock in D minor. Its riff uses the notes you just learned: open D, F at fret 3, open G, and C on string 5, fret 3. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Halogen je izvorna pjesma Timbre: pustinjski rock u D-molu. Rif koristi upravo naučene tonove: prazni D, F na pragu 3, prazni G i C na žici 5, pragu 3. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
rows.translation: Prazna žica 4, F na pragu 3, prazna žica 3, pa C na pragu 3 žice 5.

rows.source: No new ideas: every note from C on string 5 up to G on string 1, plus both tunes. Keep your thumb low and your fingers arched.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: svi tonovi od C na žici 5 do G na žici 1, uz obje melodije. Drži palac nisko, a prste svinute.

rows.source: C major from string 5, up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: C-dur od žice 5 do G na žici 1.

rows.source: A mini F, D7, and two traditional songs with both chords and melody.
rows.translation: Mali F, D7 i dvije tradicijske pjesme s akordima i melodijom.

rows.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Ovaj mali F koristi četiri žice. Prst 1 leži preko žica 1 i 2 na pragu 1, prst 2 ide na žicu 3, prag 2, a prst 3 na žicu 4, prag 3.

rows.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
rows.translation: Blago zakreni prst 1 na stranu prema palcu. Tvrđi rub lakše pritišće dvije žice. Provjeri zvoni li žica 2.

rows.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
rows.translation: Ova se progresija postupno penje od A-mola i stiže na novi F. Sviraj dva poteza po akordu i mijenjaj ranije.

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Ova engleska melodija starija je od 400 godina. Sve akorde znaš: A-mol, C, G, E-mol, F i E. U trodobnoj je mjeri: sviraj jednom po taktu, zatim na svaku dobu.

rows.source: Which strings does the mini F leave silent?
rows.translation: Koje žice šute u malom F?

rows.source: The mini F starts on string 4. Begin your strum there and skip strings 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Mali F počinje na žici 4. Ondje počni potez i preskoči žice 5 i 6.

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Povisilica podiže ton za jedan prag. Greensleeves koristi povišeni G na žici 3, pragu 1 i povišeni F na žici 4, pragu 4. Njega dohvati malim prstom.

rows.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
rows.translation: Povišeni G, A, B: žica 3 na pragovima 1 i 2, zatim prazna žica 2.

rows.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.translation: Početak: A, C D, E F E, D B.

rows.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
rows.translation: Povisilica znači jedan prag više. Povišeni G nalazi se između G i A.

rows.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Refren počinje visoko: G na žici 1, pragu 3, zatim povišeni F na pragu 2.

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: Septakord dodaje ton koji vuče prema osnovnom tonu. D7 želi prijeći u G. Prsti: 2 na žici 3, pragu 2; 1 na žici 2, pragu 1; 3 na žici 1, pragu 2.

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Ova američka balada iz 1880-ih traži samo G i D7. U trodobnoj je mjeri, poput Amazing Grace. Sviraj jednom po taktu, zatim na svaku dobu.

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.translation: Melodija pjesme Clementine je na žicama 4, 3 i 2. U zadnjem retku opet je povišeni F: žica 4, prag 4, mali prst.

rows.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
rows.translation: Početak: G G G, dolje do praznog D, gore do praznog B.

rows.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
rows.translation: Dodatni ton akorda D7 teži prema G. Kad stigne G, napetost popušta.

rows.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
rows.translation: Zadnji redak: A, prazni D, povišeni F na pragu 4, A, pa povratak na G.
Pjesma u fokusu: Svjetlo za duhove

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Svjetlo za duhove izvorna je pjesma Timbre: spora, tamna balada. Strofa ide kroz A-mol, F, C i E, pa mali F dobiva pjesmu, a povišeni G u akordu E vuče melodiju kući. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Poslušaj zadnji akord strofe. Dur ili mol?

rows.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
rows.translation: Obrazac za baladu: jak potez na prvu dobu neka zvoni, drugi na tri, pa dolje-gore na četiri. Prostor nakon svakog poteza dio je pjesme.

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.translation: Zadnji redak strofe: prazni B, C na pragu 1, B, povišeni G na pragu 1 žice 3, B, pa prazni E.
Dvije pjesme, od početka do kraja

rows.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: mali F, D7 i obje pjesme iz ove cjeline. Mijenjaj akorde ranije i pusti melodije da pjevaju.

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest toward G?
rows.translation: Koji akord najjače vuče prema G?

rows.source: E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.
rows.translation: E7, A7, G7 i B7, sus akordi, shuffle i tvoj prvi blues od 12 taktova.

rows.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
rows.translation: Odsviraj E pa podigni prst 3 sa žice 4. Prazni D koji zazvoni septima je, ton koji dodaje blues napetost.

rows.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
rows.translation: Odsviraj A pa podigni prst 2 sa žice 3. Prazni G zazvoni i A postaje A7.

rows.source: How do you turn E into E7 here?
rows.translation: Kako ovdje pretvaraš E u E7?

rows.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: G7 zadržava niski G, ali stavlja F na vrh: prst 3 na žicu 6, prag 3; prst 2 na žicu 5, prag 2; prst 1 na žicu 1, prag 1.

rows.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Gradi B7 od žice 5: prst 2 na pragu 2, prst 1 na žici 4, pragu 1, prst 3 na žici 3, pragu 2, mali prst na žici 1, pragu 2. Žica 2 zvoni prazna.

rows.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
rows.translation: U koji akord B7 najprirodnije vodi?

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
rows.translation: B7 vuče prema E. Njegova se napetost topi u E-molu ili E.

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.translation: Shuffle dijeli svaku dobu nejednako: dug potez dolje, kratak gore. To je puls bluesa. Zamisli duu-ba, duu-ba.

rows.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: U shuffle ritmu svaka se doba dijeli na…

rows.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.translation: Mnoge blues pjesme slijede plan od 12 taktova. U E: četiri takta E7, dva A7, dva E7, pa po jedan B7, A7, E7 i B7.

rows.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Koliko taktova E7 otvara blues od 12 taktova?

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.translation: Zadnja četiri takta mijenjaju se brže: B7, A7, E7 pa B7, koji te vraća na početak. Mijenjaj ranije i drži shuffle ritam.

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.translation: Sus akord zamjenjuje ton koji određuje dur ili mol susjednim tonom. Zvuči otvoreno i neriješeno dok se ne smiri na polazištu.

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Podigni prst 2 sa žice 1 za Dsus2. Za Asus4 odsviraj A i dodaj mali prst na žicu 2, prag 3.
Pjesma u fokusu: Shuffle hrđavog pojasa

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Shuffle hrđavog pojasa izvorna je pjesma Timbre: blues od 12 taktova u E, upravo odsviran plan s melodijom u swingu. Zadrži dugo-kratki ritam u obje ruke. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.translation: Prazni G, pa povišeni G na pragu 1 žice 3, pa prazni B: blues klizanje u drugom taktu.

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
rows.translation: Drugi takt klizi s G na povišeni G. Koji pripada akordu E7?

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.translation: E7 čine E, povišeni G, B i D. G je blues ton: sudara se s akordom pa klizne u njega.

rows.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
rows.translation: Deveti takt, uz B7: povišeni F na pragu 2 žice 1, prazni E, povišeni D na pragu 4 žice 2 malim prstom, pa B.

rows.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: septakordi, sus akordi i shuffle od 12 taktova. Drži ujednačen dugo-kratki swing kroz svaku promjenu.

rows.source: Which chord uses all four fingers?
rows.translation: Koji akord koristi sva četiri prsta?

rows.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
rows.translation: Kvintni akordi, otvoreni i pomični, prigušivanje dlanom i tvoj vlastiti rif.

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.translation: Kvintni akord sadrži samo osnovni ton i kvintu, ton pet slovnih mjesta više. Nije ni dur ni mol i ostaje prodoran, čak i glasno odsviran. E5 je donji dio E-mola.

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
rows.translation: Pomakni ista dva prsta na žice 4 i 3. Uz praznu žicu 5 dobivaš A5. Ciljaj potez samo na žice 5, 4 i 3.

rows.source: Which notes make a power chord?
Rest the edge of your hand
Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
rows.translation: Nasloni vanjski rub ruke s trzalicom na žice, točno uz most. Odsviraj potez i tonovi postaju kratki i zbijeni.

rows.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
rows.translation: Uz most žice još zvuče, samo kraće. Pomakni dlan naprijed i potpuno će utihnuti.

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
rows.translation: Rock često gradi napetost prigušenim osminkama, a zatim stiže na otvoreni akord. Podigni dlan za snažan potez i pusti ga da zvoni.

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
rows.translation: Prst 1 na žici 6, pragu 3, a prsti 3 i 4 dva praga više na žicama 5 i 4. To je G5. Klizni hvatom i ime se mijenja s pragom.

rows.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Osnovni ton je na žici 6, pragu 5. Koji je to kvintni akord?

rows.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
rows.translation: Broji uz žicu 6: prazna E, F na 1, G na 3, A na 5.

rows.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
rows.translation: Isti hvat radi i od žice 5. Prst 1 na žici 5, pragu 3 daje C5. Vrhom prsta 1 dotakni žicu 6 da šuti.

rows.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
rows.translation: Rif je kratka, pamtljiva fraza koja se ponavlja. Ovaj se oslanja na prazni niski E. Nasloni dlan uz most za čvrst zvuk.

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: Prazni E, žica 6 na pragu 3, pa prazni A.

rows.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
rows.translation: Drugi se takt penje po žici 5: prag 2, pa prag 5 malim prstom, zatim natrag na prag 2. Drži prst 1 blizu praga 2.

rows.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
rows.translation: Žica 5: prag 2, prag 5 malim prstom, opet prag 2.

rows.source: What makes a riff a riff?
Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
rows.translation: Pjesme često odgovaraju na rif kvintnim akordima. Odsviraj rif, pa udari akorde na jedan, na i nakon dva te na četiri.

rows.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
rows.translation: Pomakni G5 dva praga više. Što dobivaš?

rows.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.
rows.translation: Dva praga iznad G je A. Ime akorda pomiče se s osnovnim tonom.
Pjesma u fokusu: Vrijeme u podrumu

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Vrijeme u podrumu izvorna je pjesma Timbre: garažni rock u A. Otvara je rif na niskim žicama, a kvintni akordi odgovaraju na jedan, na i nakon dva te na četiri. Drži dlan uz most. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.translation: Prazni A, C na pragu 3 žice 5, prazni D, pa G na pragu 3 žice 6 i prazni niski E.

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.translation: Znaš C5, s prstom 1 na žici 5, pragu 3. Klizni cijelim hvatom dva praga više i dobivaš D5. G5 je također na pragu 3, jednu žicu niže od C5.

rows.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: kvintni akordi, otvoreni i pomični, prigušivanje dlanom i tvoj rif. Prati klik i precizno prigušuj.

rows.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Osnovni ton je na žici 5, pragu 3. Koji je to kvintni akord?

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.
rows.translation: Žica 5 kreće od A: B na 2, C na 3.

rows.source: Which one is a power chord?
The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
rows.translation: Bare hvat F i B-mol, A-molska pentatonika i tvoj prvi solo.

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.translation: Za pune bare akorde trebaju tjedni, pa ih gradi postupno. Znaš mali F. Slijedi F na pet žica, zatim puni bare hvat.

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.translation: Pomakni prst 3 na žicu 5, prag 3 i stavi mali prst na žicu 4, prag 3. Pet žica zvoni, a F zvuči punije.

rows.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
rows.translation: Bare akordi u početku su teški. Što najviše pomaže?

rows.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
rows.translation: Snaga i osjećaj razvijaju se polako. Kratka svakodnevna vježba bolja je od jednog dugog, bolnog vježbanja.

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.translation: Položi prst 1 preko svih šest žica na pragu 1. Prsti 2, 3 i 4 ispred njega čine hvat E. F je E pomaknut jedan prag više.

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.translation: Neka težina ruke povuče bare hvat, kao da nježno privlačiš vrat prema sebi. Palac ga samo stabilizira. Zakreni prst 1 na bok.

rows.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
rows.translation: Koji je otvoreni hvat pomaknut prag više bare hvat F?

rows.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
rows.translation: Prst 1 prekriva žice od 1 do 5 na pragu 2. Prsti 2, 3 i 4 grade hvat A-mola dva praga više. Preskoči žicu 6.

rows.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Još ne ide bare hvat? Sviraj samo gornje četiri žice: prag 4 na žicama 4 i 3, prag 3 na žici 2, prag 2 na žici 1.

rows.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
rows.translation: Koji akord dobivaš kad E pomakneš prag više uz bare hvat?

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.translation: Molska pentatonika ima pet tonova. U A-molu to su A, C, D, E i G. To je zvuk brojnih blues i rock sola.

rows.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Prst 1 pokriva prag 5 na svakoj žici. Prsti 3 i 4 uzimaju pragove 7 i 8. Dva tona po žici, jedan prst po pragu.

rows.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
rows.translation: Prag 5, prag 8 na žici 6, pa prag 5, prag 7 na žici 5.

rows.source: Which notes are in A minor pentatonic?
rows.translation: Koji su tonovi u A-molskoj pentatonici?

rows.source: A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
rows.translation: Solo je melodija od kratkih fraza. Odsviraj nekoliko tonova, ostavi prazninu pa odgovori. Završetak na A, osnovnom tonu, zvuči kao točka.

rows.source: Which note sounds most like a full stop in A minor?
rows.translation: Koji ton u A-molu najviše zvuči kao završna točka?

rows.source: A is the root, the home of A minor. Ending a phrase on it sounds finished.
rows.translation: A je osnovni ton, dom A-mola. Fraza koja njime završava zvuči dovršeno.

rows.source: A power ballad with a barre

Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Stakleni sateliti izvorna je pjesma Timbre: snažna rock balada uz A-mol, F, C i G. Puni bare hvat F drugi je akord, a obrazac 1 odgovara cijeloj petlji, pa dobiva solo. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Over the F chord, which box-1 notes belong to it?
rows.translation: Koji tonovi obrasca 1 pripadaju akordu F?

rows.source: F is F, A and C. Box 1 holds A and C, so they sound settled over F.
rows.translation: F čine F, A i C. Obrazac 1 ima A i C, pa oni uz F zvuče smireno.

rows.source: No new ideas: barre chords, B minor, the pentatonic box and your solo. Breathe, keep the beat, and play it like you mean it.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: bare akordi, B-mol, pentatonski obrazac i tvoj solo. Diši, drži ritam i sviraj uvjerljivo.

rows.source: Which finger covers fret 5 in box 1?
rows.translation: Koji prst pokriva prag 5 u obrascu 1?

rows.source: Thumb on the bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and a fingerpicked ballad.
rows.translation: Palac na basu, p-i-m-a, Travisov stil i balada svirana prstima.

rows.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
rows.translation: Sviranje prstima znači trzanje prstima umjesto trzalicom. Palac drži basovske žice, 6, 5 i 4, i svira na dobu poput velikog bubnja.

rows.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Samo palac: guraj dolje kroz žice 6, 5 i 4, jednu po jednu.

rows.source: Which strings does your thumb usually play?
The thumb takes the bass strings. Your fingers take the thinner ones.
rows.translation: Palac preuzima basovske žice. Prsti preuzimaju tanje.

rows.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
rows.translation: Drži A-mol. Palac svira osnovni ton na žici 5, pa prelazi na žicu 4, kvintu akorda. Osnovni ton, kvinta, osnovni ton, kvinta: to je izmjenični bas.

rows.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
rows.translation: Sviranje prstima posuđuje španjolske oznake: p za palac, i za kažiprst, m za srednji prst, a za prstenjak. Nasloni i na žicu 3, m na žicu 2 i a na žicu 1, spremne za trzaj.

rows.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
rows.translation: i, m, a: kažiprst na žici 3, srednji na 2, prstenjak na 1.

rows.source: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. The little finger usually rests.
rows.translation: p palac, i kažiprst, m srednji prst, a prstenjak. Mali prst obično miruje.

rows.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
rows.translation: Svaki prst trza gore i blago prema dlanu, pa se opusti. Drži ruku mirno iznad žica i prepusti pokret prstima.

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.translation: Travisov stil, nazvan po Merleu Travisu, drži palac u izmjeni na svaku dobu, dok prsti trzaju između, na i.

rows.source: In Travis picking, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Što palac radi u Travisovu stilu?

rows.source: Alternates bass notes on every beat
rows.translation: Izmjenjuje basovske tonove na svaku dobu

rows.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
rows.translation: Palac je stalan puls: basovski ton na svaku dobu, uz izmjenu dviju žica.

rows.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
rows.translation: Neka palac nastavi. Između njegovih tonova m trza žicu 2, a i žicu 3: palac, m, palac, i. Sviraj polako dok ne krene samo.

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
rows.translation: Koji prst između tonova palca trza žicu 2?

rows.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.
rows.translation: U ovom obrascu m svira žicu 2, a i žicu 3. Prst a zasad miruje.

rows.source: When the chord changes, the thumb lands on the new root right on beat one. The fingers keep plucking strings 2 and 3 as before.
rows.translation: Kad se akord promijeni, palac stiže na novi osnovni ton točno na prvu dobu. Prsti nastavljaju trzati žice 2 i 3 kao prije.

rows.source: The chord changes. Where does your thumb go?
rows.translation: Akord se mijenja. Kamo ide palac?

rows.source: The bass tells the ear which chord you're on. Landing the root on beat one makes the change clear.
rows.translation: Bas govori uhu koji akord sviraš. Osnovni ton na prvu dobu jasno označava promjenu.

rows.source: Hold each chord for the whole bar so every note rings into the next. Lift a finger only when the next shape needs it.
rows.translation: Drži svaki akord cijeli takt da svaki ton traje do sljedećega. Podigni prst tek kad ga novi hvat treba.

rows.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
rows.translation: Arpeđo svira akord ton po ton. Ovaj ide p, i, m, a, pa natrag dolje m, i. Šest tonova puni trodobni takt, dva po dobi.

rows.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Nakon što a trzne žicu 1, koji prst slijedi?

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
rows.translation: Obrazac se okreće na vrhu: p, i, m, a, pa m i i na povratku.

rows.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Po jedan takt: A-mol, F, C, G, pa A-mol, F, E, A-mol. Palac nalazi svaki novi osnovni ton: žice 5, 4, 5 i 6.
Pjesma u fokusu: Svjetlo na trijemu

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Svjetlo na trijemu izvorna je pjesma Timbre: spora balada u D-duru. Sviraj prstima: palac na osnovni ton svakog akorda, zatim i, m i a po žicama 3, 2 i 1. Pusti da svaki ton traje do sljedećega. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
rows.translation: Koju žicu svira palac u hvatu D?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton akorda D daje prazna žica 4. Žice 5 i 6 u tom akordu šute.

rows.source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: izmjenični bas, p-i-m-a, Travisov stil i balada. Drži palac ravnomjernim i pusti svaki ton da zvoni.

rows.source: In p-i-m-a, which letter is the thumb?
rows.translation: Koje slovo u p-i-m-a označava palac?

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 3?
rows.translation: Koji prst između tonova palca trza žicu 3?

rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: Blues od 12 taktova u A, rana promjena, boogie bas, povratni završetak i tvoje prve blues fraze.

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Blues akordi stoje na prvom, četvrtom i petom tonu tonaliteta. U E to su E7, A7 i B7. Prijeđi u A i postaju A7, D7 i E7.

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Koji akord u tonalitetu A obavlja ulogu koju je B7 imao u E?

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 je pet slovnih mjesta iznad E. Pet mjesta iznad A je E, pa E7 preuzima njegovu ulogu.

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Četiri takta A7, dva D7, dva A7, pa po jedan E7, D7, A7 i E7. Zadnji E7 vraća te na početak.

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Pri ranoj promjeni takt 2 skače na četvrti akord i odmah natrag. U A: A7, D7, A7, A7. To dodaje pokret od samog početka.

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Koji je akord u taktu 2 pri ranoj promjeni u A?

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: Četvrti akord u A je D7. Rana promjena posjećuje ga u taktu 2, pa se vraća na A7.

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Rana promjena radi u svakom tonalitetu. U E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Pripazi na B7 pri kraju, svoj akord s četiri prsta.

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Boogie dionica ide uz akord i natrag, svaki ton dvaput, dugo-kratko kao shuffle. Uz A7 penje se A, povišeni C, E, povišeni F, G, pa silazi natrag.

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: Prazni A, prag 4 na žici 5, pragovi 2 i 4 na žici 4, pa prazni G.

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Kakav je odnos dvaju tonova svakog para?

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Opet je to shuffle: dug ton na dobu, kratak tik prije sljedeće.

rows.source: Move it to D and E
The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Ista šetnja kreće od D na žici 4 i od E na žici 6. Uz D7: D, povišeni F, A, B, C. Uz E7: E, povišeni G, B, povišeni C, D.

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.translation: Boogie, iz A u D i natrag

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: Taktovi 11 i 12 često imaju povratni završetak, kratku frazu koja vodi na početak. Ova se spušta od A do E, prag po prag.

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: Žica 4: prag 4, pa 3, pa 2. Pusti E da zvoni.

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: U zadnja dva takta. Vodi uho natrag na takt 1 za novi krug.

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Prvih deset taktova sviraj s ranom promjenom, pa prijeđi na frazu za taktove 11 i 12. Tako blues sastav završava svaki krug.

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: Tvoj A-molski pentatonski obrazac pristaje uz blues u A. Njegov C sudara se s povišenim C u A7, a taj je sudar zvuk bluesa.

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Koji ton uz blues u A najviše zvuči kao dom?

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: A je osnovni ton tonaliteta. Fraze koje završavaju na A zvuče smireno; G i C ostavljaju napetost.

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Blues fraze razgovaraju. Odsviraj frazu 1 kao pitanje, pa odgovori frazom 2, koja završava na niskom A.

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neonska praonica izvorna je pjesma Timbre: funk koji se drži jednog akorda, A7. Motiv klizi s C na povišeni C, s istim trenjem kao tvoje blues fraze, a refren pada na E7. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A na pragu 2 žice 3, pa C i povišeni C na pragovima 1 i 2 žice 2, pa prazni E.

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.translation: Koji se ton uz A7 sudara s akordom?

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: A7 čine A, povišeni C, E i G. C iz tvog pentatonskog obrasca sudara se s povišenim C u akordu, a motiv klizi s jednoga na drugi.

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: Neonska praonica nema shuffle ritam. Odsviraj boogie šetnju ravnim osminkama i postaje bas uz A7: A, povišeni C, E, povišeni F, G, pa natrag dolje.

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: blues od 12 taktova u A i E, rana promjena, boogie dionica, povratni završetak i tvoje fraze. Neka shuffle i dalje njiše.

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Koji je akord u taktu 2 pri ranoj promjeni u E?

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off, slide, bend i vibrato te drugi pentatonski obrazac.

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: Hammer-on oglasi drugi ton samo rukom na vratu. Trzni ton pa drugim prstom odlučno udari žicu odmah iza višeg praga. Žica nastavlja zvoniti.

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Trzni praznu žicu 3 pa udari prstom 2 na prag 2. Drugi ton nemoj trzati.

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: Žica 3: drži prag 5 prstom 1 i trzni, pa prstom 3 udari na prag 7.

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
rows.translation: Brz, čvrst doskok odmah iza praga

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Brzina i preciznost važnije su od sile. Doskoči vrhom prsta odmah iza praga i žica će nastaviti pjevati.

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Pull-off spušta na niži ton. Uz oba prsta na žici trzni viši ton, pa gornji prst povuci ustranu tako da pri odlasku trzne žicu.

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: Prag 2 na žici 3, pa povuci prst 2 ustranu da zazvoni prazni G.

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Prsti 1 i 3 na pragovima 5 i 7. Trzni, pa povuci prst 3 sa žice.

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
rows.translation: Povlači se ustranu i trza žicu

rows.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Ravno podizanje utišava ton. Mali trzaj ustranu oživljava niži ton.

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Za klizanje trzni ton i nastavi pritiskati dok isti prst klizi do novog praga. Pritisak nosi zvuk; trzaš samo prvi ton.

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Prst 3 na žici 3, pragu 7. Trzni pa klizni do praga 9 bez podizanja.

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Što održava zvuk tona tijekom klizanja?

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Popustiš li, ton se gasi. Zadrži isti pritisak sve do novog praga.

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Sada natrag: trzni prag 9 i klizni dolje do praga 7.

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Bend gura žicu preko praga i povisuje ton. Bend za cijeli ton, odnosno dva praga, s praga 7 mora zvučati točno kao prag 9.

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Žica 3, prag 9: ovo je cilj benda. Pusti ton da zvoni i zapamti ga.

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Stavi prst 3 na prag 7, s prstima 1 i 2 iza njega na istoj žici. Guraj sva tri prema stropu i okreći zapešće kao kvaku.

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: Bend s praga 7 zvuči niže od praga 9. Što sada?

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
rows.translation: Bend koji ne doseže cilj zvuči nečisto. Guraj dok ne odgovara tonu koji čuješ kao cilj.

rows.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Ciljni ton, pa nedovoljno podignut bend. Isti ton ili različit?

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: Vibrato je mali bend i otpuštanje, brzo ponavljani na zadržanom tonu. Neka bude uzak i ujednačen da ton ostane čist.

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Istih pet tonova ponavlja se uz vrat. Obrazac 2 počinje gdje obrazac 1 završava: prst 1 na pragu 7 žica 5, 4 i 3, prst 2 na pragu 8 žica 6, 2 i 1.

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Žica 6: pragovi 8 i 10. Žica 5: pragovi 7 i 10.

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Istih pet tonova kao u obrascu 1, A C D E G, na novom mjestu na vratu.

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Za prijelaz iz obrasca 1 u obrazac 2 klizni prstom 3 s praga 7 do praga 9 na žici 3. U obrazac 2 stižeš s rukom već na mjestu.

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Slana nedjelja izvorna je pjesma Timbre: opušteni reggae u A-molu, gdje Am7 i D7 izmjenjuju taktove. Oba pentatonska obrasca pristaju. Sviraj hammer-on, pull-off i slide, a svaki takt počni tonom akorda. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Koji od ovih tonova obrasca pripada akordu D7?

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 čine D, povišeni F, A i C. C, njegova septima, zvuči smireno; E i G samo prolaze.

rows.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
rows.translation: Tvoj solo uz Am7 i D7

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: hammer-on, pull-off, slide, ciljevi benda, vibrato i oba obrasca. Sviraj svaku frazu čisto, pa joj daj glas.

rows.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
rows.translation: Bend za cijeli ton s praga 7 treba odgovarati…

rows.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Ciljni ton, pa bend. Isti ton ili različit?
Iz obrasca 1 u obrazac 2, s osjećajem

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: Hvatovi E i A uz vrat, dur i mol, bliži hvat i progresija u A.

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: Tvoj bare F je hvat E s bareom na pragu 1. Klizni cijelim hvatom gore i ime prati osnovni ton na žici 6: na pragu 3 je G, na pragu 5 je A.

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: Bare u hvatu E na pragu 5. Koji je akord?

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Žica 6 kreće od E: F na 1, G na 3, A na 5. Prag bare hvata određuje ime akorda.

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Podigni prst 2 i neka bare pokrije žicu 3. To je hvat E-mola koji se pomiče jednako: mol na povišenom F na pragu 2, A-mol na pragu 5.
Hvat A, osnovni ton na žici 5

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B-mol bio je hvat A-mola uz bare. Durski hvat A također se pomiče: prekrij žice od 1 do 5, pa položi prst 3 preko žica 4, 3 i 2, dva praga više.

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: Bare u hvatu A na pragu 3. Koji je akord?

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Žica 5 kreće od A: B na 2, C na 3, D na 5.

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.translation: Pomiče se i molski hvat A

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Za mol koristi prste B-mola: 2, 3 i 4 grade obrazac A-mola ispred bare hvata. Na pragu 3 to je C-mol.

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Većina akorda ima hvat E, s osnovnim tonom na žici 6, ili hvat A, s osnovnim tonom na žici 5. Odaberi onaj bliži trenutnom položaju ruke.

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Sviraš G na pragu 3. Gdje je najbliži C?

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton C je na žici 5, pragu 3. Ostani na pragu 3 i prijeđi na hvat A.

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Iz G u C na pragu 3 prst 1 zadržava bare. Mijenjaju se samo prsti ispred njega. To je najglađa promjena bare akorda.

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: Na kojem je pragu D u hvatu A?

rows.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Žica 5: prazni A, B na 2, C na 3, D na 5.

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.translation: Mol na povišenom F, D, A, E

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: Mol na povišenom F, D, A i E pripadaju tonalitetu A. Počni molom na povišenom F uz bare, a preostala tri sviraj otvoreno.

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Mol na povišenom F u bare hvatu E nalazi se na…

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Žica 6: F na pragu 1, povišeni F na pragu 2.

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.translation: Sviraj uz vrat: mol na povišenom F na pragu 2, D u hvatu A na pragu 5, A u hvatu E na pragu 5 i E u hvatu A na pragu 7.

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Na trenutak popusti bare dok se pomičeš, pa pritisni pri doskoku. Stalan jak stisak umara ruku i usporava promjenu.

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.translation: Kada ruka na vratu treba stisnuti?

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Stisni pri doskoku, opusti pri pomaku. Stalna sila umara ruku za nekoliko minuta.

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Na zadnji potez gore prije promjene podigni bare i nastavi svirati. Prazne žice načas zazvuče, ritam ne staje i stižeš na vrijeme.
Pjesma u fokusu: Zora u spreju

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Zora u spreju izvorna je pjesma Timbre: indie pop u E uz E, B, mol na povišenom C i A. B i mol na povišenom C su bare hvatovi A udaljeni dva praga, pa jedan oblik ruke obavlja većinu posla. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Mol na povišenom C u bare hvatu A-mola nalazi se na…

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
rows.translation: Žica 5 kreće od A: B na 2, C na 3, povišeni C na 4.

rows.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: hvatovi E i A, dur i mol, odabir bližeg hvata i glatke promjene. Opusti se između akorda i stigni na prvu dobu.

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
rows.translation: Bare u hvatu E na pragu 3 je…

rows.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
rows.translation: Koji hvat ima osnovni ton na žici 5?

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Funk šesnaestinke i prigušeni potezi, reggae udar, country bum-čik i sinkopirani pop obrazac.

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Šesnaestinke dijele svaku dobu na četiri: jedan-e-i-a, dva-e-i-a. Ruka udvostručuje brzinu, dolje-gore-dolje-gore unutar svake dobe.

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.translation: Koliko šesnaestinki stane u jednu dobu?

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: Jedan-e-i-a: četiri jednaka dijela svake dobe.

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk voli nonakord. Prst 2 na žici 5, pragu 7, prst 1 na žici 4, pragu 6 i prst 3 položen preko žica 3, 2 i 1 na pragu 7.

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Drži ruku u šesnaestinkama, ali opusti prste na vratu da većina poteza daje suhe, šuškave klikove. Pritisni samo za jasne udare.

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.translation: Prsti na vratu lagano dodiruju žice

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Dodir bez pritiska sprečava žice da zvone. Potez postaje jasan udaraljkaški klik.

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Stisni za svaki udar pa odmah opusti da ostane kratak. Klizni cijelim hvatom E9 dva praga dolje i dobivaš D9.
Kratki udari na dva i četiri

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Reggae gitara odgovara bubnjevima kratkim, svijetlim akordima na drugu i četvrtu dobu. Sviraj samo tanke žice i odmah prekini svaki akord.

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Koristi samo gornje četiri žice. Ovaj A-mol gornji je dio bare hvata A-mola na pragu 5: prst 3 na žici 4, pragu 7, a prst 1 prekriva ostale.

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Koliko dugo treba zvoniti reggae udar?

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Stisni, sviraj, otpusti. Udar je kratak lavež, a prostor nakon njega stvara ritam.

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Sada vrh tvog bare hvata D: prst 3 položen preko žica 4, 3 i 2 na pragu 7, prst 1 na žici 1, pragu 5.

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Country ritam dijeli takt: jedan basovski ton na prvu i treću dobu, brz potez po tankim žicama na dva i četiri. Bum, čik, bum, čik.

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Što se u bum-čiku događa na drugu i četvrtu dobu?

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
