Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Premjesti drugi bum na drugu žicu: u G, žica 6 pa žica 4. U C, žica 5 pa 4. U D, žica 4 pa prazna žica 5.

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.translation: Basovski udari u G, C i D

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Sinkopa stavlja potez ondje gdje ga ne očekuješ. Dolje na jedan, gore na i nakon dva, gore na i nakon tri, pa dolje-gore na četiri.

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Što ruka radi na drugu dobu u ovom obrascu?

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Njihalo nikad ne staje. Na dva ruka ide dolje bez dodira, spremna za potez gore.

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Pop svirači često mijenjaju akord na zadnji potez gore, na i nakon četiri, pa novi akord stiže mrvicu ranije. To gura pjesmu naprijed.

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords

Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sezona prskalica izvorna je pjesma Timbre: ljetna himna u C uz C, G, A-mol i F. Sviraj sinkopirani pop obrazac i mijenjaj mrvicu ranije, na i nakon četiri. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: Prazni E i D na pragu 3 žice 2, dvaput, pa G na pragu 3 žice 1 i natrag dolje do D.

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.translation: Zašto mijenjati akorde na i nakon četiri?

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.translation: Da novi akord zvoni na prvu dobu

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Pomak na zadnji potez gore dovodi ruku mrvicu ranije, pa je novi akord spreman za prvu dobu.

rows.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: funk šesnaestinke, reggae udar, bum-čik i sinkopirani pop obrazac. Neka ruka stalno radi, mijenjaj samo što zahvaća.

rows.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
rows.translation: Na koje dobe dolaze reggae udari?

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Kapodaster, hvatovi G i D na kapodasteru 2 te Oh! Susanna sa strofom i refrenom.

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Kapodaster steže svaku žicu na jednom pragu. Na pragu 2 svaka prazna žica zvuči dva praga više, a svi otvoreni hvatovi akorda pomiču se s njim.

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Prije kapodastera: trzni prazne žice 1 i 2. To su E i B.

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Sada stavi kapodaster odmah iza praga 2 i trzni ih opet: povišeni F i povišeni C.

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Kapodaster je na pragu 2. Sviraš hvat G. Koji akord čuješ?

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: Dva praga iznad G je A. Hvat ostaje G; zvuk se podiže s kapodasterom.

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: S kapodasterom i dalje misliš G, C i D, poznate hvatove. Dijagrami ovdje imenuju akord koji čuješ, pa je hvat G uz kapodaster 2 označen A.

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.translation: Hvatovi G i D uz kapodaster 2

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: Uz kapodaster 2 hvatovi G, C, D i E-mol zvuče kao A, D, E i mol na povišenom F. Isti prsti, novi tonalitet: A-dur.

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapodaster na pragu 2. Hvat D zvuči kao…

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: Dva praga iznad D je E.

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: Hvatovi D rade jednako. Uz kapodaster 2 hvatovi D, G i A zvuče kao E, A i B: tonalitet E uz lake otvorene hvatove.

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: Većina pjesama izmjenjuje dva dijela. Strofa priča priču, refren ponavlja glavni motiv. Oh! Susanna Stephena Fostera (1848) ima oboje. Skini kapodaster: pjesma je u G.

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: Predtakt i prvi takt: prazni G, A na pragu 2, pa prazni B, D na pragu 3 dvaput i prazni E.

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Koji se dio obično vraća s istim riječima?

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Strofe mijenjaju riječi kako priča napreduje. Refren se vraća nepromijenjen i njega ljudi pjevaju zajedno.

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Prati strofu uz G i D7, bum-čik stilom: bas na jedan, potez na dva. Tri takta G, jedan D7, dva G, pa D7 i G.

rows.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
rows.translation: Refren počinje na C, žici 2, pragu 1, pa skače na prazni E. Akordi su C, G i D7, a druga polovica odgovara završetku strofe.

rows.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
rows.translation: Početak: C dvaput na žici 2, pragu 1, pa prazni E triput.

rows.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Zatim dolje: D dvaput, prazni B, prazni G i A na pragu 2.

rows.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
rows.translation: Tri tona E idu kratko, dugo, kratko. Gdje počinje dugi?

rows.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
rows.translation: Počinje na i i traje preko sljedeće dobe. Taj je pomak sinkopa, kao u tvom pop obrascu.

rows.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
rows.translation: Aranžman određuje što sviraš i kada. Tvoj: uvod u Travisovu stilu, strofa kao melodija, refren u bum-čik stilu, pa melodija refrena za kraj.

rows.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
rows.translation: Postavlja tonalitet i tempo prije melodije

rows.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
rows.translation: Nekoliko taktova akorda svima govori gdje je dom i koliko brzo svirati.

rows.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
rows.translation: Završi melodijom refrena i pusti zadnji G da zvoni. Završetak melodijom koju su svi upravo čuli djeluje zaokruženo.
Pjesma u fokusu: Two-step na makadamu

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Two-step na makadamu izvorna je pjesma Timbre: plesni country u A, uz A, D i E. Stavi kapodaster na prag 2 i sviraj hvatovima G, C i D, koje najbolje znaš. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
rows.translation: Kapodaster je na pragu 2. Koji hvat zvuči kao E?

rows.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
rows.translation: Dva praga iznad D je E. Uz kapodaster 2 hvat G daje A, a hvat C daje D.

rows.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
rows.translation: Trzni osnovni ton akorda na prvu i treću dobu, a na dva i četiri prijeđi po žicama, svaki put uz brzi potez gore. Bum, čik-a, bum, čik-a: koraci plesača.

rows.source: No new ideas: the capo, G and D shapes, and your Oh! Susanna arrangement. Play it as if someone's listening. Maybe someone is.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: kapodaster, hvatovi G i D i tvoj aranžman Oh! Susanna. Sviraj kao da netko sluša. Možda netko i sluša.

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A C shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapodaster na pragu 2. Hvat C zvuči kao…

rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
rows.translation: Pet otvorenih hvatova postaje pet mjesta za G i akorde koji ostaju blizu ruke.

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Svaki durski akord može posuditi hvat otvorenog C, A, G, E ili D pomaknut uz vrat. Kreneš li od bilo kojeg, slijede tim redom, C A G E D, i svaki se nadovezuje na sljedeći.
Po čemu je CAGED dobio ime?

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: C, A, G, E i D: pet otvorenih hvatova koje svaki durski akord može posuditi bilo gdje na vratu.

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Kreni uz vrat od otvorenog G i slijedi hvat E: tvoj bare G na pragu 3. Osnovni ton na žici 6 isti je G kao u otvorenom akordu.

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: Otvoreni D pomaknut pet pragova gore daje G. Prst 1 drži žicu 4 na pragu 5, gdje je prije bila gornja kobilica. Prsti 2, 4 i 3 iznad njega ponovno tvore trokut D.

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
Where is the D shape's root?
rows.translation: Gdje je osnovni ton hvata D?

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton otvorenog D daje prazna žica 4. Nakon pomaka drži ga prst 1: G na pragu 5. Žica 2, prag 8 također daje G.

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: Hvat E na pragu 3 i hvat D na pragu 5 dijele jedan ton: G na žici 4, pragu 5. Prati ga pogledom dok prelaziš između njih.

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: Otvoreni C pomaknut sedam pragova gore daje G. Prst 1 leži preko žica 3, 2 i 1 na pragu 7, prst 2 uzima žicu 2 na pragu 8, a prsti 3 i 4 pružaju se do žica 4 i 5.

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Kao i u otvorenom C, osnovni ton hvata C je na…

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton otvorenog C je na žici 5, pragu 3. Ovdje ga drži mali prst: G na pragu 10.

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Klizni hvatom C dolje do praga 2 i dobivaš D, s osnovnim tonom na žici 5, pragu 5. Ime uvijek prati osnovni ton.

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Prekrij žice od 5 do 1 na pragu 10 i položi prst 3 preko žica 4, 3 i 2 na pragu 12. To je tvoj bare u hvatu A, a opet je G.

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: Nakon hvata A hvat G vraća se na pragu 12: otvoreni G, oktavu više. Odatle se pet hvatova ponavlja istim redom.

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Kad ideš uz vrat, koji hvat slijedi nakon A?

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Redoslijed se vrti: C, A, G, E, D, pa opet C. Nakon A dolazi G.

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: Uz CAGED rijetko moraš skakati. Oko praga 5 G je hvat D, C je hvat G, a D je hvat A. Tri akorda, jedno mjesto.

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: Koji hvat svira C tik uz G u hvatu D?

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: C u hvatu G koristi pragove 5 i 8, upravo gdje ti ruka već jest.

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Ista ideja radi niže: G u hvatu E na pragu 3, C u hvatu A na pragu 3 i D u hvatu C na pragu 2.

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Brijeg lampiona izvorna je pjesma Timbre: pjesma za zajedničko pjevanje uz vatru na G, C i D. Sviraj refren otvoreno, pa blizu praga 5, pa blizu praga 3, i ista pjesma putuje vratom. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: Koji hvat blizu praga 5 svira C?

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: C u hvatu G koristi pragove 5 i 8, tik uz G u hvatu D i D u hvatu A.

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: G u svih pet hvatova te G, C i D blizu praga 3 i praga 5. Imenuj svaki hvat kad ga postaviš.

rows.source: G with the D shape sits at…
rows.translation: G u hvatu D nalazi se na…

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Akordi s tri tona na gornjim žicama: dur i mol, svaki obrat i progresije s jedva primjetnim pomakom.

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: Trozvuk je najmanji potpuni akord: osnovni ton, terca i kvinta. Na žicama 3, 2 i 1 trozvuci zvone jasno i svijetlo te rade bilo gdje na vratu.

rows.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton, terca, kvinta: od C preskoči jedno slovo do E, pa još jedno do G.

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Premjesti najniži ton na vrh i dobivaš obrat. S E na dnu C stoji na pragovima 9, 8 i 8. S G na dnu to je vrh tvog otvorenog C.

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Svaki durski trozvuk na ovim žicama koristi jedan od tri hvata, po jedan za svaki obrat. Nauči ih na G i D i moći ćeš pronaći svaki durski akord.

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G na pragovima 4, 3 i 3 ima isti hvat kao…

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Oba stavljaju tercu na dno: prag više na žici 3, ostale dvije poravnate. Isti hvat, udaljen pet pragova.

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D na pragovima 7, 7 i 5 ima osnovni hvat kao tvoj C na pragu 5. Niže, pragovi 2, 3 i 2 čine vrh otvorenog D.

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: Molski trozvuk je durski s tercom jedan prag niže. Na ovim žicama A-mol na pragovima 2, 1 i 0 čini vrh otvorenog A-mola.

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Prekrij prag 5 na žicama 3, 2 i 1 i dobivaš A-mol s C na dnu. Jedan prst, tri tona.

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E-mol na pragovima 4, 5 i 3 stavlja B na dno. Tik je uz A-mol na pragu 5, pa je promjena sićušna.

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Odaberi obrat najbliži ruci i progresija se jedva pomiče. G, E-mol, C i D svi su između pragova 2 i 5.

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Iz G na pragovima 4, 3, 3 u E-mol na 4, 5, 3, koji tonovi ostaju?

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B na žici 3 i G na žici 1 ostaju. Samo se žica 2 mijenja, iz D gore u E.

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: Ista četiri akorda nalaze se i više: G na pragovima 7, 8 i 7, E-mol na 9, 8 i 7, C na 9, 8 i 8 te D na 7, 7 i 5.

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Sviraj tonove trozvuka jedan po jedan i dobivaš arpeđo. Kroz progresiju tonovi stvaraju vlastitu melodiju.

rows.source: A chord played one note at a time
The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Najviši tonovi ovdje idu G, G, G, povišeni F: gotovo miruju dok se akordi mijenjaju ispod. Ton koji dva akorda dijele zajednički je ton i zbog njega trozvuci zvuče tako glatko.

rows.source: Did the top note go up or down?
rows.translation: Je li najviši ton išao gore ili dolje?

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Koturaljkalište je izvorna pjesma Timbre: retro plesni pop uz G, E-mol, C i D, tvoja četiri trozvuka između pragova 2 i 5. Mali hvatovi na gornjim žicama zvuče svijetlo i čvrsto, poput druge gitare. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Petlja pjesme Koturaljkalište ide jedan, šest, četiri, pet u G. Koji je akord šest?

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Broji uz G-dur: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akord na 6 je molski: E-mol.

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: durski i molski trozvuci, njihovi obrati, G, E-mol, C i D na dva mjesta te arpeđi. Neka svaki pokret bude malen.

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
rows.translation: Molski trozvuk je durski trozvuk s…

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.translation: Veliki durski, mali molski i dominantni septakordi, otvoreni i bare, ii–V–I te pratnja u swingu.

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: Veliki durski septakord dodaje ton prag ispod oktave osnovnog tona. Običan durski akord pretvara u mekan, sanjiv zvuk. Otvoreni Cmaj7 je C s podignutim prstom 1.

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Cmaj7 je C uz koji dodani ton?

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Velika septima je prag ispod oktave osnovnog tona: B, tik ispod C.

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Sviraj mali F, ali prstom 1 pritisni samo žicu 2. Prazna žica 1, E, velika je septima od F.

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: Mali molski septakord dodaje ton dva praga ispod oktave osnovnog tona. Zvuči blago, između tamnog i svijetlog. Am7 je A-mol s podignutim prstom 3.

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: prst 2 na žici 3, pragu 2 i prst 1 preko žica 2 i 1 na pragu 1. Em7: samo prst 2 na žici 5, pragu 2.

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Am7 je A-mol uz koji dodani ton?

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Mala septima je dva praga ispod oktave osnovnog tona: G, dva praga ispod A.

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.translation: Septakordi s osnovnim tonom na žici 5

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Prst 1 drži žicu 5 na pragu 3 i leži sve do žice 1. Prst 3 uzima žicu 4, prst 2 žicu 3, a prst 4 žicu 2.

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 je tvoj bare hvat A-mola s podignutim malim prstom. D7 je bare hvat A s prstima 3 i 4 na žicama 4 i 2. Oba dobivaju ime po žici 5.

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 na pragu 5. Gdje je osnovni ton?

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Kao svaki akord u hvatu A, ime dobiva po tonu na žici 5.

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Omiljeni jazz pokret: akord na drugom tonu tonaliteta, zatim na petom, pa kući. U C to su Dm7, G7 i Cmaj7.

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Sviraj hvat E7 kao bare na pragu 3: prst 1 preko svih šest žica, prst 3 na žici 5 i prst 2 na žici 3. Osnovni ton je na žici 6.

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: Koji je akord ii u tonalitetu C?

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Broji od C: C je jedan, D je dva. Septakord na D je mali molski septakord D.

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Jazz svirači često puštaju akord da zvoni samo trenutak. Stisni pri potezu i odmah popusti pa će akordi početi njihati.

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Swing gitaristi sviraju kratke akorde koji odgovaraju sastavu. Charleston ritam udara prvu dobu i odgođeno i nakon dva, pa ostavlja prostor.

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: U G dva, pet, jedan glasi Am7, D7 i Gmaj7. Am7 je bare hvat malog molskog septakorda E na pragu 5; Gmaj7 preskače žicu 5, s osnovnim tonom na žici 6, pragu 3.

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Kasna odjava izvorna je pjesma Timbre: lo-fi u C uz Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 i Am7. To je ii–V–I, uz šesti akord za novi krug. Prati je bare septakordima i Charleston ritmom. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Koji je akord V u pjesmi Kasna odjava?

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Broji uz C-dur: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Septakord na G je G7.

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: veliki durski, mali molski i dominantni septakordi, otvoreni i bare, te ii–V–I u C i G. Drži akorde kratkima, a swing ujednačenim.

rows.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
rows.translation: Koja je septima prag ispod oktave osnovnog tona?

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G-dur u dvije oktave na pragu 2, stupnjevi ljestvice i akordi te dorski i miksolidijski modus.

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Poluton je jedan prag, cijeli ton dva. Svaka durska ljestvica ide cijeli, cijeli, polu, cijeli, cijeli, cijeli, polu. Taj obrazac daje duru zvuk.

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Stavi prst 1 na prag 2 i daj svakom prstu svoj prag, do praga 5. Od G na žici 6, pragu 3, ljestvica se penje preko žica 6, 5 i 4.

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Žica 6: pragovi 3 i 5, prsti 2 i 4. Žica 5: pragovi 2 i 3, prsti 1 i 2.

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Žica 5, prag 5, pa žica 4: pragovi 2, 4 i 5. Povratak na G.

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Gdje su polutonovi u durskoj ljestvici?

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Cijeli, cijeli, polu: prvi poluton je od 3 do 4. Cijeli, cijeli, cijeli, polu: drugi je od 7 do 8.

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Ista se pozicija nastavlja: A, B i C na žici 3, D i E na žici 2, povišeni F i G na žici 1. Ruka se ne pomiče.

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Žica 3: pragovi 2, 4, 5. Žica 2: pragovi 3, 5. Žica 1: pragovi 2, 3.

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Koji prst u ovoj poziciji svira prag 5?

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Prst 1 stoji na pragu 2, pa prag 5 pripada prstu 4, malom prstu.
Dvije oktave, od G do G

rows.source: A carol built on the scale
Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Joy to the World, u obradi Lowella Masona iz 1839., počinje G-durskom ljestvicom ravno od vrha prema dolje. Već znaš svaki ton.

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position
rows.translation: Joy to the World, u poziciji

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Numeriraj ljestvicu od G: G je 1, A je 2 i tako do povišenog F, 7. Glazbenici tim brojevima govore o melodijama i akordima u svakom tonalitetu.

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Broji od G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Na svaki stupanj složi svaki drugi ton ljestvice i dobivaš akorde tonaliteta. Na 1, 4 i 5 su durski; na 2, 3 i 6 molski. U G: G, C i D, pa A-mol, B-mol i E-mol.

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Koji se akord u G-duru gradi na 6?

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Šesti je ton E, a akordi na 2, 3 i 6 su molski. Složi E, G i B: E-mol.

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Sviraj tonove G-dura, ali A smatraj domom i ljestvica postaje molska. To je A dorski, modus G-dura: ista pozicija, novi početni ton.

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Počni od A na žici 6, pragu 5, prstom 4 i penji se istim pragovima do A na žici 3.

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Koji ton čini A dorski svjetlijim od običnog A-mola?

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: Obični A-mol ima F. Dorski zadržava povišeni F iz G-dura: svijetlu točku u molskoj ljestvici.

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Sada smatraj D domom. Tonovi G-dura od D do D daju D miksolidijski: dursku ljestvicu sa septimom prag niže. Čest je u folku, rocku i tradicijskim violinskim melodijama.

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Od D na žici 5, pragu 5, kroz istu poziciju do D na žici 2, pragu 3.

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D-dur ima povišeni C. D miksolidijski ima…

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Miksolidijski spušta septimu za prag, pa C iz G-dura daje njegov poseban zvuk.

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Svaki ton durske ljestvice može biti dom. Od G je dur, od A dorski, od D miksolidijski, od E obični mol. Isti pragovi, druga raspoloženja.

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sajmeni dan izvorna je pjesma Timbre: sunčani pop u G uz polet highlifea, vedre gitarske glazbe zapadne Afrike. Motiv koristi samo tonove G-dura, pa stane u ljestvicu druge pozicije. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Akordi pjesme Sajmeni dan su G, B-mol, C i D. Na kojim su stupnjevima ljestvice?

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: G je 1, B je 3, C je 4 i D je 5. Akord na 3 molski je u svakom durskom tonalitetu: B-mol.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, B na pragu 4 žice 3, opet D, E na pragu 5 prstom 4, pa D i B.

rows.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: G-dur u dvije oktave, ljestvica u tercama, A dorski i D miksolidijski. Drži jedan prst po pragu.

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…
rows.translation: Cijeli, cijeli, polu, cijeli, cijeli, cijeli, polu daje…

rows.source: Which mode starts on the second note of G major?
rows.translation: Koji modus počinje na drugom tonu G-dura?

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: Durska pentatonika, country hammer-on i slide, trileri, fraziranje te slatko i oporo uz blues.

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Pomakni molski pentatonski obrazac s praga 5 na prag 2 i smatraj A domom: postaje sladak i durski. To je A-durska pentatonika: A, B, povišeni C, E i povišeni F.

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Od A na žici 6, pragu 5, pa pragovi 2 i 4 na žicama 5 i 4, te A na pragu 2 žice 3.

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.translation: Koji su tonovi u A-durskoj pentatonici?

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, povišeni C, E, povišeni F

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Pet tonova A-durske ljestvice, bez njezina dva polutona. Molski obrazac na pragu 5 sadrži A, C, D, E i G.

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Ovaj je obrazac na pragu 2 i molska pentatonika na povišenom F, počneš li od povišenog F. Ton koji smatraš domom određuje koju sviraš.

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Country svirači vole hammer-on unutar ovog obrasca: E do povišenog F na žici 4, A do B na žici 3. Trzni prvi ton pa udari drugi prstom.

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Žica 4: trzni prag 2, pa prstom 3 udari na prag 4.

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Sada klizni prstom 3 po žici 3 s praga 4 do praga 6, iz B u povišeni C, pa se vrati u obrazac.

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Prst 3 na žici 3, pragu 4. Trzni pa klizni do praga 6 bez podizanja.

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: Triler treperi između dvaju tonova: jedan trzaj, pa hammer-on i pull-off ukrug. Neka bude ravnomjeran prije nego što ga ubrzaš.

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Žica 3: pragovi 2 i 4. Trzni jednom, pa radi hammer-on i pull-off prstom 3.

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Počni prag ispod željenog tona i klizni u njega dok trzaš. Cilj je važan: stigni na njega točno na dobu.

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Kad kliziš u ton, koji dolazi na dobu?

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: Klizanje počinje tik prije dobe, pa željeni ton stiže točno na nju.

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Uz blues u A rade oba obrasca. Durska pentatonika na pragu 2 zvuči slatko; molska na pragu 5 snažno. Dobri svirači prelaze između njih.

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Koji obrazac zvuči slađe uz A7?

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Durska pentatonika sadrži povišeni C, tercu akorda A7. C molskog obrasca sudara se s njim i taj je sudar blues.

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Postavi oštro pitanje na pragu 5, pa slatko odgovori na pragu 2. Pomakni ruku tijekom dugog tona i završi obje fraze na A.

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Dobri solo nastupi dišu. Odsviraj kratku frazu, odmaraj otprilike koliko je trajala, pa odgovori. Tišina daje važnost sljedećim tonovima.

rows.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
rows.translation: Koliko bi odmora moglo slijediti nakon fraze od dvije dobe?

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Odsviraj frazu dvaput isto, pa promijeni samo završetak. Slušatelji čuju ponavljanje i iščekuju obrat.

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Drži svaki dugi ton i njiši ga malim, ravnomjernim guranjem i otpuštanjem. Neka bude usko: visina treba treperiti, ne odlutati.

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Usporeni stroboskop izvorna je pjesma Timbre: synth-pop u A uz mol na povišenom F, D, A i E. Obrazac na pragu 2 pristaje cijeloj petlji: A-durska pentatonika, ujedno molska pentatonika na povišenom F. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Poslušaj prvi akord. Dur ili mol?

rows.source: Over F sharp minor and D
rows.translation: Uz mol na povišenom F i D

rows.source: Which box notes belong to the E chord?
rows.translation: Koji tonovi obrasca pripadaju akordu E?

rows.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
rows.translation: E čine E, povišeni G i B. Obrazac ima E i B, ali nema povišeni G, pa se uz E osloni na ta dva.

rows.source: No new ideas: the major pentatonic, hammer-ons, slides, trills and both boxes over the blues. Leave space, and finish on A.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: durska pentatonika, hammer-on, slide, trileri i oba obrasca uz blues. Ostavi prostor i završi na A.

rows.source: Slide the minor box from fret 5 to fret 2 and it plays…
rows.translation: Spusti molski obrazac s praga 5 na prag 2 i svira…

rows.source: Verse, chorus and AABA, intros and tags, texture and fills, and your own arrangement of Down by the Riverside.
rows.translation: Strofa, refren i AABA, uvodi i dodaci, tekstura i ispune te tvoj aranžman Down by the Riverside.

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: Većina pjesama ima nekoliko dijelova: strofe koje pričaju priču, refren koji ponavlja glavni motiv i katkad most za kontrast. Poznavanje plana čuva te od lutanja.

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Refren se vraća s istim riječima i melodijom. To je dio koji ljudi pamte i pjevaju zajedno.

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Mnoge starije pjesme koriste AABA: melodija, ista melodija opet, kontrastni most, pa melodija još jednom. Svaki dio često traje osam taktova; ovdje četiri.

rows.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?
rows.translation: Koji je dio most u obliku AABA?

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Najlakši uvod je zadnji redak pjesme, odsviran prije prve strofe. Postavlja tonalitet, tempo i ugođaj, a pjevač točno zna gdje treba ući.

rows.source: An intro from the last line
Why start with the song's last line?
It sets the key and tempo
To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: Za kraj ponovi zadnji redak, često još dvaput, i pusti završni akord da zvoni. Dodatak svima govori da se pjesma zatvara.

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Aranžeri podižu refren promjenom sviranja gitare. Sviraj strofu tiho prstima, pa refren potezima preko žica i isti akordi odjednom zvuče veće.

rows.source: Verse: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Strofa: Travisov stil na G i D7

rows.source: Each section can add a little: a picked verse, a strummed chorus, then triads up the neck for the last chorus. Save your biggest sound for the end.
rows.translation: Svaki dio može malo dodati: strofa prstima, refren preko žica, pa trozvuci uz vrat za zadnji refren. Sačuvaj najveći zvuk za kraj.

rows.source: When the melody holds a long note, a solo guitarist fills the space: a bass note or two from the chord, then back to the tune in time.
rows.translation: Kad melodija drži dugi ton, solo gitarist ispunjava prostor: jedan ili dva basovska tona iz akorda, pa na vrijeme natrag u melodiju.

rows.source: On top of every melody note
Fill with notes of the chord under the long note. Over G: G, B and D. Over D7: D, F sharp, A and C. They can't clash with the band.
rows.translation: Ispuni tonovima akorda ispod dugog tona. Uz G: G, B i D. Uz D7: D, povišeni F, A i C. Ne mogu se sukobiti s pratnjom.

rows.source: Down by the Riverside: your arrangement
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside: tvoj aranžman

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, duhovni napjev prvi put tiskan 1918., dobiva pun aranžman: uvod u Travisovu stilu, dvije strofe i refrena, pentatonski solo i dodatak.

rows.source: Intro: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Uvod: Travisov stil na G i D7

rows.source: A solo in G major pentatonic
The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.
rows.translation: Solo koristi G-dursku pentatoniku u otvorenoj poziciji: G, A, B, D i E. Prati akorde strofe i završava dobu ranije da se pjevač može vratiti.

rows.source: Which parts of this arrangement have no words?
rows.translation: Koji dijelovi ovog aranžmana nemaju riječi?
Pjesma u fokusu: Mjesec iz džuboksa

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Mjesec iz džuboksa izvorna je pjesma Timbre: spori ples pedesetih u obliku AABA, strofa, opet strofa, most na F, pa još jednom strofa. Sviraj svaku dobu, uz brz swing potez gore u svaki novi takt. Cijela je pjesma u Pjesmama, pod Izvorne pjesme.

rows.source: In Jukebox Moon, which section is the B?
rows.translation: Koji je dio B u pjesmi Mjesec iz džuboksa?

rows.source: The verses share one tune: A, A. The bridge brings new chords and a new tune, B, then the verse returns.
rows.translation: Strofe dijele istu melodiju: A, A. Most donosi nove akorde i novu melodiju, B, pa se strofa vraća.
Tvoj aranžman, od početka do kraja

rows.source: No new ideas: form, intros, tags, texture, fills and your Down by the Riverside. Play it straight through, like a set.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: oblik, uvodi, dodaci, tekstura, ispune i tvoj Down by the Riverside. Odsviraj sve bez prekida, kao nastup.

rows.source: In AABA, how many times does the A tune come?
rows.translation: Koliko se puta melodija A pojavljuje u AABA?

rows.source: From G C E A to new keys, fingerpicking and a stage set
rows.translation: Od G C E A do novih tonaliteta, sviranja prstima i nastupa

rows.source: Hold it, meet G C E A, play your first notes, your first chord and a song.
rows.translation: Drži ga, upoznaj G C E A, odsviraj prve tonove, prvi akord i pjesmu.

rows.source: Rest the body against your chest with the neck pointing left. The string nearest the floor is string 1. It plays the highest open note.
rows.translation: Nasloni tijelo instrumenta na prsa, s vratom usmjerenim ulijevo. Žica najbliža podu je žica 1. Ona daje najviši prazni ton.

rows.source: Strings count up from the floor side: 1, 2, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Žice brojimo od strane prema podu: 1, 2, 3, 4.

rows.source: Pluck string 1 with your thumb and let it ring.
rows.translation: Trzni žicu 1 palcem i pusti je da zvoni.

rows.source: Now string 2, the next one up.
G C E A, the open strings
rows.translation: G C E A, prazne žice

rows.source: From string 4 down to string 1, the open strings are G, C, E, A. Try: Good Cooks Eat Apples.
rows.translation: Od žice 4 do žice 1 prazne žice su G, C, E, A. Probaj: Goran Crta Emine Autobuse.

rows.source: Play strings 4 and 3, one at a time.
rows.translation: Sviraj žice 4 i 3, jednu po jednu.

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: Na većini instrumenata žice daju niže tonove kako ideš gore. Na ukuleleu žica 4 (G) viša je od žice 3 (C). To zovemo povratnim ugađanjem.

rows.source: The high G keeps every chord close together and bright. It is the sweet, ringing sound people know as ukulele.
rows.translation: Visoki G drži tonove svakog akorda blizu i daje im sjaj. To je slatki, zvonki zvuk koji ljudi prepoznaju kao ukulele.

rows.source: String 3, then string 4. Hear the jump up?
rows.translation: Žica 3, pa žica 4. Čuješ skok gore?

rows.source: Which open string plays the lowest note?
rows.translation: Koja prazna žica daje najniži ton?

rows.source: With re-entrant tuning, C on string 3 is the lowest note on the ukulele.
rows.translation: Pri povratnom ugađanju C na žici 3 najniži je ton ukulelea.

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 3: A, B, C.
rows.translation: Prazna žica, prag 2, prag 3: A, B, C.

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3 is D. Fret 1 on string 2 is F. Fret 3 on string 2 is G, the same note as open string 4.
rows.translation: Prag 2 na žici 3 daje D. Prag 1 na žici 2 daje F. Prag 3 na žici 2 daje G, isti ton kao prazna žica 4.

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2 matches which open string?
rows.translation: Prag 3 na žici 2 odgovara kojoj praznoj žici?

rows.source: Both are G. Two places, one note.
rows.translation: Oba su G. Dva mjesta, jedan ton.

rows.source: Open strings, the high G and your first fretted notes. Take it slowly and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Prazne žice, visoki G i prvi tonovi na pragovima. Sviraj polako i pusti svaki ton da zvoni.

rows.source: Name the open strings from 4 to 1.
Which one is the open G string?
rows.translation: Koji je primjer prazna žica G?
Sve četiri prazne žice, od 4 do 1.

rows.source: Your fretted notes: D, F, B, C.
rows.translation: Tvoji tonovi na pragovima: D, F, B, C.

rows.source: C uses your third finger on fret 3 of string 1. The other three strings ring open.
rows.translation: C koristi treći prst na pragu 3 žice 1. Ostale tri žice zvone prazne.

rows.source: Brush down across all four strings with the pad of your thumb, from string 4 to string 1. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Prijeđi dolje preko sve četiri žice jagodicom palca, od žice 4 do žice 1. Opusti zapešće.

rows.source: Which finger plays the C chord?
Your third finger reaches fret 3 without a stretch.
rows.translation: Treći prst doseže prag 3 bez istezanja.

rows.source: Row, Row, Row Your Boat needs only C. Strum it on the two big beats of every bar, then play the tune on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Row, Row, Row Your Boat traži samo C. Sviraj ga na dvije velike dobe svakog takta, pa melodiju na žicama od 1 do 3.

rows.source: The tune's five notes: C and D on string 3, E, F and G on string 2.
rows.translation: Pet tonova melodije: C i D na žici 3, E, F i G na žici 2.

rows.source: A minor, F, G7 and G: with C, the chords behind countless songs.
rows.translation: A-mol, F, G7 i G: uz C, akordi iza bezbroj pjesama.

rows.source: A minor and your first change
Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
rows.translation: Stavi drugi prst na prag 2 žice 4 i sviraj sve četiri žice. A-mol zvuči tamnije od C.

rows.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
rows.translation: Podigni prst koji ne trebaš i postavi novi dok zadnji potez još zvoni. Gledaj unaprijed prema sljedećem akordu.

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na pragu 1 žice 2, drugi prst na pragu 2 žice 4. Žice 3 i 1 zvone prazne.

rows.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
rows.translation: Koji akord dijeli prst s F?

rows.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
rows.translation: Drugi prst u oba hvata stoji na pragu 2 žice 4. Zadrži ga ondje pri promjeni.

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home
First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na pragu 1 žice 2, drugi na pragu 2 žice 3, treći na pragu 2 žice 1. Sviraj sve četiri.

rows.source: A chord that wants to go home
G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: G7 zvuči nedovršeno. Odsviraj C nakon njega i napetost popušta. Zbog te privlačnosti mnoge pjesme stavljaju G7 prije C.

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
rows.translation: Završava li ovo smireno ili ostavlja napetost?

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na pragu 2 žice 3, drugi na pragu 2 žice 1, treći na pragu 3 žice 2. Svini prste da žica 4 zvoni.

rows.source: G and G7 both press which spot?
rows.translation: Koje mjesto pritišću i G i G7?

rows.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
rows.translation: Oba akorda stavljaju prst na prag 2 žice 3. Koristi ga kao oslonac.

rows.source: Which one is G7, the one with more tension?
rows.translation: Koji je G7, onaj s većom napetošću?

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A-mol, F, G7 i G pokrivaju stotine pjesama. Postavi svaki hvat čisto, pa drži ritam dok mijenjaš.

rows.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
rows.translation: Koji akord koristi samo jedan prst?

rows.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
rows.translation: Ravni potezi dolje, dolje-gore i otočki obrazac.

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Sviraj dolje na svaku dobu: 1, 2, 3, 4. Koristi nokat kažiprsta. Kad mijenjaš akorde, ruka se nastavlja kretati.

rows.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
rows.translation: Što ruka treba raditi dok mijenjaš akorde?

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: Zakašnjeli akord bolji je od prekinutog ritma. Nastavi svirati, čak i ako žica zuji.

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Broji 1 i 2 i 3 i 4 i. Sviraj dolje na brojeve, gore na svako i. Ruka se nikad ne prestaje kretati.

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Potezi gore uglavnom zahvaćaju žice 1 i 2. Prijeđi preko njih jagodicom prsta, malo tiše nego dolje.

rows.source: Only at the end of a bar
Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Dolje na 1, dolje-gore na 2, dolje na 3, dolje-gore na 4. Ruka i dalje ide gore nakon 1 i 3, samo promašuje žice.

rows.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
rows.translation: Što ruka radi na i nakon 1?

rows.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
rows.translation: Tihi potez gore drži ruku u ritmu za sljedeći potez dolje.

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Dolje na 1, dolje-gore na 2, preskoči dolje na 3, pa gore, dolje-gore. Izostavljeni potez dolje daje ritmu polet.

rows.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
rows.translation: Koji potez preskačeš u otočkom obrascu?

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: Ruka i dalje ide dolje na 3, samo promašuje žice. Tako sljedeći potez gore ostaje u ritmu.

rows.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
rows.translation: Zadnji potez gore u taktu može biti opušten ili po praznim žicama. Iskoristi ga za prijelaz na novi akord da doba 1 bude čista.

rows.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
rows.translation: Dolje, dolje-gore i otočki obrazac. Neka se ruka kreće, a akordi neka dolaze sami.

rows.source: Which pattern is the island strum?
Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Sviraj melodije ton po ton na žicama od 1 do 3.

rows.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Počni na praznoj žici 3 i penji se preko žica 2 i 1. Svaki je ton unutar prva tri praga.

rows.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
rows.translation: Žica 3 prazna i prag 2, pa žica 2 prazna i prag 1.

rows.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Žica 2 prag 3, pa žica 1: prazna, prag 2, prag 3.

rows.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
rows.translation: Koliko različitih imena tonova ima ljestvica?

rows.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
rows.translation: Od C do C ima osam tonova, ali gornji C ponavlja prvi. Sedam imena, pa kreću iznova.

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Beethoven je ovu melodiju napisao 1824. Uglavnom ide postupno, od tona do tona, na žicama 2 i 3.

rows.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.translation: Početak: E E F G, G F E D.

rows.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Prvi redak završava na D. Gdje završava drugi?

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
rows.translation: Isti početak, drugi kraj. Drugi redak vraća se kući na C.

rows.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
rows.translation: Ova tradicijska melodija skače s C gore na G, pa se vraća dolje ton po ton. Svaki redak završava duljom notom.

rows.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
rows.translation: Prazna žica 3, žica 2 prag 3, prazna žica 1.

rows.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
rows.translation: Ide li ova fraza gore ili dolje?

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
rows.translation: Četvrtinka traje jednu dobu, polovinka dvije, cijela nota četiri. Drži svaku do početka sljedeće.

rows.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Točka dodaje polovicu trajanja note. Polovinka s točkom traje tri dobe; četvrtinka s točkom jednu i pol.

rows.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
rows.translation: Koliko doba traje polovinka s točkom?

rows.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
rows.translation: „Aura Lee” objavljena je 1861., a glazbu je napisao George R. Poulton. Sviraj polako i pusti svaki ton da traje do sljedećega.

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 2 is F sharp, one fret above F. A sharp raises a note by one fret.
rows.translation: Prag 2 na žici 2 daje povišeni F, prag iznad F. Povisilica podiže ton za jedan prag.

rows.source: A sharp sign raises a note by how much?
Watch the note highway and keep your place, even if you miss a note. The beat goes on, so you do too.
rows.translation: Prati traku s notama i zadrži mjesto, čak i ako promašiš ton. Ritam ide dalje, pa i ti.

rows.source: Where is F sharp on string 2?
rows.translation: Gdje je povišeni F na žici 2?

rows.source: D minor, E minor, D, A and E7, then the four-chord song.
rows.translation: D-mol, E-mol, D, A i E7, pa pjesma s četiri akorda.
Dm: F i još jedan prst

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third on fret 2 of string 3, first on fret 1 of string 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Drugi prst na pragu 2 žice 4, treći na pragu 2 žice 3, prvi na pragu 1 žice 2. Žica 1 zvoni prazna.

rows.source: Which chord is D minor closest to?
D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.
rows.translation: D-mol je F s još jednim prstom, na pragu 2 žice 3.

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 1, second on fret 3 of string 2, third on fret 4 of string 3. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na pragu 2 žice 1, drugi na pragu 3 žice 2, treći na pragu 4 žice 3. Žica 4 zvoni prazna.

rows.source: E minor and G both leave which string open?
rows.translation: Koju žicu i E-mol i G ostavljaju praznom?

rows.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Stavi prste 1, 2 i 3 jedan uz drugi na prag 2 žica 4, 3 i 2. Žica 1 zvoni prazna.

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Drugi prst na pragu 2 žice 4, prvi prst na pragu 1 žice 3. Žice 2 i 1 zvone prazne.

rows.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
rows.translation: Koji akord ima tri prsta na istom pragu?

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na pragu 1 žice 4, drugi na pragu 2 žice 3, treći na pragu 2 žice 1. Žica 2 zvoni prazna.

rows.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
rows.translation: G7 vuče prema C. Jednako tako E7 vuče prema A-molu. Odsviraj ih uzastopce i poslušaj razrješenje.

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Numeriraj tonove C ljestvice i možeš imenovati akorde brojem: C je I, G je V, A-mol je vi, F je IV. Taj se redoslijed provlači kroz brojne pjesme.

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Koji je akord IV u tonalitetu C?

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
rows.translation: Broji uz ljestvicu od C: C, D, E, F. F je četvrti ton, pa je F akord IV.

rows.source: Which chord is vi in C?
rows.translation: Koji je akord vi u C?

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
rows.translation: Mali rimski brojevi označavaju molske akorde. Šesti ton C-dura je A.

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
rows.translation: C, A-mol, F, G, G7, D-mol, E-mol, D, A i E7. Prvo čisti hvatovi, pa ujednačeni potezi.

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Koji je akord V u tonalitetu C?

rows.source: Four public-domain songs with melody and chords.
rows.translation: Četiri pjesme iz javne domene s melodijom i akordima.

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster napisao je ovu pjesmu 1848. Broji se na dva: 1 i 2 i. Većina nota su brze osminke.

rows.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.translation: Početak: C D E G, G A G E.

rows.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
rows.translation: Još jedna Fosterova pjesma, iz 1850. Melodija skače između G i E, a kratak dvotonski poziv odgovara svakom retku.

rows.source: G G E G A G E.
rows.translation: G G E G A G E.

rows.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
rows.translation: Kao većina pjesama u C, vraća se kući na C.

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
rows.translation: Broji 1 2 3, 1 2 3, s naglaskom na 1. To je mjera valcera. „Clementine”, prvi put tiskana 1884., njiše se u tri dobe.

rows.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
rows.translation: Žica 2 prag 1, prazna 3, prazna 1, pa žica 1 pragovi 3 i 1.

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na pragu 1 žice 1. Uz F nosi cijelu pjesmu.

rows.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
rows.translation: Ova tradicijska melodija tiskana je najkasnije 1896. Svaki redak završava dugom notom, pa je odbroji prije sljedeće.

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
rows.translation: Prazna 3, žica 2 prag 1, prazna 1, žica 2 prag 3, žica 1 pragovi 1 i 3.

rows.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
rows.translation: Zadnji redak počinje D, povišeni C, C. Kako se ti tonovi kreću?

rows.source: Down one fret at a time
Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
rows.translation: Svaki je ton prag niže na žici 3: prag 2, prag 1, prazna.

rows.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
rows.translation: Kad pratiš pjesmu akordima, melodija živi u tvojoj glavi ili glasu prijatelja. Mijenjaj akorde gdje se melodija oslanja i drži ravnomjerne poteze.

rows.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
rows.translation: Kojim akordom obično završava pjesma u F?

rows.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
rows.translation: Pjesme se vraćaju akordu svog tonaliteta. U F to je F.

rows.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
rows.translation: Četiri pjesme, nekoliko akorda i tri obrasca. Sviraj ih kao mali koncert: odbroji, nastavi, završi snažno.

rows.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
rows.translation: Sniženi B, D7, B-mol i G-mol, tonaliteti G, F i D te prijenos pjesme u svaki tonalitet.

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Položi prst 1 preko žica 2 i 1 na pragu 1. Prst 2 ide na žicu 3, prag 2, a prst 3 na žicu 4, prag 3.

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Koji akord dijeli mjesto prsta 1 na žici 2 s akordom sniženog B?

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: F također stavlja prst 1 na žicu 2, prag 1. Zadrži ga ondje pri promjeni.

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
D7: a barre and one finger
Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Položi prst 1 preko žica 4, 3 i 2 na pragu 2 i stavi prst 2 na žicu 1, prag 3.

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: U G akordi G, C i D7 obavljaju većinu posla, a E-mol dodaje tamniju boju. D7 vuče prema G kao što G7 vuče prema C.

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Položi prst 1 preko žica 3, 2 i 1 na pragu 2, pa dosegni prstom 3 žicu 4, prag 4.

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: Na kojim žicama i D i B-mol pritišću prag 2?

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Oba akorda drže prag 2 na žicama 3 i 2. Mijenjaju se samo vanjske žice.

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: U D akordi D, G i A7 nose pjesmu, a B-mol dodaje tužni akord. A7 koristi samo jedan prst: žica 3, prag 1.

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Akordi pjesme stupnjevi su tonaliteta: I, IV i V. Promijeni tonalitet, brojevi ostaju. U C to su C, F i G7; u G su G, C i D7; u F su F, sniženi B i C7.

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Koji je akord IV u tonalitetu F?

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Broji od F: F, G, A, sniženi B. Četvrti je ton sniženi B.

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Ako je pjesma previsoka ili preniska za pjevanje, prebaci je u drugi tonalitet. Isti brojevi, ista pjesma, samo bolje odgovara glasu.

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Koji je akord V u tonalitetu D?

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Broji od D: D, E, povišeni F, G, A. A je peti ton, pa je A7 akord V.

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Prst 2 na žici 3, pragu 2, prst 3 na žici 2, pragu 3 i prst 1 na žici 1, pragu 1. Žica 4 zvoni prazna.

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: Obitelj D-mola čine D-mol, G-mol i A7. A7 vuče kući u D-mol kao što E7 vuče u A-mol.

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: sniženi B, D7, B-mol i G-mol te tonaliteti C, G, F i D. Prvo čisti hvatovi, pa ujednačen potez.

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Koji je akord V u tonalitetu G?

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Prigušeni udar, otočki obrazac s naglaskom na slabim dobama, swing i ragtime akordi, naglasci 3-3-2 i valcer.

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Prigušeni udar odmah se zaustavlja. Sviraj dolje i istodobno spusti rub dlana na žice: kratak, suh klik poput malog bubnja.

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Sviraj dolje na 1, prigušeni udar na 2, dolje-gore na 3, prigušeni udar na 4. Udari dolaze gdje bubnjar udara mali bubanj.
Na koje dobe dolaze prigušeni udari?

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: Dva i četiri su naglašene slabe dobe, gdje svira mali bubanj. Prigušeni udar ondje daje potezu snagu bubnja.

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Uzmi otočki obrazac D, DU, UDU i pretvori potez dolje na 2 u prigušeni udar. Ritam ostaje isti, a slabe dobe dobivaju naglasak.

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Koji potez u ovom obrascu postaje prigušeni udar?

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Doba 1 zvoni, doba 2 klikne. Sve ostalo ostaje kao u otočkom obrascu.

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Swing dijeli svaku dobu nejednako: dugo dolje, pa kratko gore. Izgovaraj duu-ba, duu-ba dok sviraš. To je njihanje starih melodija za ukulele.

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7, pa kući na C. Svaki septakord vuče prema sljedećem, mali lanac napetosti. Prije stoljeća pokretao je bezbroj pjesama.

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Prema kojem akordu D7 ovdje vuče?

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 vodi u G, a G7 kući u C. Svaki akord priprema sljedeći.

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Sviraj ravne osminke dolje-gore, ali tri naglasi: 1, i nakon 2 te 4. Naglasci su udaljeni 3, 3 i 2 osminke.

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Broji 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 kroz osam osminki takta. Svaki 1 je naglasak.

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: Podijeljeni potez Georgea Formbyja na bendžo-ukuleleu stavlja jake poteze na ista tri mjesta, uz pojedinačne žice između. Prvo svladaj naglaske.

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: U trodobnoj mjeri sviraj dolje na 1, pa dolje-gore na 2 i na 3: D, DU, DU. Naglasi 1 da se njihanje jasno čuje.

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Koliko poteza puni ovaj trodobni takt?

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Dolje na 1, pa dolje-gore na 2 i na 3: jedan plus dva plus dva.

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: prigušeni udari, otočki obrazac s njima, swing, naglasci 3-3-2 i valcer. Neka se ruka kreće, a naglasci govore.

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: U swing potezu svaka se doba dijeli na…
Sviranje prstima i melodija u akordima

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Prst po žici, tekući obrasci, izmjenični palac i melodija izvučena iz vlastitih akorda.

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Nasloni palac na žicu 4, kažiprst na žicu 3, srednji prst na žicu 2 i prstenjak na žicu 1. Svaki trza samo svoju žicu.

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Palac, kažiprst, srednji prst, prstenjak: žice 4, 3, 2 i 1.

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Palac na 4, kažiprst na 3, srednji na 2, prstenjak na 1: jedan prst po žici.

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Budući da je žica 4 visoki G, obrazac ide cik-cak: visoko, nisko, pa uspon. Taj sjaj zvuk je ukulelea sviranog prstima.

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A-mol, F, C, G7, u osminkama

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Trzaj žice 4, 3, 2 i 1, pa natrag 2 i 3: palac, kažiprst, srednji, prstenjak, srednji, kažiprst. Šest tonova puni trodobni takt.

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Nakon što prstenjak trzne žicu 1, koji prst slijedi?

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Obrazac se okreće na vrhu: prstenjak na žici 1, pa srednji na 2 i kažiprst na 3.

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Postavi novi akord kad palac počinje novi takt. Prsti nastavljaju obrazac; mijenja se samo hvat ispod njih.

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Sada palac izmjenjuje žice 3 i 4 na dobe, dok prsti trzaju žice 2 i 1 između. To je ukulele inačica Travisova stila.

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Što palac radi u ovom obrascu?

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Palac drži puls, ton na svaku dobu, dok prsti ispunjavaju praznine.

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: Kod melodije u akordima ruka na vratu drži akord, a ti iz njega trzaš melodiju. Drži F i C, F i A već su ti pod prstima.

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Drži F: prazna žica 3, žica 2 na pragu 1, prazna žica 1. Tako počinje Amazing Grace.

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Kad melodija izađe iz akorda, dosegni ton slobodnim prstom. Uz F prst 3 svira G na žici 2, pragu 3, pa se diže kad se melodija vrati.

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.translation: Gdje je D u melodiji uz akord sniženog B?

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: U hvatu sniženog B prst 2 već drži D na žici 3, pragu 2. Melodija prolazi ravno kroz akord.

rows.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
rows.translation: Razloženi akordi između strofa i melodija unutar akorda. Melodija je himan New Britain, tiskan 1829., uz riječi Johna Newtona.

rows.source: Why does the intro's last bar end on a long note?
rows.translation: Zašto zadnji takt uvoda završava dugom notom?

rows.source: To leave room for the pickup
The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
