rows.translation: Strofa počinje dobu ranije, svojim predtaktom. Duga zadnja nota ostavlja tu dobu slobodnom.

rows.source: No new ideas: one finger per string, the out-and-back roll, the alternating thumb and the melody inside the chord.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: prst po žici, obrazac tamo-natrag, izmjenični palac i melodija unutar akorda.

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring play which strings?
rows.translation: Koje žice sviraju palac, kažiprst, srednji prst i prstenjak?

rows.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
rows.translation: Četiri pjesme iz javne domene u aranžmanu za ukulele i kako povesti publiku kroz njih.

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, prvi put tiskan 1918., stvoren je za zajedničko pjevanje. Na ukuleleu je u G, uz G, C i D7 te gospel povišeni A na žici 1, pragu 1.

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, povišeni A, B, pa A i G.

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp tiskao je ovu englesku baladu 1906. U F koristi F, sniženi B, C i C7, G-mol i D-mol, često dva akorda po taktu. Trzaj akorde između strofa i pusti ih da zvone.

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: prazna žica 3, F na pragu 1 dvaput, G na pragu 3, pa prazni A.

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Mnogi taktovi ovdje mijenjaju akord na polovici. Broji strofu u polovicama od dvije dobe, po akord svaka, i mijenjaj na svaki drugi klik.

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Prije prvog poteza broji naglas u tempu pjesme: jedan, dva, tri, četiri. Svi počinju zajedno, brzinom koju postaviš.

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Promašiš akord? Nastavi svirati i uhvati sljedeći. Prostorija puna pjevača prati ritam, ne svaki ton.

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Promjena usred pjesme pođe krivo. Što sada?

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.translation: Nastavi svirati i uhvati sljedeći akord

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Ritam nosi sve. Ako moraš, preskoči akord, ali nikad ritam.

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Prije zadnjeg retka kimni ili reci zadnji put. Malo uspori završni redak i pusti zadnji akord da zvoni.

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone tiskana je 1876. To je valcer: naglasi dobu 1 i pusti melodiju da se njiše. U F koristi F, G-mol, C7, D-mol i G7.

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: prazna žica 3, F na pragu 1 četiri puta, prazni A, pa natrag na F.

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Koji akord najjače vuče natrag prema F?

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: C7 je akord V u F. Njegova septima vuče ravno kući.

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Ova veslačka pjesma je u šestosminskoj mjeri: šest brzih brojanja po taktu koje osjećaš kao dva velika njihaja. Broji 1 2 3, 4 5 6 i naglasi 1 i 4.

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.translation: Gdje su velike dobe u šestosminskoj mjeri?

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Šest osminki grupira se u dvije trojke: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. Prva u svakoj trojci nosi njihaj.

rows.source: No new ideas: four songs, counted in, kept going and finished clean. Play them back to back like a short concert.
rows.translation: Ništa novo: četiri pjesme, s odbrojanim početkom, bez stajanja i s čistim krajem. Sviraj ih jednu za drugom kao kratak koncert.

rows.source: From open strings to walking lines and grooves
rows.translation: Od praznih žica do hodajućih basova i ritmova

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Upoznaj E A D G, trzaj dvama prstima, odsviraj prve tonove i pjesmu.

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: Najdeblja žica daje najniži ton. Dok sviraš, najbliža je tvom licu. Zovemo je žica 4.

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.translation: Žice brojimo od najtanje (1) do najdeblje (4).

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: Od debele do tanke: E, A, D, G. Odgovaraju četirima najnižim žicama gitare, oktavu niže. Probaj: Ema Anu Daruje Gitarom.

rows.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.
rows.translation: Trzaj jagodicama kažiprsta i srednjeg prsta, naizmjence. Nasloni palac na magnet ili na žicu 4.

rows.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
rows.translation: Trzaj poprijeko kroz žicu, ne gore i od nje. Prst se zaustavlja na sljedećoj debljoj žici. Taj trzaj s osloncem zvuči puno i snažno.

rows.source: Where does your finger stop after a rest stroke?
rows.translation: Gdje se prst zaustavlja nakon trzaja s osloncem?

rows.source: In the air above the strings
Pulling through to the next string keeps the motion small and the tone strong.
rows.translation: Povlačenje do sljedeće žice zadržava malen pokret i snažan ton.

rows.source: Open E, fret 3, open A, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prazni E, prag 3, prazni A, prag 3.

rows.source: Open strings, two-finger plucking and your first fretted notes. Keep your fingers taking turns and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Prazne žice, trzanje dvama prstima i prvi tonovi na pragovima. Neka se prsti izmjenjuju i pusti svaki ton da zvoni.

rows.source: Which one is the open E string?
rows.translation: Koji je primjer prazna žica E?

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: B at fret 2 on string 3, open A, and G at fret 3 on string 4. Second finger for B, third for G.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb traži tri tona: B na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni A i G na pragu 3 žice 4. Drugi prst za B, treći za G.

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's B.
rows.translation: Žica 3, prag 2, drugi prst. To je B.

rows.source: B A G A B B B: string 3, then G on string 4.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: žica 3, pa G na žici 4.

rows.source: Play the root of each chord and lock in with the beat.
rows.translation: Sviraj osnovni ton svakog akorda i čvrsto prati dobe.

rows.source: Every chord is built on one note, its root. The root of an A chord is A. Bass players play roots so the band knows where home is.
rows.translation: Svaki akord gradi se na jednom tonu, osnovnom tonu. Osnovni ton akorda A je A. Basisti sviraju osnovne tonove da sastav zna gdje je dom.

rows.source: What is the root of a D chord?
rows.translation: Koji je osnovni ton akorda D?

rows.source: Root or not? Listen to the lowest note.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton ili ne? Slušaj najniži ton.

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E: all open strings.
rows.translation: Osnovni tonovi A, D i E: sve prazne žice.

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E
rows.translation: Osnovni tonovi A, D i E

rows.source: Bass and kick drum land together. Aim for the exact moment of the click, not just near it. Timbre shows if you're early or late.
rows.translation: Bas i veliki bubanj dolaze zajedno. Ciljaj točan trenutak klika, ne samo blizu njega. Timbre pokazuje uraniš li ili zakasniš.

rows.source: You keep landing a little after the click. What helps?
rows.translation: Stalno dolaziš malo nakon klika. Što pomaže?

rows.source: Feel the beat coming and pluck a touch earlier
rows.translation: Osjeti dolazak dobe i trzni malo ranije

rows.source: Your finger needs a moment to move. Start the pluck slightly earlier so the note speaks right on the beat.
rows.translation: Prstu treba trenutak za pokret. Počni trzaj malo ranije da ton zazvuči točno na dobu.

rows.source: A rest is a beat of silence. Stop the string by touching it lightly with a free finger, so the rest is as clean as the note.
rows.translation: Stanka je doba tišine. Zaustavi žicu laganim dodirom slobodnog prsta da stanka bude čista kao ton.

rows.source: How do you stop a ringing string?
Touch it lightly with a free finger
Muting is half of bass playing. Rest a finger lightly on the string to silence it.
rows.translation: Prigušivanje je pola sviranja basa. Lagano nasloni prst na žicu da je utišaš.

rows.source: A chord chart tells you which chord is coming. Play its root on every beat until the chart changes.
rows.translation: Zapis akorda govori koji akord dolazi. Sviraj njegov osnovni ton na svaku dobu dok se akord ne promijeni.

rows.source: G on string 4 fret 3, C on string 3 fret 3, then open D.
rows.translation: G na žici 4 pragu 3, C na žici 3 pragu 3, pa prazni D.

rows.source: The chart says C. Which note do you play?
rows.translation: U zapisu piše C. Koji ton sviraš?

rows.source: Roots on the beat, clean rests and changes right on time. Keep your plucking fingers taking turns the whole way.
rows.translation: Osnovni tonovi na dobu, čiste stanke i pravodobne promjene. Trzaji prstiju neka se cijelo vrijeme izmjenjuju.

rows.source: What is the root of an E chord?
rows.translation: Koji je osnovni ton akorda E?

rows.source: Every note from fret 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3, and the major scale shape.
rows.translation: Svaki ton od praga 0 do 5 na žicama 4 i 3 te hvat durske ljestvice.

rows.source: E to A on one string
rows.translation: Od E do A na jednoj žici

rows.source: On string 4, each fret is one note higher: E, F, F sharp, G, G sharp, then A at fret 5. Fret 5 sounds the same as open string 3.
rows.translation: Na žici 4 svaki prag daje viši ton: E, F, povišeni F, G, povišeni G, pa A na pragu 5. Prag 5 zvuči isto kao prazna žica 3.

rows.source: Which fret on string 4 matches open string 3?
rows.translation: Koji prag na žici 4 odgovara praznoj žici 3?

rows.source: Both are A. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Oba su A. Svaka žica ugođena je prema pragu 5 žice ispod nje.
Od A do D na žici 3

rows.source: String 3 works the same way: A, B flat, B, C, C sharp, then D at fret 5. Fret 5 matches open string 2.
rows.translation: Žica 3 radi jednako: A, sniženi B, B, C, povišeni C, pa D na pragu 5. Prag 5 odgovara praznoj žici 2.
Koji je ton na pragu 3 žice 3?

rows.source: A on fret 5 of string 4 sounds the same as open string 3. Open strings ring longer; fretted notes are easier to stop and shape.
rows.translation: A na pragu 5 žice 4 zvuči isto kao prazna žica 3. Prazne žice dulje zvone; tonove na pragovima lakše je zaustaviti i oblikovati.

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4, then open string 3.
rows.translation: Prag 5 na žici 4, pa prazna žica 3.

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 3, then open string 2.
rows.translation: Prag 5 na žici 3, pa prazna žica 2.

rows.source: Which fret on string 3 matches open string 2?
rows.translation: Koji prag na žici 3 odgovara praznoj žici 2?

rows.source: Both are D. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Oba su D. Svaka žica ugođena je prema pragu 5 žice ispod nje.

rows.source: Let each finger cover one fret: index on fret 2, middle on 3, ring on 4, little on 5. Your thumb rests behind the neck, across from your middle finger.
rows.translation: Neka svaki prst pokriva jedan prag: kažiprst 2, srednji 3, prstenjak 4, mali 5. Palac je iza vrata, nasuprot srednjem prstu.

rows.source: Start on G, fret 3 of string 4, with your middle finger. Climb across three strings: G A B C D E F sharp G. The same shape works from any root.
rows.translation: Počni od G na pragu 3 žice 4, srednjim prstom. Penji se preko triju žica: G A B C D E povišeni F G. Isti hvat radi od svakog osnovnog tona.

rows.source: Middle, little; then index, middle on string 3.
rows.translation: Srednji, mali; pa kažiprst, srednji na žici 3.

rows.source: Little finger; then index, ring, little on string 2.
rows.translation: Mali prst; pa kažiprst, prstenjak, mali na žici 2.

rows.source: You move the shape so it starts on fret 5 of string 4. Which scale is it now?
rows.translation: Pomakneš hvat da počinje na pragu 5 žice 4. Koja je to sada ljestvica?

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4 is A, so the same shape plays A major.
rows.translation: Prag 5 na žici 4 daje A, pa isti hvat svira A-dur.

rows.source: Ode to Joy works on bass too. Play it in G on strings 4 and 3, with your hand in the scale shape: index on fret 2.
rows.translation: Oda radosti radi i na basu. Sviraj je u G na žicama 4 i 3, s rukom u hvatu ljestvice: kažiprst na pragu 2.

rows.source: The first line ends on A. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Prvi redak završava na A. Gdje završava drugi?

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to G.
rows.translation: Isti početak, drugi kraj. Drugi redak vraća se kući na G.

rows.source: Name it, find it, play it
Frets 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3 give you every note from E up to D. Say each note's name as you play it.
rows.translation: Pragovi od 0 do 5 na žicama 4 i 3 daju sve tonove od E do D. Izgovaraj ime svakog tona dok ga sviraš.
Koji je ton na pragu 3 žice 4?

rows.source: F, A, B, D on strings 4 and 3.
rows.translation: F, A, B, D na žicama 4 i 3.

rows.source: Outline chords with the root, its fifth and its octave.
rows.translation: Ocrtaj akorde osnovnim tonom, njegovom kvintom i oktavom.

rows.source: One string over, two frets up
The fifth of a chord sits on the next thinner string, two frets higher than the root. For open A, that's fret 2 of string 2: E.
rows.translation: Kvinta akorda nalazi se na sljedećoj tanjoj žici, dva praga iznad osnovnog tona. Za prazni A to je prag 2 žice 2: E.

rows.source: What is the fifth of D?
Count up the D major scale: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note.
rows.translation: Broji uz D-dursku ljestvicu: D, E, povišeni F, G, A. A je peti ton.
Osnovni ton i kvinta uz akorde

rows.source: Play the root on beat 1 and the fifth on beat 3. Two notes per bar outline the whole chord and leave room for the drums.
rows.translation: Sviraj osnovni ton na dobu 1, a kvintu na dobu 3. Dva tona po taktu ocrtavaju cijeli akord i ostavljaju prostor bubnjevima.

rows.source: In a root-fifth pattern, which note lands on beat 1?
rows.translation: Koji ton dolazi na dobu 1 u obrascu osnovni ton-kvinta?

rows.source: The root on beat 1 tells everyone which chord they're in.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton na dobu 1 svima govori u kojem su akordu.

rows.source: Two strings over, two frets up
rows.translation: Dvije žice dalje, dva praga više

rows.source: The octave is the same note name, higher. From a root on string 4 or 3, go two strings thinner and two frets up. Open A becomes fret 2 of string 1.
rows.translation: Oktava je isto ime tona, više. Od osnovnog tona na žici 4 ili 3 idi dvije žice prema tanjima i dva praga gore. Prazni A postaje prag 2 žice 1.

rows.source: G is on fret 3 of string 4. Where is the G an octave higher?
rows.translation: G je na pragu 3 žice 4. Gdje je G oktavu više?

rows.source: Two strings thinner, two frets up: fret 5 of string 2. Open string 1 is the same G.
rows.translation: Dvije žice prema tanjima, dva praga gore: prag 5 žice 2. Prazna žica 1 isti je G.

rows.source: Root, fifth, octave, then back to the fifth. Over A: open string 3, fret 2 of string 2, fret 2 of string 1. It fits any major or minor chord.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton, kvinta, oktava, pa natrag na kvintu. Uz A: prazna žica 3, prag 2 žice 2, prag 2 žice 1. Pristaje svakom durskom ili molskom akordu.

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 2, string 1 fret 2, back to string 2.
rows.translation: Prazna 3, žica 2 prag 2, žica 1 prag 2, natrag na žicu 2.

rows.source: Move it to a fretted root
From G on fret 3 of string 4, use your index finger for the root and your ring finger for the fifth and octave, both on fret 5.
rows.translation: Od G na pragu 3 žice 4 koristi kažiprst za osnovni ton, a prstenjak za kvintu i oktavu, obje na pragu 5.

rows.source: Index on the root, ring finger on fret 5 for the fifth and the octave.
rows.translation: Kažiprst na osnovni ton, prstenjak na prag 5 za kvintu i oktavu.

rows.source: You slide the shape so the root is fret 3 of string 3. Which chord is it now?
rows.translation: Klizneš hvatom tako da osnovni ton bude prag 3 žice 3. Koji je sada akord?

rows.source: Fret 3 of string 3 is C. Same shape, new root.
rows.translation: Prag 3 žice 3 daje C. Isti hvat, novi osnovni ton.

rows.source: Root on the beat, fifth and octave to fill the bar. Keep the root strong and the other notes even.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton na dobu, kvinta i oktava za ispunu takta. Drži osnovni ton snažnim, a ostale ujednačenima.

rows.source: What is the fifth of E?
The 12-bar blues, walking lines and chromatic approach notes.
rows.translation: Blues od 12 taktova, hodajuće dionice i kromatski prilazni tonovi.

rows.source: The blues repeats a 12-bar loop: four bars of A, two of D, two of A, then E, D, A, E. Count the bars and you always know where you are.
rows.translation: Blues ponavlja petlju od 12 taktova: četiri takta A, dva D, dva A, pa E, D, A, E. Broji taktove i uvijek znaš gdje si.

rows.source: How many bars of A open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Koliko taktova A otvara blues od 12 taktova?

rows.source: Bars 9 to 12 go E, D, A, E. The E in bar 12 turns the loop around.
rows.translation: Taktovi od 9 do 12 idu E, D, A, E. E u taktu 12 okreće petlju.

rows.source: A new note on every beat
A walking bass line plays a new note on every beat. Start with root, third, fifth, sixth: over A that's A, C sharp, E, F sharp.
rows.translation: Hodajući bas svira novi ton na svaku dobu. Počni osnovnim tonom, tercom, kvintom, sekstom: uz A to su A, povišeni C, E, povišeni F.

rows.source: Open 3, fret 4; then string 2, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Prazna 3, prag 4; pa žica 2, pragovi 2 i 4.

rows.source: What makes a bass line walk?
Open 2, fret 4; then string 1, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Prazna 2, prag 4; pa žica 1, pragovi 2 i 4.
Hodajući bas u D i E

rows.source: On beat 4, play a note one fret away from the next root. It pulls the ear forward, so the change feels like it arrives.
rows.translation: Na dobu 4 sviraj ton prag udaljen od sljedećeg osnovnog tona. Vuče uho naprijed, pa promjena zvuči kao dolazak.

rows.source: String 3 fret 4, then open string 2: one fret up into D.
rows.translation: Žica 3 prag 4, pa prazna žica 2: prag gore u D.

rows.source: You're heading to D in the next bar. Which note on beat 4 pulls best?
rows.translation: U sljedećem taktu ideš na D. Koji ton na dobu 4 najbolje vuče?

rows.source: C sharp is one fret below D. A half step slides right into the new root.
rows.translation: Povišeni C je prag ispod D. Poluton klizi ravno u novi osnovni ton.

rows.source: Put the walk on the form
Same 12 bars, now with a walking line. Bars that lead into a new chord end on an approach note.
rows.translation: Istih 12 taktova, sada s hodajućom dionicom. Taktovi koji vode u novi akord završavaju prilaznim tonom.

rows.source: Why does bar 12 end on G sharp?
rows.translation: Zašto takt 12 završava na povišenom G?
To je osnovni ton akorda E

rows.source: It leads back to A at the top
rows.translation: Vodi natrag na A na početku

rows.source: Bar 12 turns the form around. G sharp sits one fret below A, the chord that starts the next time through.
rows.translation: Takt 12 vraća oblik na početak. Povišeni G je prag ispod A, akorda koji počinje sljedeći krug.
Blues s hodajućim basom u A

rows.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.
rows.translation: Blues od 12 taktova radi u svakom tonalitetu. U E akordi su E, A i B. Hodaj osnovnim tonovima, tercama, kvintama i sekstama te pripremi svaku promjenu.

rows.source: In the key of E, which chord comes in bar 9?
rows.translation: Koji akord u tonalitetu E dolazi u taktu 9?

rows.source: String 3 fret 2; string 2 frets 1 and 4; string 1 fret 1.
rows.translation: Žica 3 prag 2; žica 2 pragovi 1 i 4; žica 1 prag 1.
Blues s hodajućim basom u E

rows.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
rows.translation: Rock u osminkama, punktirani ritmovi, prostor i dionica u stilu Motowna.

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
rows.translation: Broji 1 i 2 i 3 i 4 i. Sviraj ton na svaki broj i i, izmjenjujući prste. Cilj je jednaka glasnoća.

rows.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
rows.translation: Osminke ti počinju žuriti. Što pomaže?

rows.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Četvrtinka s točkom traje jednu i pol dobu. Sviraj na 1, drži kroz 2, pa sviraj na i nakon 2, zatim na 3 i 4.

rows.source: Long-short on A, D and E
rows.translation: Dugo-kratko na A, D i E

rows.source: How long does a dotted quarter note last?
Silence is part of the groove
Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
rows.translation: Kratki tonovi s čistim stankama daju dionici polet. Popusti prst na pragu, i dalje dodirujući žicu, da svaki ton zaustaviš točno na vrijeme.

rows.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
rows.translation: Kako čisto zaustavljaš ton na pragu?

rows.source: Ease off but keep touching it
Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
rows.translation: Otpusti pritisak dok prst ostaje na žici. Ton staje bez zujanja.

rows.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
rows.translation: Živahno, ali uvijek čvrsto u ritmu

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.translation: Basovske dionice ere Motowna mnogo su se kretale: tonovi akorda, prilazi sljedećem akordu i naglasci između doba. Ova je dionica nova, napisana u tom duhu.

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.translation: Prvi takt: C, E, G, pa sniženi B koji teži prema A.

rows.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
rows.translation: Što sniženi B radi na kraju takta 1?

rows.source: Leads down a fret into A
It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.translation: To je prilazni ton, prag iznad A, osnovnog tona sljedećeg akorda. Klizno te vodi u sljedeći takt.

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.translation: Osminke, punktirani ritmovi i pokretna dionica. Drži se klika, izmjenjuj prste i uživaj u ritmu.

rows.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
rows.translation: Koja brojanja dobivaju ton u osminskom obrascu?

rows.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
rows.translation: Gudalom i prstima do čiste intonacije i tradicijskih melodija

rows.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Drži je, sviraj gudalom, ugodi je, odsviraj prazne žice i prvu pjesmu.
Četiri žice, od niske do visoke

rows.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Kad je violina pod bradom, žice idu G, D, A, E slijeva nadesno. G je najdeblja i najniža. E je najtanja i najviša, a zovemo je žica 1.

rows.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
rows.translation: Kobilica je tanki drveni luk koji podiže žice. Drži je samo pritisak žica. Ako se počne naginjati, zamoli učitelja ili servis da je poravna.

rows.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
rows.translation: E je najtanja i najviša žica. Žice brojimo od E (1) do G (4).

rows.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
rows.translation: Prije gudala trzaj prstom. Nasloni desni palac na rub hvataljke i povuci žicu prvim prstom. Svirači to zovu pizzicato.

rows.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Položi violinu u krilo kao malu gitaru. Trzni žicu 2, A, i pusti je da zvoni.

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
rows.translation: Stavi donji rub violine na lijevu ključnu kost i okreni glavu da čeljust sjedne na podbradak. Drži je težina glave. Bez stiskanja.

rows.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
rows.translation: Usmjeri puž naprijed i ulijevo, približno paralelno s podom. Lijeva ruka podupire vrat, palac nasuprot prvom prstu. Zapešće drži ravno i opušteno.

rows.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
rows.translation: Neka glava počiva na podbratku. Stisnuta ruka ili podignuto rame stvaraju napetost, a ona kvari intonaciju.

rows.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
rows.translation: Drži violinu na mjestu i trzni žicu D, žicu 3.

rows.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
rows.translation: Drveni štap ide od žabice, gdje ga držiš, do vrha. Između je napeta konjska dlaka. Zategni vijak dok olovka jedva stane između dlake i štapa.

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
rows.translation: Savij palac i postavi vrh ondje gdje žabica dodiruje štap. Prebaci prste preko štapa, a mali prst savijeno osloni na vrh. Cijela ruka neka bude opuštena.

rows.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
rows.translation: Savijen, na spoju žabice i štapa

rows.source: Flat on top of the stick
A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
rows.translation: Savijen palac kod žabice omogućuje opuštenu ruku i ravnotežu gudala.

rows.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
rows.translation: Čista dlaka klizi po žici bez zvuka. Prije sviranja nekoliko puta protrljaj kolofonij duž dlake. Tanak sloj je dovoljan.

rows.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Stavi gudalo na žicu A, na pola puta između kobilice i hvataljke. Polako ga povuci udesno.

rows.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Sada žicu D. Malo podigni lakat, pa polako povuci.

rows.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.translation: Od niskog do visokog: G, D, A, E. Svaka žica je pet slovnih mjesta iznad prethodne, interval koji zovemo kvinta. Probaj: Goran Daruje Ani Ekran.

rows.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
rows.translation: Desni lakat određuje koju žicu gudalo svira. Podigni ga za G, spusti za E. Svaka žica ima svoju razinu, poput stepenica.

rows.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
rows.translation: Sviraj gudalom žicu G, pa D. Lakat je najviši za G.

rows.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
rows.translation: Sada A, pa E. Spusti lakat po jednu razinu za svaku.

rows.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
rows.translation: Žica G je najviše ulijevo, pa podižeš ruku da je dosegneš. E traži najnižu ruku.

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
rows.translation: Orkestri ugađaju prema A. Timbre pokazuje odstupanje svake žice u centima; 100 centi čini poluton, najmanji korak na klaviru. Ugodi A, pa D, G i E.

rows.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
rows.translation: Mali vijci na žičnjaku služe za fino ugađanje. Okreni u smjeru kazaljke na satu za viši ton, suprotno za niži. Četvrtina okreta je dosta.

rows.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Žica je malo preniska. Što radiš?
Okreni fini ugađač u smjeru kazaljke na satu
Okreni fini ugađač suprotno kazaljci na satu

rows.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
rows.translation: Prenisko znači niži ton od cilja. Okret u smjeru kazaljke na satu zateže žicu i povisuje ton.

rows.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
rows.translation: Ako fini ugađač dođe do kraja, koristi čiviju. Malo je okreni i guraj unutra da drži. Ako je žica jako raštimana, zamoli učitelja; čivije mogu kliznuti.

rows.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
rows.translation: Ugodi žicu A, pa je sviraj gudalom i drži ton ravnim.

rows.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Sada D, G i E. Ugodi svaku, pa je sviraj gudalom i drži ton.

rows.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Violina na ključnoj kosti, opušten hvat gudala, gudalo na pola puta između kobilice i hvataljke. Sada odsviraj sve iz ove cjeline.

rows.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
rows.translation: Sviraj gudalom svaku praznu žicu od visoke do niske. Drži svaki ton ravnim.

rows.source: Which string do you tune first?
Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
rows.translation: Orkestri ugađaju prema A, pa kreni od njega i zatim ugodi ostale.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb živi na žici A: prazni A, prvi prst cijeli ton više za B, drugi prst još cijeli ton više za povišeni C. Prvo trzaj, pa sviraj gudalom.

rows.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na žici A, cijeli ton više. To je B.

rows.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
rows.translation: Drugi prst cijeli ton iznad prvog. To je povišeni C.

rows.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
rows.translation: Povišeni C, B, A, B, pa povišeni C triput.

rows.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
rows.translation: Dugi, ravnomjerni potezi, čisti prijelazi između žica i prvi ritmovi.

rows.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
rows.translation: Potez dolje vuče gudalo udesno, od žabice prema vrhu. Potez gore gura ga natrag ulijevo. U notama oznaka za dolje nalikuje stoliću, a za gore slovu V.

rows.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
rows.translation: Kamo se kreće potez gudalom dolje?

rows.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
rows.translation: Sviraj na pola puta između kobilice i kraja hvataljke. Drži gudalo paralelno s kobilicom, poput vlaka na tračnicama.

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Jedan spor potez dolje, pa jedan spor potez gore na A. Drži zvuk ujednačenim do kraja.

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
rows.translation: Četvrtinka traje jednu dobu. Brze note trebaju manje gudala, pa koristi srednju polovicu i drži svaki potez jednake duljine.

rows.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
rows.translation: Polovinka traje dvije dobe. Koristi dulji, sporiji potez da zvuk ne oslabi na drugoj dobi.

rows.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
rows.translation: Polovinka traje dvostruko dulje, pa dobiva dulji, sporiji potez.

rows.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
rows.translation: Za prijelaz između žica mijenjaj razinu laktom, ne zapešćem. Stigni na novu razinu tik prije promjene smjera gudala.

rows.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: A, E, A, E. Neka se lakat njiše između dviju razina.

rows.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
rows.translation: Što premješta gudalo na novu žicu?

rows.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Prijelaz iz G u A preskače žicu D, pa lakat radi veći pokret. Putuj glatko i ne dopusti da srednja žica zazvuči.

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
rows.translation: Osminka traje pola dobe, pa dvije stanu u svaku dobu. Koristi male, brze poteze blizu sredine gudala.

rows.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Koliko osminki stane u jednu dobu?

rows.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
rows.translation: Sada ih pomiješaj: četvrtinka, dvije osminke, pa dvije četvrtinke. Tradicijski violinisti vole ovaj ritam. Prvo ga izgovori: dugo, kratko-kratko, dugo, dugo.

rows.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
rows.translation: Ravni potezi na mjestu dodira, prijelazi vođeni laktom i ravnomjerni ritmovi. Evo spoja svih triju.
Na pola puta između kobilice i hvataljke

rows.source: Right on top of the bridge
Over the end of the fingerboard
Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
rows.translation: Postavi prste 1, 2 i 3, sviraj A-dursku ljestvicu i prvu pjesmu.

rows.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
rows.translation: Tvoj instrument nema pragove, pa sluh postavlja svaki ton. Mnogi svirači za učenje lijepe tanke trakice na hvataljku kao vodič.

rows.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
rows.translation: Stavi vrh prvog prsta na žicu A kod prve trakice. To je B, cijeli ton iznad A; cijeli ton su dva polutona. Pritisni dok žica ne dotakne hvataljku.

rows.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Prazni A, pa B prvim prstom. Drži B dok ne postane intonacijski čist.

rows.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
rows.translation: Timbre prihvaća ton unutar 30 centi, otprilike trećine polutona. Ako je previsok, pomakni prst prema pužu. Ako je prenizak, prema kobilici.

rows.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
rows.translation: B, prazni A, B. Podigni prst i vrati ga na isto mjesto.

rows.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
rows.translation: Prazni A, pa B. Koliki je razmak?

rows.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
rows.translation: Drugi prst svira povišeni C, cijeli ton iznad B, pa ostavi razmak nakon prvog prsta. To mjesto zovemo visoki 2 jer je blizu budućeg mjesta trećeg prsta.

rows.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
rows.translation: A, B, povišeni C. Drži prvi prst na žici dok drugi svira.

rows.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od B do sljedećeg tona: kakav je korak?

rows.source: How far is C sharp above B?
rows.translation: Koliko je povišeni C iznad B?

rows.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
rows.translation: Od B do povišenog C dva su polutona, pa drugi prst ostavlja razmak nakon prvog.

rows.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
rows.translation: B, povišeni C, B, A. Postavi svaki ton čisto prije nego što nastaviš.

rows.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
rows.translation: Treći prst svira D, poluton iznad povišenog C, pa stoji tik uz drugi prst. Na žici A obrazac je 1, pa 2 i 3 zajedno.

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
rows.translation: A, B, povišeni C, D. Zadrži svaki prst na žici dok dodaješ sljedeći.

rows.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
rows.translation: Kad je tvoj D čist, prazna žica D vibrira s njim. Dijele isto slovo, udaljeni osam tonova: oktavu. Slušaj kako violina zvuči punije.

rows.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: D trećim prstom, prazni D, pa opet D trećim prstom. Slušaj rezonanciju.

rows.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
rows.translation: Koji se prsti dodiruju na žici A?

rows.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
rows.translation: Od B do povišenog C cijeli je ton, pa 1 i 2 imaju razmak. Od povišenog C do D poluton je, pa se 2 i 3 dodiruju.

rows.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
rows.translation: Na žici E prvi prst svira povišeni F, visoki drugi povišeni G, a treći A. To je hvat sa žice A, jednu žicu više. Spusti ruku s gudalom na razinu E.

rows.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
rows.translation: E, povišeni F, povišeni G, A. Isti hvat kao na žici A.

rows.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?
rows.translation: Treći prst na E daje A. S čime ga možeš usporediti?

rows.source: The open A string is an octave below, so it rings along when your A is in tune.
rows.translation: Prazna žica A je oktavu niže, pa odzvanja zajedno kad je tvoj A čist.

rows.source: Join the halves: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, then E, F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string. Eight notes, A to A, one shape played twice.
rows.translation: Spoji polovice: A, B, povišeni C, D na žici A, pa E, povišeni F, povišeni G, A na žici E. Osam tonova, od A do A, jedan hvat odsviran dvaput.

rows.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.
rows.translation: Polako uz A-dursku ljestvicu. Prijeđi na E za gornja četiri tona.

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, and E and F sharp on the E string.
rows.translation: Ova francuska melodija iz stogodišnjeg razdoblja koje počinje 1700. koristi samo naučene tonove: A, B, povišeni C, D na žici A te E i povišeni F na žici E.

rows.source: Which finger plays F sharp on the E string?
rows.translation: Kojim prstom sviraš povišeni F na žici E?

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
rows.translation: Cijeli ton, cijeli ton, poluton: to je obrazac na A i E. Postavi svaki ton čisto i pusti prazne žice da odzvanjaju s tobom.

rows.source: Second finger to third: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od drugog do trećeg prsta: kakav je korak?

rows.source: B, C sharp, D, then open D. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: B, povišeni C, D, pa prazni D. Slušaj rezonanciju.

rows.source: Which note does high 2 play on the E string?
rows.translation: Koji ton svira visoki 2 na žici E?

rows.source: F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string, then open A an octave lower.
rows.translation: Povišeni F, povišeni G, A na žici E, pa prazni A oktavu niže.

rows.source: The same finger pattern on two lower strings, D major and three tunes.
rows.translation: Isti prstomet na dvije niže žice, D-dur i tri melodije.

rows.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
rows.translation: Na žici D prvi prst svira E, visoki drugi povišeni F, a treći G. To je obrazac sa žice A, jednu žicu niže. Podigni ruku s gudalom za jednu razinu.

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.
rows.translation: D, E, povišeni F, G. Drugi i treći prst se dodiruju.

rows.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G trećim prstom na žici D oktavu je iznad prazne žice G. Kad je čist, žica G odzvanja zajedno.

rows.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G trećim prstom, prazni G, G trećim prstom. Slušaj rezonanciju.

rows.source: On the D string, which fingers touch?
rows.translation: Koji se prsti dodiruju na žici D?

rows.source: It's the A-string pattern again: whole step, whole step, half step. The half step is between 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Opet obrazac sa žice A: cijeli ton, cijeli ton, poluton. Poluton je između 2 i 3.

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The D major scale is one finger shape played twice.
rows.translation: Sviraj D, E, povišeni F, G na žici D, pa A, B, povišeni C, D na žici A. D-durska ljestvica jedan je prstomet odsviran dvaput.

rows.source: Up the D major scale. Cross to the A string on the fifth note.
rows.translation: Uz D-dursku ljestvicu. Na petom tonu prijeđi na žicu A.

rows.source: Which notes are sharp in D major?
rows.translation: Koji su tonovi povišeni u D-duru?

rows.source: D major has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. Both are high 2.
rows.translation: D-dur ima dvije povisilice, povišeni F i povišeni C. Oba su visoki 2.

rows.source: Lightly Row is an old German children's song. It walks up and down the D major scale on the D and A strings.
rows.translation: Lightly Row stara je njemačka dječja pjesma. Šeta gore i dolje D-durskom ljestvicom na žicama D i A.

rows.source: Which finger plays the F sharps?
First finger on the A string
Third finger on the D string
On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
rows.translation: Na žici G prvi prst svira A, visoki drugi B, a treći C. Opet isti hvat. Podigni ruku s gudalom na najvišu razinu.

rows.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C. Malo pomakni lijevi lakat ispod violine da dosegneš.

rows.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
rows.translation: A prvim prstom na žici G, pa prazna žica A. Isto slovo, razmak oktave.

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C na žici G uz D, E, povišeni F, G na žici D čine G-dur. To je prva oktava dvooktavne ljestvice koju ćeš dovršiti u sljedećoj cjelini.

rows.source: Up the G major scale. Same shape on both strings.
rows.translation: Uz G-dursku ljestvicu. Isti hvat na obje žice.

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
rows.translation: Beethoven je ovu melodiju napisao za Devetu simfoniju 1824. Uglavnom ide postupno, pa tvoji prsti hodaju.

rows.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
rows.translation: Svaki redak završava dugo, kratko, dugo: četvrtinka s točkom, osminka i polovinka. Točka iza note dodaje polovicu njezina trajanja.

rows.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
rows.translation: Ova stara američka violinska melodija nosi ritam koji već sviraš na praznim žicama: dugo, kratko-kratko, dugo, dugo. Svira se na zajedničkim svirkama posvuda.

rows.source: Which string does this tune never use?
rows.translation: Koju žicu ova melodija nikad ne koristi?

rows.source: It lives on the D, A and E strings.
rows.translation: Živi na žicama D, A i E.

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step works on every string so far. Raise your bow arm for the low strings and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Cijeli ton, cijeli ton, poluton zasad radi na svakoj žici. Podigni ruku s gudalom za niske žice i pusti oktave da zvone.

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then A with open A.
rows.translation: Dvije oktavne provjere: G uz prazni G, pa A uz prazni A.

rows.source: In D major, which finger plays C sharp?
rows.translation: Koji prst u D-duru svira povišeni C?

rows.source: Move second finger to change keys: G major in two octaves, A minor and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Pomiči drugi prst za nove tonalitete: G-dur u dvije oktave, A-mol i tradicijske violinske melodije.

rows.source: Slide second finger back until it touches first. On the A string that's C natural, a half step below C sharp. Players call it low 2.
rows.translation: Klizni drugim prstom natrag dok ne dotakne prvi. Na žici A to je prirodni C, poluton ispod povišenog C. Svirači to zovu niski 2.

rows.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D. Drugi prst dodiruje prvi; ostavi razmak prije trećeg.

rows.source: High 2, low 2, high 2, low 2. Move only your second finger.
rows.translation: Visoki 2, niski 2, visoki 2, niski 2. Pomiči samo drugi prst.

rows.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
rows.translation: G-dur treba prirodni C na žici A i prirodni G na žici E, pa drugi prst ondje stoji nisko. Na žicama G i D ostaje visoko.

rows.source: The A string in G major: second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: Žica A u G-duru: drugi prst nisko, dodiruje prvi.

rows.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
rows.translation: Sada E, povišeni F, G na žici E. Opet niski 2.

rows.source: Where does second finger go on the E string in G major?
rows.translation: Gdje ide drugi prst na žici E u G-duru?

rows.source: G natural is a half step above F sharp, so second finger tucks right against first.
rows.translation: Prirodni G poluton je iznad povišenog F, pa drugi prst stoji tik uz prvi.

rows.source: Start on open G and climb to G on the E string: fifteen notes, two octaves. High 2 on the low strings, low 2 on the high ones.
rows.translation: Počni na praznom G i penji se do G na žici E: petnaest tonova, dvije oktave. Visoki 2 na niskim žicama, niski 2 na visokima.

rows.source: A minor starts with first-finger A on the G string. Second finger is high on the G string for B, then low on the D string for F natural.
rows.translation: A-mol počinje tonom A prvim prstom na žici G. Drugi prst je visoko na žici G za B, pa nisko na žici D za prirodni F.

rows.source: A minor, up. High 2 on the G string, low 2 on the D string.
rows.translation: A-mol, gore. Visoki 2 na žici G, niski 2 na žici D.

rows.source: Its third note is a half step lower
rows.translation: Treći joj je ton poluton niže

rows.source: It starts on a lower string
A to C sounds dark; A to C sharp sounds bright. One half step changes the whole mood.
rows.translation: Od A do C zvuči tamno; od A do povišenog C svijetlo. Jedan poluton mijenja cijelo raspoloženje.

rows.source: This minuet comes from the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725. It's now credited to Christian Petzold. Count three beats to a bar.
rows.translation: Ovaj menuet potječe iz bilježnice koju je Bach darovao supruzi Anni Magdaleni 1725. Danas se pripisuje Christianu Petzoldu. Broji tri dobe po taktu.

rows.source: Which C does the minuet use?
The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
rows.translation: Menuet je u G-duru, pa je C prirodan, a drugi prst nisko na žici A.

rows.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
rows.translation: Povišeni F je visoki 2 na žici D: nisko na A, visoko na D.

rows.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
rows.translation: Druga polovica počinje visoko: četvrti prst doseže B na žici E. Zatim treći, pa niski 2.

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark apalačka je violinska melodija. U A je, ali koristi prirodni G: visoki 2 za povišeni C na žici A, niski 2 za G na žici E.

rows.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: E, povišeni F, G, povišeni F. Drži drugi prst nisko, uz prvi.

rows.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
rows.translation: Koji G ova melodija koristi na žici E?

rows.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Prirodni G umjesto povišenog G daje pjesmi Old Joe Clark starinski zvuk.

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy tiskana je u Škotskoj tijekom stogodišnjeg razdoblja koje počinje 1700., a i danas se svira na plesovima diljem Amerike. Prvi dio njiše se na A, povišenom F i D, tonovima D-durskog akorda.

rows.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
rows.translation: Prazni A, povišeni F visokim 2 na D, prazni D, povišeni F. Njiši lakat između žica.

rows.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
rows.translation: Kojim prstom sviraš G na žici E?

rows.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy je u D-duru, pa je G prirodan: visoki 2 za povišeni F na D, niski 2 za G na E.

rows.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
rows.translation: Svaki tonalitet određuje drugi prst. Prije sviranja pitaj: visoki 2 ili niski 2, i na kojoj žici?

rows.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
rows.translation: Povišeni F, pa visoki 2 ili niski 2?

rows.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
rows.translation: Niski 2 i visoki 2 na žici A, pa niski 2 i visoki 2 na žici E.

rows.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
rows.translation: Gdje je drugi prst na žicama A i E u A-duru?

rows.source: Low on A, high on E
rows.translation: Nisko na A, visoko na E

rows.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
rows.translation: Glasno i tiho, legato lukovi, četvrti prst, prvi korak prema vibratu i cijela Oda radosti.

rows.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
rows.translation: Dodaj težinu ruke, ubrzaj gudalo i pomakni mjesto dodira bliže kobilici. Koristi sve troje zajedno. Za tiho učini suprotno.

rows.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
rows.translation: U notama glasno označava f, za forte, a tiho p, za piano. Postupno pojačavanje je crescendo; stišavanje diminuendo.

rows.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
rows.translation: Blizu kobilice žica podnosi više težine i brzine, pa zvuči glasnije bez struganja.

rows.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
rows.translation: Svaki ton dvaput: forte, pa piano. Zadrži čistu intonaciju dok mijenjaš glasnoću.

rows.source: A curved line over notes is a slur: play them all in one bow. Your left hand changes notes while the bow keeps moving.
rows.translation: Zakrivljena crta iznad nota je legato luk: sviraj ih sve jednim potezom gudala. Lijeva ruka mijenja tonove dok se gudalo nastavlja kretati.

rows.source: Slur A to B in one down-bow, then B to A in one up-bow.
rows.translation: Poveži A i B jednim potezom dolje, pa B i A jednim potezom gore.

rows.source: Two notes in one bow means each gets half of it. Plan ahead and start a slur with enough bow left for both notes.
rows.translation: Dva tona u jednom potezu znače da svaki dobiva polovicu. Planiraj i počni legato s dovoljno gudala za oba tona.

rows.source: What does a slur tell you?
Play the notes in one bow
Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
rows.translation: Četvrti prst doseže cijeli ton iznad trećeg. Na žici D to je A, isti ton kao prazna žica A. Drži prst savijenim i nagni ruku prema njemu.

rows.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
rows.translation: A četvrtim prstom na žici D, prazni A, pa opet četvrti prst. Uskladi ih točno.

rows.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
rows.translation: Zašto koristiti četvrti prst umjesto prazne žice?

rows.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
rows.translation: Izbjegava prijelaz žice i zvuči toplije

rows.source: Open strings are out of tune
A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
rows.translation: Ton pod prstom drži frazu na jednoj žici i stapa se s okolnim tonovima. Prazne žice zvone svjetlije.

rows.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
rows.translation: D trećim prstom, E četvrtim na žici A, pa prazni E. Slušaj podudaranje.

rows.source: D to A on one string
rows.translation: Od D do A na jednoj žici

rows.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace pjeva se na ranu američku melodiju New Britain. Parovi brzih tonova povezani su lukom. Pusti duge tonove da pjevaju punim, sporim potezima.

rows.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
rows.translation: Od G do B i natrag prelaziš žice. Njiši se glatko iz lakta.

rows.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
rows.translation: Kako sviraš gudalom brz par, poput B do G?

rows.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
rows.translation: Povezani su lukom, pa dijele jedan potez.

rows.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
rows.translation: Vibrato je mali, ravnomjerni val visine koji daje sjaj dugim tonovima. Vrh prsta blago se kotrlja unatrag od tona i vraća, uvijek iznova, pokretan šakom i rukom.

rows.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
rows.translation: Vibrato ne spašava nečist ton; samo boji onaj koji je pogođen. Većina ga dodaje kad prsti nalaze čiste tonove bez traženja.

rows.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
rows.translation: Kada je ton spreman za vibrato?

rows.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
rows.translation: Stavi drugi prst na žicu A. Drži vrh na mjestu, opusti zglob prsta i polako njiši šaku prema pužu i natrag. Malo i ravnomjerno. Ovdje pomaže učiteljev pogled.

rows.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
rows.translation: Sada ih sviraj gudalom bez vibrata i precizno pogodi svaki ton. Od te sredine počinje vibrato.

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler tiskana je najkasnije 1847. Violinisti povezuju najbrže tonove u parove, što melodiji daje polet. Počni polako i drži parove ujednačenima.

rows.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
rows.translation: Zašto tradicijski violinisti povezuju brze parove?

rows.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
It keeps the strings in tune
A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
rows.translation: A, G, povišeni F, A na žici E: treći prst, niski 2, prvi, treći.

rows.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
rows.translation: Spoji sve: čiste tonove pod prstima, ravno gudalo, legato lukove i dinamiku. Počni piano, pojačaj kroz sredinu i završi forte.

rows.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
rows.translation: Zagrijavanje: četvrti prst uz prazne žice, prvo A pa E.

rows.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
rows.translation: Sjedni i sviraj gudalom čisto, od praznih žica do Labuda

rows.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Sjedni, postavi nožicu, primi gudalo, odsviraj prazne žice i prvu pjesmu.

rows.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Od niskog do visokog žice su C, G, D i A. C je najdeblja i najniža. A je najtanja i najviša, a zovemo je žica 1.

rows.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
rows.translation: C je najdeblja i najniža žica. Žice brojimo od A (1) do C (4).

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Trzni žicu 1, A, i pusti je da zvoni.

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
rows.translation: Sada najdeblju žicu, C. Pusti je da zagrmi.

rows.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
rows.translation: Sjedni blizu prednjeg ruba stolca, stopala na podu, koljena razmaknuta, kao da lako možeš ustati. Violončelo počiva između koljena.

rows.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
rows.translation: Izvuci nožicu dok gornji rub violončela ne dotakne prsa kod prsne kosti, a čivija C bude blizu lijevog uha. Zategni vijak. Podložak ili remen sprečava klizanje.

rows.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
rows.translation: Gdje te dodiruje gornji rub violončela?

rows.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
rows.translation: Violončelo se naginje na tvoja prsa, a koljena ga lagano stabiliziraju sa strana.

rows.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
rows.translation: Sjedni uspravno i trzni D, pa G. Opusti ramena.

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
rows.translation: Savij palac i stavi vrh na spoj žabice i štapa, nasuprot srednjem prstu. Prebaci sva četiri prsta preko štapa i pusti šaku da teško visi.

rows.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Stavi gudalo na žicu D, na pola puta između kobilice i hvataljke. Polako povuci udesno.

rows.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Sada žicu A. Pomakni cijelu ruku na njezinu razinu, pa polako povuci.

rows.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.translation: Od niskog do visokog: C, G, D, A. Svaka je žica pet slovnih mjesta iznad prethodne, interval koji zovemo kvinta. Probaj: Cvrčak Glasno Doziva Anu.

rows.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
rows.translation: Desna ruka određuje koju žicu gudalo svira. Svaka žica ima svoju razinu ruke, poput stepenica. Pomiči cijelu ruku, ne samo šaku.

rows.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
rows.translation: Sviraj gudalom žicu C, pa G. Neka se ruka smjesti na svaku razinu.

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
rows.translation: Orkestri ugađaju prema A. Timbre pokazuje odstupanje svake žice u centima; 100 centi čini poluton, najmanji korak na klaviru. Ugodi A, pa D, G i C.

rows.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Sada D, G i C. Ugodi svaku, pa je sviraj gudalom i drži ton.

rows.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Sjedni uspravno s postavljenom nožicom, opuštenim hvatom gudala i gudalom na pola puta između kobilice i hvataljke. Sada odsviraj sve iz ove cjeline.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb živi na žici D: prazni D, prvi prst cijeli ton više za E, treći prst dva cijela tona više za povišeni F. Prvo trzaj, pa sviraj gudalom.

rows.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na žici D, cijeli ton više. To je E.

rows.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Treći prst cijeli ton iznad prvog. To je povišeni F.

rows.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
rows.translation: Povišeni F, E, D, E, pa povišeni F triput.

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Jedan spor potez dolje, pa jedan spor potez gore na D. Drži zvuk ujednačenim do kraja.

rows.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: D, A, D, A. Neka se ruka njiše između dviju razina.

rows.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Prijelaz iz C u D preskače žicu G, pa ruka radi veći pokret. Putuj glatko i ne dopusti da srednja žica zazvuči.

rows.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
rows.translation: Prst po polutonu: sviraj D-dur i prve melodije.

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
rows.translation: Poluton je najmanji glazbeni korak. U prvoj poziciji prsti su razmaknuti po poluton, počevši cijeli ton (dva polutona) iznad prazne žice. Palac iza vrata, nasuprot drugom prstu.

rows.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Prazni D, pa E prvim prstom. Drži E dok ne postane intonacijski čist.

rows.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
rows.translation: Isti prst na žici A: prazni A, pa B.

rows.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
rows.translation: Prazni D, pa E. Koliki je razmak?

rows.source: First finger on D and A
rows.translation: Prvi prst na D i A

rows.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
rows.translation: Treći prst svira povišeni F, cijeli ton iznad E. Neka drugi prst lebdi iznad svog mjesta između 1 i 3 da ruka zadrži oblik.

rows.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
rows.translation: D, E, povišeni F. Zadrži prvi prst na žici dok treći svira.

rows.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od E do sljedećeg tona: kakav je korak?

rows.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
rows.translation: Zašto drugi prst ostaje iznad svog mjesta?

rows.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
rows.translation: Svaki prst ima svoj poluton. Drži sva četiri na mjestu da svaki ton svaki put dođe na isto mjesto.

rows.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
rows.translation: Isti prsti na žici A: prazni A, B, povišeni C.

rows.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Četvrti prst svira G, poluton iznad povišenog F. D, E, povišeni F, G prva je polovica D-durske ljestvice: prazna, 1, 3, 4.

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: D, E, povišeni F, G: prazna, 1, 3, 4.

rows.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G četvrtim prstom na žici D oktavu je iznad prazne žice G: isto slovo, osam tonova više. Kad je čist, žica G odzvanja zajedno.

rows.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G četvrtim prstom, prazni G, pa opet G četvrtim prstom. Slušaj rezonanciju.

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Sviraj D, E, povišeni F, G na žici D, pa A, B, povišeni C, D na žici A. Isti prsti dvaput: prazna, 1, 3, 4.

rows.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
rows.translation: Kojim prstima sviraš D-dur na svakoj žici?

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
rows.translation: Ova francuska melodija iz stogodišnjeg razdoblja koje počinje 1700. koristi samo naučene tonove: D, E, povišeni F, G na žici D te A i B na žici A.

rows.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
rows.translation: Kojim prstom sviraš B na žici A?

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Prazna, 1, 3, 4 na žicama D i A. Zadrži oblik ruke, postavi svaki ton čisto i pusti oktave da zvone.

rows.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od trećeg do četvrtog prsta: kakav je korak?

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
rows.translation: Dvije oktavne provjere: G uz prazni G, pa D četvrtim prstom uz prazni D.

rows.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
rows.translation: Kojim prstom sviraš povišeni C na žici A?

rows.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
rows.translation: Dvije niske žice, C-durska i G-durska ljestvica te tri klasične melodije.

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
rows.translation: Na žici G prvi prst svira A, treći B, a četvrti C. Isti razmaci kao na D. Smjesti ruku na razinu žice G.

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C na žici G uz D, E, povišeni F, G na žici D čine G-dursku ljestvicu. Isti prsti na obje žice.

rows.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
rows.translation: Kojim prstom sviraš C na žici G?

rows.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
rows.translation: Na žici C prvi prst svira D, treći E, a četvrti F. Debela žica treba sporo, teško gudalo da progovori.

rows.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F: prazna, 1, 3, 4. Daj svakom tonu vremena da progovori.

rows.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F na žici C uz G, A, B, C na žici G čine C-dursku ljestvicu. Nema nijednu povisilicu.

rows.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
rows.translation: Uz C-dursku ljestvicu. Na vrhu slušaj kako C odzvanja s praznom žicom C.

rows.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
rows.translation: Drugi prst svira prirodni F na žici D, poluton ispod povišenog F, i prirodni C na žici A. C-dur treba oba.

rows.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
rows.translation: D, E, F, G: prazna, 1, 2, 4. Drugi prst stoji tik uz prvi.

rows.source: E, then second finger or third?
rows.translation: E, pa drugi ili treći prst?

rows.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
rows.translation: Violončelisti daju svakom prstu svoj poluton, pa F svira drugi, a povišeni F treći prst. Ton tik izvan šake, poput povišenog F na žici C, traži ekstenziju, širi hvat. Ovaj tečaj bira tonalitete koji je izbjegavaju.

rows.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
rows.translation: C-dur, druga oktava: drugi prst za F i za gornji C.

rows.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
rows.translation: Brahms je ovu uspavanku napisao 1868. Njiše se u tri dobe na žicama G i D. Koristi duge, spore poteze i pusti svaku frazu da diše.

rows.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
rows.translation: G, povišeni F, E: prsti 4, 3, 1. To je vrhunac uspavanke.

rows.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
rows.translation: Au clair de la lune francuska je narodna pjesma iz stogodišnjeg razdoblja koje počinje 1700. Živi na žicama G i D, s C pod četvrtim prstom.

rows.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
rows.translation: D, C, B, A, G: prazni D, pa prsti 4, 3, 1 i prazni G.

rows.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
rows.translation: Koji su tonovi ove melodije prazne žice?

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
rows.translation: Prazna, 1, 3, 4 na svakoj žici, s drugim prstom za prirodni F i C. Spori, teški potezi na niskim žicama.

rows.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
rows.translation: Dvije oktavne provjere: C uz prazni C, pa G uz prazni G.

rows.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
rows.translation: Koji od ovih tonaliteta nema povisilica?

rows.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
rows.translation: Klizni u četvrtu poziciju, provjeri sluhom i sviraj Labuda i Amazing Grace.

rows.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
rows.translation: Promjena pozicije pomiče cijelu ruku na novo mjesto na žici. Olakšaj prst, klizni njime duž žice bez podizanja i pusti palac da putuje s rukom.

rows.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
rows.translation: U četvrtoj poziciji prvi prst svira D na žici A, ton koji je četvrti svirao u prvoj poziciji. Palac sjeda gdje se vrat savija prema tijelu.

rows.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
rows.translation: B prvim prstom, pa klizni tim prstom gore do D. Neka putem bude lagan.

rows.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
rows.translation: Pomicanje ruke kao cjeline čuva razmake prstiju, pa i sljedeći tonovi dolaze čisto.

rows.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
rows.translation: Klizni gore, natrag i opet gore na prvom prstu. Pogodi svaki ton čisto.

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
rows.translation: U četvrtoj poziciji na žici A prvi prst svira D, treći E, a četvrti F. Isti okvir kao u prvoj poziciji: prst po polutonu.

rows.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
rows.translation: D, E, F: prsti 1, 3, 4. Ovdje gore tonovi su malo bliže.

rows.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
rows.translation: Prazni A, B, klizni prvim prstom do D, pa E trećim.

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
rows.translation: Koji prst svira E u četvrtoj poziciji na žici A?

rows.source: Up to fourth position and back
Check it with the open A
In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
rows.translation: U četvrtoj poziciji na žici D prvi prst svira G, a treći A, isti ton kao prazna žica A. Sviraj ih jedan za drugim i uskladi.

rows.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
rows.translation: G prvim prstom, pa A trećim, oba na žici D.

rows.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
rows.translation: A u četvrtoj poziciji, prazni A, A u četvrtoj poziciji. Neka zvuče isto.

rows.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
rows.translation: Sviraj E prvim prstom u prvoj poziciji, pa klizni njime do G. To su tri polutona, isti razmak kao od B do D na žici A.

rows.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
rows.translation: E prvim prstom, pa klizni do G prvim prstom. Neka i palac putuje.

rows.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
rows.translation: Labud je iz Karnevala životinja, koji je Camille Saint-Saëns napisao 1886. Ovo je početna fraza, oktavu niže i pojednostavljena.

rows.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
rows.translation: Duge note trebaju spore poteze. Drži gudalo blizu kobilice i rasporedi ga ravnomjerno da svaki ton traje do kraja bez slabljenja.

rows.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
rows.translation: G, povišeni F, B: četvrti i treći prst na D, pa treći prst na G.

rows.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
rows.translation: U Amazing Grace visoki D dolazi odmah nakon praznog A. Dok A zvoni, klizni rukom u četvrtu poziciju i postavi D prvim prstom.

rows.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
