rows.source: Hear F in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Čuj F u glavi, pa ga otpjevaj.

rows.source: Your first try lands flat. What next?
rows.translation: Prvi pokušaj je prenizak. Što dalje?

rows.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
rows.translation: Mali pomaci najbrže pronalaze ton. Nježno ga podigni i pusti da se ustali.

rows.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Čuj A u glavi, pa ga otpjevaj.

rows.source: Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
rows.translation: Tri tona zaredom: D, F, A.

rows.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
rows.translation: Unisono znači dva zvuka na potpuno istoj visini. Kad se podudaraju, stapaju se u jedan; kad malo odstupaju, čuješ podrhtavanje.

rows.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj E i drži ga čisto.

rows.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
rows.translation: Za dvostruko pjevanje istog tona na trenutak zaustavi zrak, pa ponovno započni nježnim „da”. Nemoj kliziti između njih.

rows.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj E tri puta na „da”, svaki put s kratkom stankom.

rows.source: A step is the next note
A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
rows.translation: Korak vodi na sljedeći ton ljestvice, naviše ili naniže. Koraci su najmanji i najlakši pomaci za čisto pjevanje.

rows.source: Did it go up or down?
rows.translation: Je li išlo naviše ili naniže?

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
rows.translation: Poluton je najmanji korak, poput E do F, bez tona između. Većinu susjednih tonova ljestvice, poput C i D, dijeli cijeli ton: dva polutona.

rows.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
rows.translation: E, poluton naviše do F i natrag.

rows.source: Hear each note in your head first, start softly, and adjust in small moves. Give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Prvo čuj svaki ton u glavi, započni tiho i prilagođavaj malim pomacima. Ponovljenim tonovima daj novi početak.

rows.source: Hear G in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Čuj G u glavi, pa ga otpjevaj.

rows.source: B, up a half step to C, and back.
rows.translation: B, poluton naviše do C i natrag.

rows.source: E to F has no note between them. C to D and G to A are whole steps.
rows.translation: Između E i F nema tona. Od C do D i od G do A cijeli su tonovi.

rows.source: Sing do-re-mi, the major scale, and five-note patterns.
rows.translation: Pjevaj do-re-mi, dursku ljestvicu i obrasce od pet tonova.

rows.source: Solfege gives each step of the scale a syllable: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do is home, wherever the scale starts.
rows.translation: Solmizacija svakom stupnju ljestvice daje slog: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do. Do je uporište, gdje god ljestvica počinjala.

rows.source: Sing do, re, mi on C, D, E.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj do, re, mi na C, D, E.

rows.source: Which syllable is home, the first step of the scale?
rows.translation: Koji je slog uporište, prvi stupanj ljestvice?

rows.source: Do is the first step and the note a scale comes back to.
rows.translation: Do je prvi stupanj i ton kojem se ljestvica vraća.

rows.source: Now back down: mi, re, do.
rows.translation: Sada natrag naniže: mi, re, do.
Pet stupnjeva: od do do sol

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: the first five steps carry many simple tunes. Sing them up and back down on one breath if it feels easy.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: prvih pet stupnjeva nosi mnoge jednostavne melodije. Otpjevaj ih naviše i natrag naniže u jednom dahu ako je ugodno.

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: C up to G.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: od C naviše do G.

rows.source: Between which two steps is there a half step?
rows.translation: Između kojih je dvaju stupnjeva poluton?

rows.source: Mi to fa (E to F) is a half step. The other steps from do to sol are whole steps.
rows.translation: Od mi do fa (od E do F) je poluton. Ostali koraci od do do sol cijeli su tonovi.

rows.source: Sol back down to do: G down to C.
rows.translation: Od sol natrag naniže do do: od G naniže do C.

rows.source: The major scale runs from do up to the next do: eight notes. Mi to fa and ti to do are half steps; every other step is a whole step.
rows.translation: Durska ljestvica ide od do naviše do sljedećeg do: osam tonova. Od mi do fa i od ti do do polutonovi su; svaki drugi korak je cijeli ton.

rows.source: Do to do: C up to the next C.
rows.translation: Od do do do: od C naviše do sljedećeg C.

rows.source: Where are the half steps in a major scale?
rows.translation: Gdje su polutonovi u durskoj ljestvici?

rows.source: Mi-fa and ti-do are half steps. That pattern gives the major scale its sound.
rows.translation: Mi-fa i ti-do su polutonovi. Taj obrazac daje durskoj ljestvici njezin zvuk.

rows.source: Take a low breath before you start so you don't run out near the top. Let high notes get lighter, not louder, and keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Duboko udahni prije početka da ti pri vrhu ne ponestane zraka. Neka visoki tonovi budu lakši, ne glasniji, i opusti čeljust.

rows.source: Back down from C to C. Keep each lower note bright so it doesn't sag flat.
rows.translation: Natrag naniže od C do C. Zadrži vedrinu svakog nižeg tona da ne padne prenisko.

rows.source: Short patterns like do-re-mi-re-do build accuracy fast. Sing one, then start it a step higher and let the scale guide you.
rows.translation: Kratki obrasci poput do-re-mi-re-do brzo razvijaju točnost. Otpjevaj jedan, pa ga započni stupanj više i slijedi ljestvicu.

rows.source: Do up to sol and back: C to G to C.
rows.translation: Od do naviše do sol i natrag: od C do G do C.

rows.source: Sing C-D-E-D-C, then the same shape one step higher. What's the top note now?
rows.translation: Otpjevaj C-D-E-D-C, pa isti oblik stupanj više. Koji je sada najviši ton?

rows.source: One step higher, the shape becomes D, E, F, E, D.
rows.translation: Stupanj više oblik postaje D, E, F, E, D.

rows.source: Breathe low before each scale, keep the top light, and keep lower notes bright on the way down.
rows.translation: Duboko udahni prije svake ljestvice, neka vrh ostane lagan, a niži tonovi vedri pri spuštanju.

rows.source: How many notes are in a major scale, do to do?
rows.translation: Koliko tonova ima durska ljestvica, od do do do?

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: eight notes, with do at both ends.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti, do: osam tonova, s do na oba kraja.

rows.source: Leap by thirds, fifths and octaves, and land in tune.
rows.translation: Skači za terce, kvinte i oktave i doskoči čisto.

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. Skip one scale step and you get a third, like do to mi. Hear mi in your head before you leave do.
rows.translation: Interval je udaljenost između dvaju tonova. Preskoči jedan stupanj ljestvice i dobiješ tercu, poput do do mi. Čuj mi u glavi prije nego što napustiš do.

rows.source: Do to mi and back: C, E, C.
rows.translation: Od do do mi i natrag: C, E, C.
Još jedna terca: D, F, D.

rows.source: C to E skips over D, so it spans three scale notes: a third.
rows.translation: Od C do E preskače se D, pa obuhvaća tri tona ljestvice: tercu.

rows.source: Do to sol spans five scale notes, a fifth. It sounds open and strong. Picture the steps in between, then jump straight to sol.
rows.translation: Od do do sol obuhvaća pet tonova ljestvice, kvintu. Zvuči otvoreno i snažno. Zamisli stupnjeve između, pa skoči ravno na sol.

rows.source: Do to sol and back: C, G, C.
rows.translation: Od do do sol i natrag: C, G, C.

rows.source: Do, mi, sol: two thirds stack up to a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, mi, sol: dvije terce složene jedna na drugu daju kvintu.

rows.source: Counting both ends, how many scale notes from do to sol?
rows.translation: Računajući oba kraja, koliko je tonova ljestvice od do do sol?

rows.source: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: five notes, so it's a fifth.
rows.translation: Do, re, mi, fa, sol: pet tonova, dakle kvinta.

rows.source: An octave leaps from do to the next do, eight scale notes up. The two notes share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one.
rows.translation: Oktava skače od do do sljedećeg do, osam tonova ljestvice naviše. Oba tona dijele naziv i tako se dobro stapaju da gotovo zvuče kao jedan.

rows.source: Before an octave leap, breathe low and keep your chin level. Think of the top note as light and easy, not a stretch upward.
rows.translation: Prije skoka za oktavu duboko udahni i drži bradu ravno. Zamisli gornji ton kao lagan i ugodan, a ne kao istezanje naviše.

rows.source: C, then G, then the high C. Use the G as a stepping stone.
rows.translation: C, pa G, pa visoki C. Neka G bude usputni oslonac.

rows.source: Why do the two notes of an octave blend so well?
rows.translation: Zašto se dva tona oktave tako dobro stapaju?

rows.source: The top one vibrates twice as fast
The top note vibrates exactly twice as fast as the bottom one, so their waves line up.
rows.translation: Gornji ton titra točno dvostruko brže od donjeg, pa im se valovi poravnavaju.

rows.source: Hear each leap in your head before you sing it. Land lightly on the top note, then step home.
rows.translation: Čuj svaki skok u glavi prije nego što ga otpjevaš. Lagano doskoči na gornji ton, pa se koracima vrati do uporišta.

rows.source: High do, sol, mi, do: back down.
rows.translation: Visoki do, sol, mi, do: natrag naniže.

rows.source: What is the interval from do to the next do?
rows.translation: Koji je interval od do do sljedećeg do?

rows.source: Do to the next do spans eight scale notes: an octave.
rows.translation: Od do do sljedećeg do obuhvaća osam tonova ljestvice: oktavu.

rows.source: Five public-domain tunes, melody only, at an easy pace.
rows.translation: Pet melodija iz javne domene, samo melodijska linija, laganim tempom.

rows.source: This traditional melody leaps up, then steps back down home. Sing it on "loo" and give each repeated note a fresh start.
rows.translation: Ova tradicijska melodija skače naviše, pa se koracima vraća naniže do uporišta. Pjevaj je na „lu” i svaki ponovljeni ton započni iznova.

rows.source: The opening leap: C up to G, step to A, back to G.
rows.translation: Početni skok: od C naviše do G, korak do A, natrag na G.

rows.source: The middle phrase: does it go up or down?
rows.translation: Srednja fraza: ide li naviše ili naniže?

rows.source: This melody from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony moves almost entirely by step. Keep it smooth and even, like walking up and down a staircase.
rows.translation: Ova melodija iz Beethovenove Devete simfonije kreće se gotovo isključivo koracima. Neka bude glatka i ravnomjerna, poput hodanja stubama gore i dolje.

rows.source: The five notes the tune lives on: F up to C.
rows.translation: Pet tonova na kojima melodija živi: od F naviše do C.

rows.source: The first phrase ends with a dotted note. How does it feel?
rows.translation: Prva fraza završava notom s točkom. Kakav je osjećaj?

rows.source: The dotted note is held longer, then a short note leads into the last one.
rows.translation: Nota s točkom drži se dulje, pa kratka nota vodi u posljednju.

rows.source: This traditional Scottish melody starts with a pickup, a note before the first full bar. Sing it lightly, then lean on the next note.
rows.translation: Ova tradicijska škotska melodija počinje uzmahom, notom prije prvog punog takta. Otpjevaj je lagano, pa naglasi sljedeću notu.

rows.source: The climb in the third bar: F, A, C, up to D.
rows.translation: Uspon u trećem taktu: F, A, C, naviše do D.

rows.source: The loudest note of a song
A note before the first full bar
A pickup leads into beat 1 of the first full bar.
rows.translation: Uzmah vodi u dobu 1 prvog punog takta.

rows.source: This American hymn tune from the early 1800s is in 3/4: count 1, 2, 3. Long notes often turn into a quick pair, so keep the pair light.
rows.translation: Ova američka melodija himne s početka stoljeća započetog 1800. je u 3/4: broji 1, 2, 3. Duge note često prelaze u brz par, pa neka par bude lagan.

rows.source: The quick turn: F, up to A, back to F.
rows.translation: Brzi obrat: F, naviše do A, natrag na F.

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar of this hymn?
rows.translation: Koliko doba ima svaki takt ove himne?

rows.source: It's in 3/4: three beats per bar, with the weight on 1.
rows.translation: U 3/4 je: tri dobe po taktu, s naglaskom na 1.

rows.source: This American folk song from the 1800s moves slowly, with wide leaps. Breathe at each rest, and hear every leap before you sing it.
rows.translation: Ova američka narodna pjesma iz stoljeća započetog 1800. kreće se polako, širokim skokovima. Udahni u svakoj pauzi i čuj svaki skok prije nego što ga otpjevaš.

rows.source: The opening leap: low G up to C. Any octave counts.
rows.translation: Početni skok: od niskog G naviše do C. Svaka oktava vrijedi.

rows.source: The big leap: G up to high C, then step down.
rows.translation: Veliki skok: od G naviše do visokog C, pa naniže koracima.

rows.source: Where should you breathe in this song?
rows.translation: Gdje treba udahnuti u ovoj pjesmi?

rows.source: Never; sing it in one breath
rows.translation: Nikad; otpjevaj je u jednom dahu

rows.source: The rests mark the ends of phrases. Breathe there so each line has full support.
rows.translation: Pauze označavaju krajeve fraza. Udahni ondje kako bi svaki redak imao punu potporu.

rows.source: Five tunes back to back, one phrase each. Breathe at every rest, and give repeated notes a fresh start.
rows.translation: Pet melodija zaredom, po jedna fraza iz svake. Udahni u svakoj pauzi i svaki ponovljeni ton započni iznova.

rows.source: Which of these songs is in 3/4?
rows.translation: Koja je od ovih pjesama u 3/4?

rows.source: Amazing Grace counts 1, 2, 3 in every bar.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace broji 1, 2, 3 u svakom taktu.

rows.source: Hold notes steady, shape loud and soft, and warm up well.
rows.translation: Drži tonove stabilno, oblikuj glasno i tiho i dobro se zagrij.

rows.source: Pitch drifts when the air behind it changes. Keep a low, even breath and watch the note stay centered from start to finish.
rows.translation: Visina tona luta kad se promijeni protok zraka. Održavaj dubok, ravnomjeran dah i prati kako ton ostaje u središtu od početka do kraja.

rows.source: Hold G and keep it centered.

rows.translation: Završi prije nego što nestane zraka

rows.source: Notes often sag flat as your air runs out. Stop a little before you're empty, then take a fresh low breath.
rows.translation: Tonovi često padaju prenisko kad ponestaje zraka. Stani malo prije nego što se isprazniš, pa ponovno duboko udahni.

rows.source: Your long notes go flat at the end. What helps?
rows.translation: Dugi tonovi na kraju ti padaju prenisko. Što pomaže?

rows.source: End the note sooner and breathe
Pitch sags when you run low on air. Ending a bit early keeps the whole note in tune.
rows.translation: Visina pada kad ponestaje zraka. Malo raniji završetak održava cijeli ton čistim.

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, regular wave in pitch, around five to seven times a second. It grows out of a relaxed throat and steady breath, not out of shaking.
rows.translation: Vibrato je nježno, pravilno valovanje visine, oko pet do sedam puta u sekundi. Razvija se iz opuštenog grla i ravnomjernog daha, a ne iz tresenja.

rows.source: Where does healthy vibrato come from?
A relaxed throat and steady breath
rows.translation: Iz opuštenog grla i ravnomjernog daha

rows.source: Vibrato appears when the voice is free and supported. Forcing it from the jaw or belly makes a wobble.
rows.translation: Vibrato se javlja kad je glas slobodan i poduprt dahom. Forsiranje iz čeljusti ili trbuha stvara podrhtavanje.

rows.source: Learn to hold a straight, steady note before you chase vibrato. When your voice is relaxed and supported, vibrato often appears on its own.
rows.translation: Nauči držati ravan, stabilan ton prije nego što tražiš vibrato. Kad je glas opušten i poduprt, vibrato se često javlja sam.

rows.source: A straight, steady A. No wave, just a clear line.
rows.translation: Ravan, stabilan A. Bez valovanja, samo jasna linija.

rows.source: What's the best first goal for a new singer?
rows.translation: Koji je najbolji prvi cilj za početnika u pjevanju?

rows.source: A steady tone is the foundation. Vibrato that grows from it sounds natural.
rows.translation: Stabilan ton je temelj. Vibrato koji se iz njega razvije zvuči prirodno.

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.translation: Dinamika je koliko glasno ili tiho pjevaš. Pojačaj glas energijom daha, a ne stezanjem grla. Visina tona treba ostati ista.

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj E tiho, pa glasnije na istoj visini.

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?
rows.translation: Što se može dogoditi s visinom kad pjevaš glasnije?

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.translation: Dodatni potisak obično podiže visinu, a vrlo tihi tonovi mogu pasti prenisko. U oba slučaja prati ton.

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.translation: Pojačavanje raste od tihog prema glasnijem i natrag u jednom dahu. Počni tiho, nježno pojačaj, pa stišaj, sve na istoj visini.

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.translation: Pojačaj i stišaj G: tiho, glasnije, tiho. Drži ga u središtu.

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.translation: Kratko zagrijavanje nježno uvodi glas: duboko diši, pjevuši, zatreperi usnama, pa otpjevaj ljestvicu. Počni u sredini svojeg raspona i ostani u ugodnom području.

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?
rows.translation: Glas ti je umoran nakon vježbanja. Što je najbolje?
Odmoriti ga i piti malo vode

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.translation: Odmor pomaže umornom glasu da se oporavi. Ako promuklost traje nekoliko tjedana, obrati se liječniku.

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.translation: Prvo se zagrij. Zatim drži svaki ton stabilno, oblikuj ga tiho i glasno i udahni prije nego što ponestane zraka.

rows.source: Vibrato is a gentle, even wave around the note, a few times a second.
rows.translation: Vibrato je nježno, ravnomjerno valovanje oko tona, nekoliko puta u sekundi.

rows.source: To sing louder, what do you add?
Breath energy makes a bigger sound without strain.
rows.translation: Energija daha daje snažniji zvuk bez naprezanja.

rows.source: Play the melody, or strum the chords and sing
rows.translation: Sviraj melodiju ili sviraj akorde i pjevaj

rows.source: Six famous tunes, one note at a time, on the top strings. Slow tempos, big wins.
rows.translation: Šest poznatih melodija, ton po ton, na najvišim žicama. Spori tempo, veliki uspjesi.

rows.source: In 1877, Thomas Edison recited this rhyme to test his new phonograph. The tune uses C and D on string 2, then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Godine 1877. Thomas Edison recitirao je ovu pjesmicu kako bi ispitao svoj novi fonograf. Melodija koristi C i D na žici 2, zatim prazni E i G na pragu 3 žice 1.

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, then string 2 at frets 3 and 1, and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: prazna žica 1, pa žica 2 na pragovima 3 i 1, i natrag.

rows.source: D D D at fret 3 on string 2. Then open E, and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D na pragu 3 žice 2. Zatim prazni E i G na pragu 3 žice 1.

rows.source: This melody was first printed in France in 1761, and Mozart later wrote twelve variations on it. It leaps up, then steps down across strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Ova je melodija prvi put tiskana u Francuskoj 1761., a Mozart je poslije napisao dvanaest varijacija na nju. Skače naviše, pa silazi koracima preko žica 2 i 3.

rows.source: Open G, a leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, and back to D.
rows.translation: Prazni G, skok naviše do D na pragu 3 žice 2, prazni E i natrag na D.

rows.source: Step down in pairs: C at fret 1, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G.
rows.translation: Silazi u parovima: C na pragu 1, prazni B, A na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni G.

rows.source: Which other song uses this same tune?
rows.translation: Koja druga pjesma koristi istu melodiju?

rows.source: The alphabet song and Baa, Baa, Black Sheep both borrow this French melody.
rows.translation: Pjesma o abecedi i Baa, Baa, Black Sheep obje preuzimaju ovu francusku melodiju.

rows.source: Beethoven finished his Ninth Symphony in 1824, and this melody is now the anthem of the European Union. Here you'll play the whole tune, middle section included.
rows.translation: Beethoven je dovršio Devetu simfoniju 1824., a ova je melodija danas himna Europske unije. Ovdje ćeš odsvirati cijelu melodiju, uključujući srednji dio.

rows.source: The opening: E E F G G F E D, one step at a time.
rows.translation: Početak: E E F G G F E D, korak po korak.

rows.source: In the middle section, E and F share a single beat. Count one, two-and, three, four, and play E on two and F on the and.
rows.translation: U srednjem dijelu E i F dijele jednu dobu. Broji jedan, dva-i, tri, četiri i odsviraj E na dva, a F na i.

rows.source: The middle: quick E F pairs on string 1, then down to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: Sredina: brzi parovi E F na žici 1, pa naniže do praznog G na žici 3.

rows.source: Frère Jacques is a French round, first printed around 1780: a second player starts the same tune two bars later, and the parts fit together.
rows.translation: Bratec Martin je francuski kanon, prvi put tiskan oko 1780.: drugi svirač započinje istu melodiju dva takta kasnije, a dionice se slažu zajedno.

rows.source: In a round, the second player…
Everyone plays the same melody, each starting a little later. The phrases are built to fit on top of each other.
rows.translation: Svi sviraju istu melodiju, svatko počinjući malo kasnije. Fraze su oblikovane tako da se mogu preklapati.

rows.source: The quick part: D E D C on strings 2 and 1, then B and G.
rows.translation: Brzi dio: D E D C na žicama 2 i 1, pa B i G.

rows.source: The ending dips from open G to open D on string 4, then comes back.
rows.translation: Završetak silazi s praznog G do praznog D na žici 4, pa se vraća.

rows.source: James Lord Pierpont published this song in 1857 as One Horse Open Sleigh. You'll play its famous chorus, all on strings 1 and 2.
rows.translation: James Lord Pierpont objavio je ovu pjesmu 1857. pod nazivom One Horse Open Sleigh. Svirat ćeš njezin poznati refren, sav na žicama 1 i 2.

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3, down to C and D on string 2, then home to E.
rows.translation: Prazni E, G na pragu 3, naniže do C i D na žici 2, pa natrag do E.

rows.source: In that phrase, C rings for a beat and a half and D slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: U toj frazi C zvoni dobu i pol, a D ulazi na i nakon četiri. Broji jedan, dva, tri, četiri-i.

rows.source: The second line sits on F at fret 1, then settles onto open E.
rows.translation: Drugi redak zadržava se na F na pragu 1, pa se smiruje na praznom E.

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard after Louis Armstrong recorded it in 1938. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Ova tradicijska duhovna pjesma postala je jazz-standard nakon što ju je Louis Armstrong snimio 1938. Koristi C, D, E, F i G na žicama 2 i 1.

rows.source: The opening: C on string 2, then E, F and G climbing string 1.
rows.translation: Početak: C na žici 2, pa E, F i G uz žicu 1.

rows.source: No new notes here: all six tunes from this unit, each a little faster than before. Name the opening by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Ovdje nema novih tonova: svih šest melodija iz ove cjeline, svaka malo brže nego prije. Prepoznaj početak sluhom, pa sviraj.

rows.source: Campfire songs and a sea song, with easy chords to strum on the simplest ones.
rows.translation: Pjesme uz logorsku vatru i morska pjesma, uz jednostavne akorde za pratnju onih najlakših.

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1848, and gold seekers heading to California made it their anthem. The verse sits on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster objavio je ovu pjesmu 1848., a tragači za zlatom na putu u Kaliforniju učinili su je svojom himnom. Strofa je na žicama 3, 2 i 1.

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E, then back down to open G and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Prazni B, D na pragu 3, prazni E, pa naniže do praznog G i A na pragu 2.

rows.source: The last bar: B B A A, then home to open G.
rows.translation: Posljednji takt: B B A A, pa natrag do praznog G.

rows.source: G sounds like home, and D7 pulls back toward it. The verse is three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: G zvuči kao uporište, a D7 vuče natrag prema njemu. Strofa ima tri takta G, jedan D7, dva G, pa D7 i G.

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this racing song in 1850, two years after Oh! Susanna. It uses the same notes and the same two chords.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster napisao je ovu pjesmu o utrkama 1850., dvije godine nakon Oh! Susanna. Koristi iste tonove i ista dva akorda.

rows.source: D D B D, up to open E, then D and B. Strings 2 and 1.
rows.translation: D D B D, naviše do praznog E, pa D i B. Žice 2 i 1.

rows.source: Twice in the first line, a quick B leads into an A that rings for three beats. Pick the A once and let it ring.
rows.translation: Dvaput u prvom retku brzi B vodi u A koji zvoni tri dobe. Trzni A jednom i pusti ga da zvoni.

rows.source: This farmyard song was first printed in 1917, but people sang versions of it long before. Its tune reaches down to D and E on string 4.
rows.translation: Ova pjesma o seoskom dvorištu prvi je put tiskana 1917., ali ljudi su njezine inačice pjevali mnogo prije. Melodija seže naniže do D i E na žici 4.

rows.source: Open G three times, down to open D, E at fret 2 on string 4, back to D.
rows.translation: Prazni G tri puta, naniže do praznog D, E na pragu 2 žice 4, natrag na D.

rows.source: Then up: open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, and home to open G.
rows.translation: Zatim naviše: prazni B dvaput, A na pragu 2 žice 3 i natrag do praznog G.

rows.source: Here each chord lasts two beats, so the strum counts one, two. The order is G, G, C, G, then G, D7, G, G. Change early.
rows.translation: Ovdje svaki akord traje dvije dobe, pa se pratnja broji jedan, dva. Redoslijed je G, G, C, G, pa G, D7, G, G. Pripremi promjenu na vrijeme.

rows.source: British soldiers first sang this tune to mock American colonists. By the end of the Revolution, the Americans had made it their own.
rows.translation: Britanski vojnici prvi su pjevali ovu melodiju kako bi se rugali američkim kolonistima. Do kraja Revolucije Amerikanci su je prisvojili.

rows.source: C C D E, C E D, then a drop to open G on string 3.
rows.translation: C C D E, C E D, pa pad do praznog G na žici 3.

rows.source: The first half ends on B. How does that feel?
rows.translation: Prva polovina završava na B. Kakav je osjećaj?

rows.source: B sits just below C and leans toward it. The second half answers by landing on C.
rows.translation: B je odmah ispod C i teži prema njemu. Druga polovina odgovara završetkom na C.

rows.source: The last line: down from F on string 1, dip to open G, then climb back to C.
rows.translation: Posljednji redak: naniže od F na žici 1, spusti se do praznog G, pa se vrati naviše do C.

rows.source: The chorus sits low: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, then F and E on string 4 and C on string 5.
rows.translation: Refren je nizak: A na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni B, pa F i E na žici 4 i C na žici 5.

rows.source: George Poulton published this ballad in 1861. Nearly a century later, its melody became the tune of Love Me Tender.
rows.translation: George Poulton objavio je ovu baladu 1861. Gotovo stoljeće kasnije njezina je melodija postala napjev pjesme Love Me Tender.

rows.source: Up to C, down to open B and back, then D, a dip to A, and D again.
rows.translation: Naviše do C, naniže do praznog B i natrag, pa D, spuštanje do A i opet D.

rows.source: Aura Lee is a slow ballad. Keep each finger down until the next note sounds, so the notes join smoothly.
rows.translation: Aura Lee je spora balada. Drži svaki prst dok ne zazvuči sljedeći ton, da se tonovi glatko povežu.

rows.source: The high part: open E, F at fret 1, then down to D, A, and D again.
rows.translation: Visoki dio: prazni E, F na pragu 1, pa naniže do D, A i opet D.

rows.source: This song from the north of England is about Bobby Shafto, gone to sea. Its words were in print by 1805, and fiddlers played its tune for dances by 1770.
rows.translation: Ova pjesma sa sjevera Engleske govori o Bobbyju Shaftou koji je otišao na more. Stihovi su bili tiskani do 1805., a violinisti su melodiju svirali za ples već 1770.

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, back to B and open G, then B, D and B again.
rows.translation: Prazni B, D na pragu 3, natrag na B i prazni G, pa opet B, D i B.

rows.source: The second line dips to F sharp: string 4, fret 4, with your little finger. Keep your hand over the first four frets so it's ready.
rows.translation: Drugi redak silazi do povišenog F: žica 4, prag 4, malim prstom. Drži šaku iznad prva četiri praga da bude spremna.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, A, down to F sharp, and back up.
rows.translation: A na pragu 2 žice 3, C na pragu 1 žice 2, A, naniže do povišenog F i natrag naviše.

rows.source: The first three lines end the same way: two notes of one beat, then one of two beats. Gone to sea, on his knee, marry me.
rows.translation: Prva tri retka završavaju jednako: dvije note od jedne dobe, pa jedna od dvije. To su riječi „Gone to sea”, „on his knee”, „marry me”.

rows.source: The verse needs only the two chords from Oh! Susanna: two bars of G, two of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Strofi trebaju samo dva akorda iz Oh! Susanna: dva takta G, dva D7, dva G, pa D7 i G.

rows.source: No new notes or chords: all six songs from this unit, one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Bez novih tonova ili akorda: svih šest pjesama iz ove cjeline, jedna za drugom, svaka malo brže nego prije.

rows.source: Famous themes by Pachelbel, Dvořák, Brahms, Petzold, Grieg and Beethoven, in first position.
rows.translation: Poznate teme Pachelbela, Dvořáka, Brahmsa, Petzolda, Griega i Beethovena u prvoj poziciji.

rows.source: Johann Pachelbel wrote this canon over 300 years ago. Its bass repeats the same eight notes the whole way through while violins weave melodies above.
rows.translation: Johann Pachelbel napisao je ovaj kanon prije više od 300 godina. Bas cijelo vrijeme ponavlja istih osam tonova dok violine iznad pletu melodije.

rows.source: The bass, moved up an octave: D, A, B, F sharp, G, D, G, A.
rows.translation: Bas, podignut za oktavu: D, A, B, povišeni F, G, D, G, A.

rows.source: What does the bass do all through the Canon?
rows.translation: Što bas radi kroz cijeli Kanon?

rows.source: Plays a new tune each time
A repeating bass like this is called a ground. Everything else in the piece is built on top of it.
rows.translation: Takav ponavljajući bas zove se ostinatni bas. Sve ostalo u skladbi gradi se na njemu.

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above its letter. The melody uses C sharp on string 2, fret 2, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Povišeni ton je jedan prag iznad svojeg slova. Melodija koristi povišeni C na žici 2, pragu 2, i povišeni F na žici 4, pragu 4. Taj dohvati malim prstom.

rows.source: The first violin line: down from F sharp on string 1, then back up to C sharp.
rows.translation: Prva violinska linija: naniže od povišenog F na žici 1, pa natrag naviše do povišenog C.

rows.source: Antonín Dvořák wrote this theme for English horn in 1893, in his Symphony From the New World, while he was living in New York.
rows.translation: Antonín Dvořák napisao je ovu temu za engleski rog 1893., u svojoj Simfoniji iz Novoga svijeta, dok je živio u New Yorku.

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, back to E, then D and C on string 2.
rows.translation: Prazni E, G na pragu 3 žice 1, natrag na E, pa D i C na žici 2.

rows.source: Most bars open with a long note and a quick one. Count one, two-and, three: the quick note lands on the and of two.
rows.translation: Većina taktova počinje dugom pa brzom notom. Broji jedan, dva-i, tri: brza nota pada na i nakon dva.

rows.source: The ending: D, E, D, then settle on C and let it ring.
rows.translation: Završetak: D, E, D, pa se smiri na C i pusti ga da zvoni.

rows.source: Johannes Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868 for a friend's newborn son. It sways in three, like a cradle: a long note, then two quick ones.
rows.translation: Johannes Brahms napisao je ovu uspavanku 1868. za novorođenog sina prijateljice. Njiše se u tri, poput kolijevke: duga nota, pa dvije brze.

rows.source: The opening rocks between open B and D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Početak se njiše između praznog B i D na pragu 3 žice 2.

rows.source: Open G on string 3, then the same note an octave higher: G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: Prazni G na žici 3, pa isti ton oktavu više: G na pragu 3 žice 1.

rows.source: This minuet appears in a 1725 notebook Bach gave his wife, Anna Magdalena. Scholars now credit it to his fellow composer Christian Petzold.
rows.translation: Ovaj menuet nalazi se u bilježnici iz 1725. koju je Bach poklonio svojoj supruzi Anni Magdaleni. Znanstvenici ga danas pripisuju njegovu kolegi skladatelju Christianu Petzoldu.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, then climb from open G: A, B, C, D. Then two open Gs.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa uspon od praznog G: A, B, C, D. Zatim dva prazna G.

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. Most bars start with a long beat, then quick pairs: one, two-and, three-and.
rows.translation: Menuet je ples u tri. Većina taktova počinje dugom dobom, pa brzim parovima: jedan, dva-i, tri-i.

rows.source: Open E, back to C and D on string 2, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Prazni E, natrag na C i D na žici 2, pa E, povišeni F i G na žici 1.

rows.source: The ending: A B A G, then F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, and home to G.
rows.translation: Završetak: A B A G, pa povišeni F na pragu 4 žice 4 i natrag do G.

rows.source: The second section starts low: open B, A, open D, then C sharp at fret 4 and B at fret 2 on string 5, and open A.
rows.translation: Drugi dio počinje nisko: prazni B, A, prazni D, pa povišeni C na pragu 4 i B na pragu 2 žice 5, te prazni A.

rows.source: In the Hall of the Mountain King
Grieg wrote this for the play Peer Gynt in 1875. It pictures trolls in their king's hall, and it starts quietly and keeps speeding up.
rows.translation: Grieg je ovo napisao za dramu Peer Gynt 1875. Prikazuje trolove u dvorani njihova kralja, počinje tiho i stalno ubrzava.

rows.source: Climb from open string 6: F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, open A, B at fret 2.
rows.translation: Penji se od prazne žice 6: povišeni F na pragu 2, G na pragu 3, prazni A, B na pragu 2.

rows.source: The creeping part: A sharp at fret 1 on string 5, then open A with F at fret 1 on string 6.
rows.translation: Šuljajući dio: povišeni A na pragu 1 žice 5, pa prazni A uz F na pragu 1 žice 6.

rows.source: Where is A sharp on string 5?
rows.translation: Gdje je povišeni A na žici 5?

rows.source: A sharp is one fret above A, and A is open string 5. So A sharp is fret 1.
rows.translation: Povišeni A jedan je prag iznad A, a A je prazna žica 5. Zato je povišeni A na pragu 1.

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this piano piece in 1810, but it wasn't published until 1867, forty years after he died. This simplified version keeps the famous opening.
rows.translation: Beethoven je ovu klavirsku skladbu napisao 1810., ali objavljena je tek 1867., četrdeset godina nakon njegove smrti. Ova pojednostavljena inačica zadržava poznati početak.

rows.source: Rock between open E and D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, then walk down B, D, C to A.
rows.translation: Njiši se između praznog E i povišenog D na pragu 4 žice 2, pa siđi B, D, C do A.

rows.source: Each bar has three beats. After the long A comes a short rest, then three quick notes climb: C, E, A. Lift your finger for the rest, but keep counting.
rows.translation: Svaki takt ima tri dobe. Nakon dugog A dolazi kratka pauza, pa se tri brze note penju: C, E, A. Podigni prst za pauzu, ali nastavi brojiti.

rows.source: A, then C on string 5, E and A. Then B, E, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, and B.
rows.translation: A, pa C na žici 5, E i A. Zatim B, E, povišeni G na pragu 1 žice 3 i B.

rows.source: The middle: each phrase dips to a low note, then steps down. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.
rows.translation: Sredina: svaka fraza silazi do niskog tona, pa se spušta koracima. E G F E, D F E D, C E D C.

rows.source: No new notes: the six themes from this unit, from Pachelbel to Beethoven, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Bez novih tonova: šest tema iz ove cjeline, od Pachelbela do Beethovena, svaka malo brže nego prije.

rows.source: Which of these pieces is in three?
rows.translation: Koja je od ovih skladbi u tri?

rows.source: A minuet is a dance in three. The Canon and the trolls' march both count in four.
rows.translation: Menuet je ples u tri. Kanon i koračnica trolova oboje se broje u četiri.

rows.source: A Gold Rush ballad, two beloved hymns and a Shaker song from America's songbook.
rows.translation: Balada zlatne groznice, dvije omiljene himne i pjesma shakera iz američke pjesmarice.

rows.source: This American song was published in 1884 and looks back to the California Gold Rush of 1849. It's in three, on strings 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Ova američka pjesma objavljena je 1884. i prisjeća se kalifornijske zlatne groznice iz 1849. U tri je, na žicama 3, 2 i 1.

rows.source: Clementine starts with two quick notes before beat one. What are they called?
rows.translation: Clementine počinje dvjema brzim notama prije prve dobe. Kako se zovu?

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they fall on the and of beat three.
rows.translation: Uzmah je nekoliko nota koje vode u prvu naglašenu dobu. Ovdje padaju na i nakon treće dobe.

rows.source: The turn in the middle: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D, then back up to F.
rows.translation: Obrat u sredini: G na pragu 3 žice 1, naniže do D, pa natrag naviše do F.

rows.source: John Newton wrote the words in 1779. The tune, called New Britain, was first printed in 1829 and joined to his words in 1835.
rows.translation: John Newton napisao je stihove 1779. Melodija nazvana New Britain prvi je put tiskana 1829., a s njegovim stihovima spojena 1835.

rows.source: The high line: up to D at fret 3 on string 2, then B G, B A, G E D.
rows.translation: Visoki redak: naviše do D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa B G, B A, G E D.

rows.source: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these American words in 1831, to a tune Britain already sang as God Save the King.
rows.translation: Samuel Francis Smith napisao je ove američke stihove 1831., uz melodiju koju je Britanija već pjevala kao God Save the King.

rows.source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.
rows.translation: Točka produžuje notu za polovinu. U drugom taktu povišeni F zvoni dobu i pol, G ulazi na i nakon dva, a A pada na tri.

rows.source: The last line: B C B A G, then B C D, up to open E, and down C B A G.
rows.translation: Posljednji redak: B C B A G, pa B C D, naviše do praznog E i naniže C B A G.

rows.source: Joseph Brackett wrote Simple Gifts in 1848 for the Shakers, who danced as they sang. Aaron Copland later built part of his ballet Appalachian Spring around it.
rows.translation: Joseph Brackett napisao je Simple Gifts 1848. za shakere, koji su plesali dok su pjevali. Aaron Copland poslije je na njoj izgradio dio baleta Appalachian Spring.

rows.source: The second part starts high: G at fret 3 on string 1, then E D, and E F E D C.
rows.translation: Drugi dio počinje visoko: G na pragu 3 žice 1, pa E D i E F E D C.

rows.source: Two notes share each beat in this tune. How do you count them?
rows.translation: U ovoj melodiji dvije note dijele svaku dobu. Kako ih brojiš?

rows.source: Two even notes per beat are eighth notes. Say the number on the first and "and" on the second.
rows.translation: Dvije jednake note po dobi su osminke. Izgovori broj na prvoj, a „i” na drugoj.

rows.source: No new ideas: the four songs from this unit, each a little faster than before. Three of them sway in three. Simple Gifts dances in four.
rows.translation: Bez novih ideja: četiri pjesme iz ove cjeline, svaka malo brže nego prije. Tri se njišu u tri. Simple Gifts pleše u četiri.

rows.source: What does a dot after a note do?
Makes it half again as long
A dotted quarter lasts a beat and a half. The note after it is usually quick, to fill out the beat.
rows.translation: Četvrtinka s točkom traje dobu i pol. Nota nakon nje obično je kratka, da popuni dobu.

rows.source: Carols and a New Year's song, in two, three, four and six.
rows.translation: Božićne pjesme i novogodišnja pjesma, u dva, tri, četiri i šest.

rows.source: This tune was printed in 1582 in Piae Cantiones, a songbook from Finland, as a song about spring. John Mason Neale gave it Christmas words in 1853.
rows.translation: Ova je melodija tiskana 1582. u Piae Cantiones, pjesmarici iz Finske, kao pjesma o proljeću. John Mason Neale dao joj je božićne stihove 1853.

rows.source: The last line climbs from open D on string 4: E, F sharp at fret 4, open G, then A.
rows.translation: Posljednji redak penje se od praznog D na žici 4: E, povišeni F na pragu 4, prazni G, pa A.

rows.source: Then from D at fret 3 on string 2, step down to G, touch C, and land on G.
rows.translation: Zatim od D na pragu 3 žice 2 siđi do G, dotakni C i završi na G.

rows.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.
rows.translation: Deck the Halls potječe od Nos Galan, velške pjesme za doček Nove godine iz stoljeća započetog 1700. Engleski stihovi nastali su 1862.

rows.source: The third line climbs: C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, D, then E, F sharp and G on string 1.
rows.translation: Treći redak penje se: povišeni C na pragu 2 žice 2, D, pa E, povišeni F i G na žici 1.

rows.source: A7 needs two fingers on fret 2: finger 1 on string 4, finger 3 on string 2. Start your strum on string 5. That C sharp on string 2 is the one the melody climbs through.
rows.translation: A7 treba dva prsta na pragu 2: prst 1 na žici 4, prst 3 na žici 2. Počni akordski trzaj od žice 5. Taj povišeni C na žici 2 upravo je onaj kroz koji se melodija penje.

rows.source: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
This carol comes from England's West Country, where singers went door to door on winter nights and hoped for a treat in return.
rows.translation: Ova božićna pjesma potječe iz jugozapadne Engleske, gdje su pjevači zimskim noćima išli od vrata do vrata nadajući se poslastici zauzvrat.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2 and open string 4 are both D. How far apart are they?
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2 i prazna žica 4 oboje su D. Koliko su udaljeni?

rows.source: An octave is the same letter, eight steps higher or lower. The two Ds blend, but one sounds brighter.
rows.translation: Oktava je isto slovo, osam stupnjeva više ili niže. Dva tona D stapaju se, ali jedan zvuči svjetlije.

rows.source: B A G, then leap from D at fret 3 on string 2 down to open D. Then E, A, F sharp, G.
rows.translation: B A G, pa skok od D na pragu 3 žice 2 naniže do praznog D. Zatim E, A, povišeni F, G.

rows.source: Auld lang syne is Scots for old long since, meaning days gone by. Robert Burns sent the words to a songbook in 1788, and this melody was printed with them in 1799.
rows.translation: Auld lang syne na škotskom znači davno minula vremena, odnosno prošle dane. Robert Burns poslao je stihove za pjesmaricu 1788., a ova je melodija uz njih tiskana 1799.

rows.source: The chorus reaches up: B, D, open E, then G at fret 3 on string 1. Back down: D, B B G.
rows.translation: Refren seže naviše: B, D, prazni E, pa G na pragu 3 žice 1. Natrag naniže: D, B B G.

rows.source: Lowell Mason arranged this tune in 1839, borrowing phrases from Handel's Messiah. It opens with a G major scale, straight down from G to G.
rows.translation: Lowell Mason obradio je ovu melodiju 1839., preuzimajući fraze iz Händelova Mesije. Počinje ljestvicom G-dura ravno naniže od G do G.

rows.source: This carol counts in two. In bar one, G fills beat one, F sharp takes most of beat two, and E slips in at the very end.
rows.translation: Ova se božićna pjesma broji u dva. U prvom taktu G ispunjava prvu dobu, povišeni F veći dio druge, a E ulazi na samom kraju.

rows.source: The middle repeats open B and steps up to D, then repeats A at fret 2 on string 3 and steps up to C.
rows.translation: Sredina ponavlja prazni B i penje se do D, pa ponavlja A na pragu 2 žice 3 i penje se do C.

rows.source: Franz Xaver Gruber wrote Silent Night in 1818 for Christmas Eve in Oberndorf, Austria. At its first performance, the only accompaniment was a guitar.
rows.translation: Franz Xaver Gruber napisao je Tihu noć 1818. za Badnjak u Oberndorfu u Austriji. Pri prvoj izvedbi jedina pratnja bila je gitara.

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, grouped one-two-three, four-five-six. Each group sways like one slow beat.
rows.translation: Tiha noć je u 6/8: šest brzih brojanja po taktu, grupiranih jedan-dva-tri, četiri-pet-šest. Svaka se skupina njiše poput jedne spore dobe.

rows.source: The ending climbs to G at fret 3 on string 1, rings on F sharp, then walks down to open D.
rows.translation: Završetak se penje do G na pragu 3 žice 1, zvoni na povišenom F, pa silazi koracima do praznog D.

rows.source: D uses the top four strings. Finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3. Strum from open string 4.
rows.translation: D koristi četiri najviše žice. Prst 1 na žici 3, pragu 2; prst 2 na žici 1, pragu 2; prst 3 na žici 2, pragu 3. Sviraj akord od prazne žice 4.

rows.source: Joseph Mohr (1818), English by John Freeman Young (1859)
rows.translation: Joseph Mohr (1818.), engleski prijevod John Freeman Young (1859.)

rows.source: No new ideas: six songs in two, three, four and six, each a little faster than before. Feel where every bar begins.
rows.translation: Bez novih ideja: šest pjesama u dva, tri, četiri i šest, svaka malo brže nego prije. Osjeti početak svakog takta.

rows.source: Silent Night is in 6/8. How are its six counts grouped?
rows.translation: Tiha noć je u 6/8. Kako je grupirano njezinih šest brojanja?

rows.source: 6/8 sways in two big beats, each split into three: one-two-three, four-five-six.
rows.translation: 6/8 njiše se u dvije velike dobe, svaka podijeljena na tri: jedan-dva-tri, četiri-pet-šest.

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs: rests, minor keys, a wide range and third position.
rows.translation: Dvije Mozartove teme i dva stara napjeva: pauze, molski tonaliteti, širok raspon i treća pozicija.

rows.source: Mozart finished this serenade for strings in 1787. Its opening leaps up through the notes of a G chord, then answers with the notes of D7.
rows.translation: Mozart je dovršio ovu serenadu za gudače 1787. Početak skače naviše kroz tonove akorda G, pa odgovara tonovima D7.

rows.source: A rest is a silent beat. Touch the string with your fretting fingers so the silence is crisp, then come back in exactly on time.
rows.translation: Pauza je tiha doba. Dodirni žicu prstima na hvataljci da tišina bude jasna, pa ponovno uđi točno na vrijeme.

rows.source: The answer: C at fret 1 on string 2, A at fret 2 on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, then open D.
rows.translation: Odgovor: C na pragu 1 žice 2, A na pragu 2 žice 3, povišeni F na pragu 4 žice 4, pa prazni D.

rows.source: The opening climbs through a chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Početak se penje kroz akord. Dur ili mol?

rows.source: Greensleeves was sung in England by the 1580s, and Shakespeare mentions it in The Merry Wives of Windsor. Here it's in E minor, low and dark.
rows.translation: Greensleeves se u Engleskoj pjevala već u 1580-ima, a Shakespeare je spominje u Veselim ženama windsorskim. Ovdje je u E-molu, nisko i tamno.

rows.source: In E minor, D sharp sits one fret below E and pulls toward it. Find D sharp at string 4, fret 1, and C sharp at string 5, fret 4.
rows.translation: U E-molu povišeni D nalazi se prag ispod E i vuče prema njemu. Pronađi povišeni D na žici 4, pragu 1, i povišeni C na žici 5, pragu 4.

rows.source: Each half ends: G, F sharp, E, then D sharp, C sharp, D sharp, and home to E.
rows.translation: Svaka polovina završava: G, povišeni F, E, pa povišeni D, povišeni C, povišeni D i natrag do E.

rows.source: The chorus starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then down to open D.
rows.translation: Refren počinje visoko: D na pragu 3 žice 2, povišeni C na pragu 2, prazni B, pa naniže do praznog D.

rows.source: Greensleeves is built on this chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Greensleeves se temelji na ovom akordu. Dur ili mol?

rows.source: This melody was first printed in George Petrie's collection of Irish music in 1855. The words of Danny Boy were set to it much later, in 1913.
rows.translation: Ova je melodija prvi put tiskana u zbirci irske glazbe Georgea Petrieja 1855. Stihovi pjesme Danny Boy dodani su mnogo kasnije, 1913.

rows.source: The high point: three As, up to F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, then E E D B D, A F sharp D.
rows.translation: Vrhunac: tri tona A, naviše do povišenog F na pragu 2 žice 1, pa E E D B D, A povišeni F D.

rows.source: This tune runs from string 5 to string 1. What keeps every string in reach?
rows.translation: Ova melodija ide od žice 5 do žice 1. Što drži sve žice nadohvat?

rows.source: With your thumb low behind the neck, your fingers arch and reach from string 5 to string 1 without straining.
rows.translation: S palcem nisko iza vrata prsti se savijaju u luk i bez naprezanja dosežu od žice 5 do žice 1.

rows.source: Mozart finished his Symphony No. 40 in 1788. It's one of only two symphonies he wrote in a minor key, and it opens with this restless, sighing theme.
rows.translation: Mozart je dovršio Simfoniju br. 40 1788. Jedna je od samo dviju simfonija koje je napisao u molskom tonalitetu, a otvara je ova nemirna, uzdišuća tema.

rows.source: Slide your hand up so finger 1 rests at fret 3. Each finger now covers one fret: 3, 4, 5 and 6. Move your thumb up too, behind finger 2.
rows.translation: Klizni šakom naviše tako da prst 1 bude na pragu 3. Svaki prst sada pokriva jedan prag: 3, 4, 5 i 6. Pomakni i palac, iza prsta 2.

rows.source: In third position, which finger plays fret 3?
rows.translation: Koji prst svira prag 3 u trećoj poziciji?

rows.source: A position is named for where finger 1 sits. In third position, finger 1 plays fret 3 and finger 4 reaches fret 6.
rows.translation: Pozicija nosi ime prema mjestu prsta 1. U trećoj poziciji prst 1 svira prag 3, a prst 4 doseže prag 6.

rows.source: E flat at fret 4 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then finger 4 up to B flat at fret 6 on string 1.
rows.translation: Sniženi E na pragu 4 i D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa prst 4 naviše do sniženog B na pragu 6 žice 1.

rows.source: The last phrase: F sharp, reaching finger 1 back to fret 2. Then E flat, D, C at fret 5 on string 3, and B flat.
rows.translation: Posljednja fraza: povišeni F, prstom 1 posegni natrag na prag 2. Zatim sniženi E, D, C na pragu 5 žice 3 i sniženi B.

rows.source: No new ideas: two Mozart themes, two old airs and third position, each a little faster than before. Breathe between pieces.
rows.translation: Bez novih ideja: dvije Mozartove teme, dva stara napjeva i treća pozicija, svaka malo brže nego prije. Udahni između skladbi.

rows.source: In E minor, which note leans up into E?
rows.translation: Koji ton u E-molu teži naviše prema E?

rows.source: D sharp sits one fret below E. That half step pulls hard toward home, which is why Greensleeves uses it at every cadence.
rows.translation: Povišeni D je prag ispod E. Taj poluton snažno vuče prema uporištu, zato ga Greensleeves koristi u svakoj kadenci.

rows.source: Five new songs on the open chords you know: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.
rows.translation: Pet novih pjesama na poznatim otvorenim akordima: pop uz vatru, balada, folk uz udarce nogama, reggae i country.

rows.source: Kite Weather is bright, easy pop: four chords on a loop, G, D, E minor and C, at a relaxed 88 beats per minute. Listen for the hook jumping up to F sharp in its second bar.
rows.translation: Vrijeme za zmajeve vedar je, lagan pop: četiri akorda u petlji, G, D, E-mol i C, pri opuštenih 88 doba u minuti. Slušaj kako upečatljivi motiv u drugom taktu skače do povišenog F.

rows.source: Does the hook climb or fall at first?
rows.translation: Penje li se upečatljivi motiv na početku ili pada?

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, prazni B i natrag, pa prazni E i povišeni F na pragu 2 žice 1.

rows.source: Porchlight drifts along at 70 beats per minute. A ballad is a slow song that tells a story, so give every chord room to ring. Listen for the long note that closes each line.
rows.translation: Svjetlo na trijemu plovi pri 70 doba u minuti. Balada je spora pjesma koja priča priču, pa daj svakom akordu prostora da zvoni. Slušaj dugu notu koja zatvara svaki redak.

rows.source: Does this phrase end at home?
rows.translation: Završava li ova fraza na uporištu?

rows.source: The chorus climbs string 1: open E, F sharp at fret 2, G at fret 3, then steps back down to D.
rows.translation: Refren se penje žicom 1: prazni E, povišeni F na pragu 2, G na pragu 3, pa koracima natrag do D.
Folk uz udarce nogama i pljesak

rows.source: Moth and Ember is the kind of song a whole room stomps along to: heavy downstrokes, a chant of a hook, 96 beats per minute. It starts dark in A minor and brightens on D.
rows.translation: Moljac i žar pjesma je uz koju cijela prostorija lupa nogama: snažni trzaji dolje, skandirani motiv, 96 doba u minuti. Počinje tamno u A-molu i posvjetljuje na D.

rows.source: Climb A minor: A at fret 2 on string 3, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E. Then step back down.
rows.translation: Penji se kroz A-mol: A na pragu 2 žice 3, C na pragu 1 žice 2, prazni E. Zatim koracima natrag naniže.

rows.source: The hook's second bar copies the first, a few notes higher. What is that called?
rows.translation: Drugi takt upečatljivog motiva ponavlja prvi, nekoliko tonova više. Kako se to zove?

rows.source: A sequence repeats a melodic shape from a new starting note. It makes a hook easy to remember.
rows.translation: Sekvenca ponavlja melodijski oblik od novog početnog tona. Zbog nje se upečatljivi motiv lako pamti.

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is laid-back reggae at 80 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on the and of each beat, a short chop called a skank, while bass and drums hold the beat.
rows.translation: Radio za oseke opušteni je reggae pri 80 doba u minuti. Gitara svira samo na i svake dobe, kratkim udarom zvanim skank, dok bas i bubnjevi drže dobu.

rows.source: Strum down on each and, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings so the chord stops. Chk, chk, chk, chk. The silence between chops is half the groove.
rows.translation: Sviraj akorde trzajem dolje na svako i, pa popusti prste na žicama da akord stane. Čk, čk, čk, čk. Tišina između udara čini polovinu ritmičkog osjećaja.

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, open B, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Prazni E, D na pragu 3 žice 2, povišeni C na pragu 2, prazni B, pa A na pragu 2 žice 3.

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard rolls along at 100 beats per minute. Country players split the bar: boom, a bass note on beats one and three, then chick, a strum on two and four.
rows.translation: Prašina na armaturi kotrlja se pri 100 doba u minuti. Country svirači dijele takt: bum, bas-ton na prvoj i trećoj dobi, pa čik, akordski trzaj na drugoj i četvrtoj.

rows.source: On boom, pick only the chord's lowest note, its root: open string 5 for A, open string 4 for D, open string 6 for E. On chick, brush the thinner strings.
rows.translation: Na bum trzni samo najniži ton akorda, njegov osnovni ton: praznu žicu 5 za A, praznu žicu 4 za D, praznu žicu 6 za E. Na čik prijeđi preko tanjih žica.

rows.source: Which string is the boom for a D chord?
rows.translation: Koja žica daje bum za akord D?

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, the same string a D strum starts from.
rows.translation: Osnovni ton D je prazna žica 4, ista žica od koje počinje sviranje akorda D.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C sharp at fret 2 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: A na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni B, povišeni C na pragu 2 žice 2, pa prazni E i povišeni F na pragu 2.

rows.source: No new chords or notes: the five songs from this unit, each a touch faster. Name each hook by ear, then play.
rows.translation: Bez novih akorda ili tonova: pet pjesama iz ove cjeline, svaka malo brže. Prepoznaj svaki upečatljivi motiv sluhom, pa sviraj.

rows.source: Which song's hook starts like this?
In reggae, where does the guitar chop?
rows.translation: Gdje gitara svira kratke akordske udare u reggaeu?

rows.source: On the and of each beat
The skank lands between the beats, while bass and drums hold the downbeats.
rows.translation: Skank pada između doba, dok bas i bubnjevi drže dobe.

rows.source: Five songs on three chords each: a campfire chorus, a country two-step, a waltz, easy reggae and bedroom pop.
rows.translation: Pet pjesama sa po tri akorda: refren uz vatru, country two-step, valcer, lagani reggae i pop iz spavaće sobe.

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a campfire song on three chords, G, C and D, at 92 beats per minute. The chorus is made for a crowd, so by the second time around, sing it out.
rows.translation: Brijeg lampiona pjesma je uz vatru na tri akorda, G, C i D, pri 92 dobe u minuti. Refren je stvoren za mnoštvo, pa ga drugi put otpjevaj punim glasom.

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then G at fret 3 on string 1 and back down.
rows.translation: Prazni E, D na pragu 3 žice 2, opet prazni E, pa G na pragu 3 žice 1 i natrag naniže.

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is dance-hall country in A at 116 beats per minute. Pick the root on one and three, strum on two and four, and add a quick up after each strum.
rows.translation: Two-step na makadamu plesni je country u A pri 116 doba u minuti. Trzni osnovni ton na jedan i tri, akord na dva i četiri, pa nakon svakog akorda dodaj brzi trzaj gore.

rows.source: In a two-step, where do the bass notes fall?
The bass walks with the dancers' feet on one and three; the strums fill two and four.
rows.translation: Bas hoda s nogama plesača na jedan i tri, a akordski trzaji ispunjavaju dva i četiri.

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, then C sharp at fret 2 and A on string 3.
rows.translation: Povišeni F na pragu 2 žice 1, prazni E, D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa povišeni C na pragu 2 i A na žici 3.

rows.source: First Frost counts in three at 108 beats per minute: one, two, three, with the weight on one. D, G and A carry it all, and every line ends on a long, held note.
rows.translation: Prvi mraz broji u tri pri 108 doba u minuti: jedan, dva, tri, s naglaskom na jedan. D, G i A nose sve, a svaki redak završava dugom, držanom notom.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, D at fret 3 on string 2, twice. Then E, F sharp at fret 2, E, D and A.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 1, D na pragu 3 žice 2, dvaput. Zatim E, povišeni F na pragu 2, E, D i A.

rows.source: Hammock Season is easy reggae in C at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays only on beats two and four: one short, bright upstroke on the top strings, then silence.
rows.translation: Sezona visećih ležaljki lagani je reggae u C pri 76 doba u minuti. Gitara svira samo na drugu i četvrtu dobu: jedan kratak, vedar trzaj gore po najvišim žicama, pa tišina.

rows.source: Brush up across strings 1 to 3, then relax your fretting hand so the chord stops at once. Chk on two, chk on four. The quiet beats are what make it sway.
rows.translation: Prijeđi trzajem gore preko žica 1 do 3, pa opusti ruku na hvataljci da akord odmah stane. Čk na dva, čk na četiri. Tihe dobe stvaraju njihanje.

rows.source: Glow-in-the-Dark Stars is soft bedroom pop at 84 beats per minute: E minor, C and G, strummed light. Most lines start just after the beat, so let them float in.
rows.translation: Zvijezde koje svijetle u mraku nježan je pop iz spavaće sobe pri 84 dobe u minuti: E-mol, C i G, lagano svirani. Većina redaka počinje malo nakon dobe, pa ih pusti da uplove.

rows.source: Open E twice, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Prazni E dvaput, G na pragu 3 žice 1, prazni E, opet G, pa D na pragu 3 žice 2.

rows.source: E minor, C and G share one note. Which?
rows.translation: E-mol, C i G dijele jedan ton. Koji?

rows.source: E minor is E, G and B; C is C, E and G; G is G, B and D. G sits in all three, so the changes feel smooth.
rows.translation: E-mol čine E, G i B; C čine C, E i G; G čine G, B i D. G je u sva tri, pa promjene djeluju glatko.

rows.source: In reggae, where does the guitar play?
Reggae's guitar answers the beat: a short upstroke on two and four, silence in between.
rows.translation: Reggae gitara odgovara na dobu: kratak trzaj gore na dva i četiri, tišina između.

rows.source: The four-chord loop five ways: two summer anthems, a roller-rink bop, a pop song in 6/8 and a stadium chorus.
rows.translation: Pet lica petlje od četiri akorda: dvije ljetne himne, plesna pjesma za koturaljkalište, pop u 6/8 i stadionski refren.

rows.source: Sparkler Season rides the most famous loop in pop: C, G, A minor and F, the one, five, six and four of C. Hundreds of hits share these chords; a new tune and new words make each one its own.
rows.translation: Sezona prskalica prati najpoznatiju petlju u popu: C, G, A-mol i F, prvi, peti, šesti i četvrti stupanj C-dura. Stotine hitova dijele te akorde; nova melodija i stihovi svakome daju vlastiti identitet.

rows.source: The mini F covers strings 4 to 1: finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1, finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Mali F obuhvaća žice 4 do 1: prst 1 položen preko žica 2 i 1 na pragu 1, prst 2 na žici 3, pragu 2, prst 3 na žici 4, pragu 3.

rows.source: Roller Rink is bright dance pop at 120 beats per minute: G, E minor, C and D, the one, six, four and five. Strum even eighths and feel the kick drum land on every beat.
rows.translation: Koturaljkalište je vedar plesni pop pri 120 doba u minuti: G, E-mol, C i D, prvi, šesti, četvrti i peti stupanj. Sviraj ravnomjerne osminke i osjeti kako veliki bubanj pada na svaku dobu.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1 three times, F sharp at fret 2, open E.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, prazni E, G na pragu 3 žice 1 tri puta, povišeni F na pragu 2, prazni E.

rows.source: Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D at 80 beats per minute. Big strum on one, let it ring, then build on three and four. The half-time beat makes it feel huge.
rows.translation: Kanjon odjeka svira E-mol, C, G i D pri 80 doba u minuti. Snažan akordski trzaj na jedan, pusti da zvoni, pa gradi na tri i četiri. Osjećaj upola sporijeg ritma daje mu golemu širinu.

rows.source: Kite Weather plays G, D, E minor and C. Echo Canyon plays E minor, C, G and D. What changed?
rows.translation: Vrijeme za zmajeve svira G, D, E-mol i C. Kanjon odjeka svira E-mol, C, G i D. Što se promijenilo?

rows.source: Same four chords, same key. Starting on E minor puts the sad chord first, so the loop sounds darker.
rows.translation: Ista četiri akorda, isti tonalitet. Početak na E-molu stavlja tužni akord prvi, pa petlja zvuči tamnije.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then G again and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 1 i prazni E, dvaput. Zatim opet G i D na pragu 3 žice 2, dvaput.

rows.source: Open Windows sways in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: six quick counts felt as two big swings. C, F, A minor and G roll under a chorus that opens wide.
rows.translation: Otvoreni prozori njišu se u 6/8 pri 120 brojanja u minuti: šest brzih brojanja koja se osjećaju kao dva velika njihaja. C, F, A-mol i G kotrljaju se ispod široko otvorenog refrena.

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, E, G at fret 3, E, G, then C.
rows.translation: C na pragu 1 žice 2, D na pragu 3, prazni E, F na pragu 1 žice 1, E, G na pragu 3, E, G, pa C.

rows.source: Scoreboard Lights is a stadium anthem in D at 100 beats per minute: D, A, B minor and G, the same one, five, six, four loop in a new key. Drive steady eighths.
rows.translation: Svjetla semafora stadionska je himna u D pri 100 doba u minuti: D, A, B-mol i G, ista petlja jedan, pet, šest, četiri u novom tonalitetu. Pokreni ravnomjerne osminke.

rows.source: This B minor uses the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1. The full barre comes later.
rows.translation: Ovaj B-mol koristi samo četiri najviše žice: prag 4 na žicama 4 i 3, prag 3 na žici 2, prag 2 na žici 1. Puni barre dolazi poslije.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, D at fret 3 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp, open E.
rows.translation: A na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni B, D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa G na pragu 3 žice 1, povišeni F, prazni E.

rows.source: Which of these is the four-chord loop in C?
rows.translation: Koji je od ovih nizova petlja s četiri akorda u C?

rows.source: The one, five, six and four of C are C, G, A minor and F.
rows.translation: Prvi, peti, šesti i četvrti stupanj C-dura su C, G, A-mol i F.

rows.source: Blues, a waltz, 6/8 folk, lo-fi and funk, with seventh chords, sus chords and swung rhythms.
rows.translation: Blues, valcer, folk u 6/8, lo-fi i funk, uz septakorde, sus-akorde i swingirane ritmove.

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a blues at 80 beats per minute: twelve bars of E7, A7 and B7, strummed long-short. The melody swings the same way, so lean into every long note.
rows.translation: Shuffle hrđavog pojasa blues je pri 80 doba u minuti: dvanaest taktova E7, A7 i B7, sviranih dugo-kratko. Melodija se njiše jednako, pa istakni svaku dugu notu.

rows.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.
rows.translation: Prazni B, D na pragu 3, prazni E i natrag. Zatim G i povišeni G na žici 3, vodeći prema praznom B.

rows.source: Carousel at Closing Time turns in three, like a fairground ride winding down: oom-pah-pah at 96 beats per minute. Count one, two, three, with the weight on one.
rows.translation: Vrtuljak pred zatvaranje vrti se u tri, poput sajamske vožnje koja usporava: um-pa-pa pri 96 doba u minuti. Broji jedan, dva, tri, s naglaskom na jedan.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, A on string 3, then C sharp at fret 2, open E and G at fret 3 on string 1.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, A na žici 3, pa povišeni C na pragu 2, prazni E i G na pragu 3 žice 1.

rows.source: Cedar Smoke sways in 6/8: six quick counts per bar, felt as two big beats, one-two-three, four-five-six. At 100 counts a minute it rocks like a slow boat.
rows.translation: Cedrov dim njiše se u 6/8: šest brzih brojanja po taktu, kao dvije velike dobe, jedan-dva-tri, četiri-pet-šest. Pri 100 brojanja u minuti ljulja se poput spore barke.

rows.source: Bar four holds Dsus4: a D chord with your little finger on string 1, fret 3. It hangs in the air. Bar eight drops to plain D, and the song lands.
rows.translation: Četvrti takt drži Dsus4: akord D s malim prstom na žici 1, pragu 3. Ostaje visjeti u zraku. Osmi takt spušta se na obični D i pjesma slijeće.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B and back, then open E on string 1, and down again.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, prazni B i natrag, pa prazni E na žici 1 i opet naniže.

rows.source: Rain on the Skylight is lo-fi: soft seventh chords over a lazy, swung beat at 72 beats per minute. Strum down on one, then down-up on three, the up a little late.
rows.translation: Kiša na krovnom prozoru je lo-fi: nježni septakordi iznad lijenog, swingiranog ritma pri 72 dobe u minuti. Sviraj dolje na jedan, pa dolje-gore na tri, s malo kasnijim trzajem gore.

rows.source: Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted. Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted. For Dm7, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 lies flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1.
rows.translation: Am7 je A-mol s podignutim prstom 3. Cmaj7 je C s podignutim prstom 1. Za Dm7 prst 2 ide na žicu 3, prag 2, a prst 1 leži preko žica 2 i 1 na pragu 1.

rows.source: Neon Laundromat stays on one chord, A7, the whole way through. A vamp like this lives on rhythm: tight, choppy strums at 96 beats per minute and a hook that dodges the beat.
rows.translation: Neonska praonica cijelo vrijeme ostaje na jednom akordu, A7. Takav vamp živi od ritma: precizni, kratki akordski trzaji pri 96 doba u minuti i motiv koji izbjegava dobu.

rows.source: Funk players call beat one the one. Hit it hard, keep your strumming hand swinging in eighths, and ease your fingers off after each strum so it goes chk.
rows.translation: Funk-svirači prvu dobu zovu jedinica. Snažno je naglasi, drži ruku u osminkama i nakon svakog akordskog trzaja popusti prste da zazvuči čk.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3, then back down.
rows.translation: A na pragu 2 žice 3, C i povišeni C na pragovima 1 i 2 žice 2, prazni E, G na pragu 3, pa natrag naniže.

rows.source: How many quick counts fill a bar of 6/8?
rows.translation: Koliko brzih brojanja ispunjava takt u 6/8?

rows.source: 6/8 has six eighth-note counts, felt as two groups of three.
rows.translation: 6/8 ima šest osminskih brojanja, koja se osjećaju kao dvije skupine od tri.

rows.source: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, a 6/8 slow dance and bedroom pop, on seventh chords that make a groove glow.
rows.translation: Lo-fi, one-drop reggae, funk, spori ples u 6/8 i pop iz spavaće sobe, na septakordima koji daju ritmu sjaj.

rows.source: Late Checkout is lo-fi at 72 beats per minute: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7 on a loop. Strum down on one, then down-up on three with the up a little late, and swing the tune the same way.
rows.translation: Kasna odjava je lo-fi pri 72 dobe u minuti: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 i Am7 u petlji. Sviraj dolje na jedan, pa dolje-gore na tri s malo kasnijim trzajem gore i jednako swingiraj melodiju.

rows.source: G7 is G with string 1 at fret 1 instead of fret 3: fingers 3 and 2 on strings 6 and 5, finger 1 on string 1. It leans hard toward C.
rows.translation: G7 je G sa žicom 1 na pragu 1 umjesto praga 3: prsti 3 i 2 na žicama 6 i 5, prst 1 na žici 1. Snažno teži prema C.

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is reggae in A minor at 76 beats per minute. The guitar plays a double chop on two and four, chk-a, chk-a, while the drums drop their weight on three.
rows.translation: Slana nedjelja reggae je u A-molu pri 76 doba u minuti. Gitara svira dvostruki kratki udar na dva i četiri, čk-a, čk-a, dok bubnjevi naglasak spuštaju na tri.

rows.source: D7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1, finger 3 on string 1, fret 2. Am7 to D7 and back is the sunny, minor-but-bright sound of the whole song.
rows.translation: D7: prst 2 na žici 3, pragu 2, prst 1 na žici 2, pragu 1, prst 3 na žici 1, pragu 2. Am7 do D7 i natrag sunčan je, molski ali vedar zvuk cijele pjesme.

rows.source: Pocket Change is funk at 100 beats per minute: a vamp on Em7, with A7 for the chorus. Your strumming hand never stops moving in eighths; only some strokes ring.
rows.translation: Sitniš je funk pri 100 doba u minuti: vamp na Em7, s A7 za refren. Ruka koja svira akorde stalno se kreće u osminkama; samo neki trzaji zvone.

rows.source: Between the strokes that ring, lay your fretting fingers lightly across the strings and keep strumming: the muted strokes go chk. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Između trzaja koji zvone lagano položi prste preko žica i nastavi svirati: prigušeni trzaji daju čk. Pritisni samo za zvučne udare.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2. Twice.
rows.translation: A na pragu 2 žice 3, pa C i povišeni C na pragovima 1 i 2 žice 2. Dvaput.

rows.source: Kitchen Slow Dance is a soul ballad in 6/8 at 108 counts a minute, two slow sways a bar. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 and G7 carry the verse; Fmaj7 and Em7 open up the chorus.
rows.translation: Spori ples u kuhinji soul-balada je u 6/8 pri 108 brojanja u minuti, dva spora njihaja po taktu. Cmaj7, Am7, Dm7 i G7 nose strofu; Fmaj7 i Em7 otvaraju refren.

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 je mali F s praznom žicom 1. Em7 traži jedan prst: prst 2 na žici 5, pragu 2, sve ostale žice prazne.

rows.source: Open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, E, D at fret 3 on string 2, open E again, then open B.
rows.translation: Prazni E, G na pragu 3 žice 1, E, D na pragu 3 žice 2, opet prazni E, pa prazni B.
Pop iz spavaće sobe u septakordima

rows.source: Houseplants is soft bedroom pop at 88 beats per minute: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 and D. Seventh chords make it dreamy. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Sobne biljke nježan je pop iz spavaće sobe pri 88 doba u minuti: Gmaj7, Em7, Cmaj7 i D. Septakordi ga čine sanjivim. Sviraj jednom na jedan, pa nježno trzaj gore na „i”.

rows.source: Gmaj7 is G with string 1 at fret 2 instead of fret 3. Bm7 puts three fingers at fret 2, on strings 5, 3 and 1, and lets strings 4 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Gmaj7 je G sa žicom 1 na pragu 2 umjesto praga 3. Bm7 stavlja tri prsta na prag 2, na žice 5, 3 i 1, a žice 4 i 2 pušta da zvone prazne.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2 and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 1 i prazni E, dvaput, pa D na pragu 3 žice 2 i povišeni F na pragu 2 žice 1.

rows.source: Which chord has a major seventh?
Cmaj7 adds B, a half step under C. G7 and Am7 add a flat seventh, a whole step under the root.
rows.translation: Cmaj7 dodaje B, poluton ispod C. G7 i Am7 dodaju sniženu septimu, cijeli ton ispod osnovnog tona.

rows.source: Punk, garage rock, doo-wop, surf and heartland rock, with power chords, a riff and sus chords.
rows.translation: Punk, garažni rock, doo-wop, surf i rock američke unutrašnjosti, uz power-akorde, rif i sus-akorde.

rows.source: Static on Channel Nine is punk: four power chords, palm-muted eighths, 104 beats per minute. The verse mutters on low notes; the chorus is a gang shout, so dig in.
rows.translation: Šum na devetom kanalu je punk: četiri power-akorda, osminke prigušene dlanom, 104 dobe u minuti. Strofa mrmlja niskim tonovima, a refren je zajednički povik, pa zasviraj odlučno.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp at fret 2 and D again.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 1, naniže do D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa povišeni F na pragu 2 i opet D.

rows.source: Basement Weather is garage rock at 92 beats per minute: a riff on the low strings, then power chords that punch back. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep the riff tight.
rows.translation: Vrijeme u podrumu garažni je rock pri 92 dobe u minuti: rif na niskim žicama, pa power-akordi koji uzvraćaju udarac. Nasloni dlan uz most da rif ostane precizan.

rows.source: Open string 5, C at fret 3 on the same string, then open string 4, and back.
rows.translation: Prazna žica 5, C na pragu 3 iste žice, pa prazna žica 4 i natrag.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6, open A, G again, then open low E.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 6, prazni A, opet G, pa prazni niski E.

rows.source: Answer the riff with power chords on one, the and of two, and four: A5, G5, C5, D5. Between hits, ease your fretting fingers off so the chords stop short.
rows.translation: Odgovori na rif power-akordima na jedan, na i nakon dva i na četiri: A5, G5, C5, D5. Između udara popusti prste da se akordi kratko prekinu.

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a slow dance in 1950s doo-wop style: C, A minor, F and G7, around and around, at 72 beats per minute. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar.
rows.translation: Mjesec iz džuboksa spori je ples u doo-wop stilu 1950-ih: C, A-mol, F i G7, ukrug, pri 72 dobe u minuti. Sviraj na svaku dobu, s brzim swingiranim trzajem gore u svaki novi takt.

rows.source: Open G, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then D and C. Next, A at fret 2 on string 3 and back up.
rows.translation: Prazni G, C na pragu 1 žice 2, prazni E, pa D i C. Zatim A na pragu 2 žice 3 i natrag naviše.

rows.source: Boardwalk Comet is surf rock: a twangy melody over A minor, G, F and E, galloping along at 104 beats per minute. Picture reverb, salt spray and a wave about to break.
rows.translation: Komet sa šetnice je surf rock: zvonka melodija nad A-molom, G, F i E, u galopu pri 104 dobe u minuti. Zamisli odjek, slane kapljice i val pred lomljenjem.

rows.source: A on string 3, C at fret 1, open E and back down. Then open B, D at fret 3, and up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: A na žici 3, C na pragu 1, prazni E i natrag naniže. Zatim prazni B, D na pragu 3 i naviše do G na žici 1.

rows.source: Over the E chord the tune plays G sharp, not G. Where is G sharp on string 3?
rows.translation: Nad akordom E melodija svira povišeni G, ne G. Gdje je povišeni G na žici 3?

rows.source: G is open string 3, so G sharp is one fret up. It leans hard toward A, the home note.
rows.translation: G je prazna žica 3, pa je povišeni G jedan prag više. Snažno teži prema A, tonu uporišta.

rows.source: Mile Marker Zero is open-road rock at 100 beats per minute: big ringing chords and a chorus for driving with the windows down. Listen for D lifting to Dsus4 and back.
