rows.translation: Oznaka nulte milje rock je za otvorenu cestu pri 100 doba u minuti: veliki zvonki akordi i refren za vožnju spuštenih prozora. Slušaj kako se D podiže u Dsus4 i vraća.

rows.source: Asus4 is A with your little finger added on string 2, fret 3. Like Dsus4, it leans forward and wants to fall back home.
rows.translation: Asus4 je A s dodanim malim prstom na žici 2, pragu 3. Poput Dsus4, teži naprijed i želi pasti natrag na uporište.

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 and G at fret 3 on string 1, then down to D at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Povišeni F na pragu 2 i G na pragu 3 žice 1, pa naniže do D na pragu 3 žice 2.

rows.source: Which of these styles swings, long-short?
rows.translation: Koji od ovih stilova ima swing, dugo-kratko?

rows.source: Doo-wop rides a gentle swing. Punk and surf drive on straight, even eighths.
rows.translation: Doo-wop prati nježni swing. Punk i surf voze na ravnim, jednakim osminkama.

rows.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords and low-string riffs.
rows.translation: Punk-pop, rock s rifovima, tamni rock u 6/8, indie himna i pustinjski rock, uz power-akorde i rifove na niskim žicama.

rows.source: Last Bell is punk-pop at 152 beats per minute: C5, G5, A5 and F5, the four-chord loop as power chords. All downstrokes in steady eighths, palm resting on the strings by the bridge.
rows.translation: Posljednje zvono je punk-pop pri 152 dobe u minuti: C5, G5, A5 i F5, petlja od četiri akorda u power-obliku. Sve trzajima dolje u ravnomjernim osminkama, s dlanom na žicama uz most.

rows.source: F5 is the G5 shape two frets lower: finger 1 on string 6, fret 1, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 3.
rows.translation: F5 je oblik G5 dva praga niže: prst 1 na žici 6, pragu 1, prsti 3 i 4 na žicama 5 i 4 na pragu 3.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1 and open E, twice. Then D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, open E and D.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 1 i prazni E, dvaput. Zatim D na pragu 3 žice 2 dvaput, prazni E i D.

rows.source: Copper Wire is built on a riff: a short, catchy line on the low strings that the whole band locks onto. It runs at 112 beats per minute in E, with power chords in the chorus.
rows.translation: Bakrena žica temelji se na rifu: kratkoj, zaraznoj liniji na niskim žicama uz koju se cijeli sastav usklađuje. Ide pri 112 doba u minuti u E, s power-akordima u refrenu.

rows.source: Open string 6 twice, G at fret 3, open E, open string 5, G again, then open E.
rows.translation: Prazna žica 6 dvaput, G na pragu 3, prazni E, prazna žica 5, opet G, pa prazni E.

rows.source: The second bar turns around: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G at fret 3 on string 6, open A.
rows.translation: Drugi takt okreće smjer: B na pragu 2 žice 5, prazni A, G na pragu 3 žice 6, prazni A.

rows.source: Cold Lake is dark alternative rock in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E5, C5, G5 and D5. Keep the verse quiet and low so the chorus can open up.
rows.translation: Hladno jezero tamni je alternativni rock u 6/8 pri 120 brojanja u minuti: E5, C5, G5 i D5. Neka strofa bude tiha i niska da se refren može otvoriti.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, G again, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Let each ring.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 1, prazni E, opet G, pa D na pragu 3 žice 2. Pusti svaki ton da zvoni.

rows.source: Parking Lot Cathedral is indie rock at 128 beats per minute: D5, A5, B5 and G5, the four-chord loop again, now as power chords. Big, open, driving eighths.
rows.translation: Katedrala na parkiralištu indie je rock pri 128 doba u minuti: D5, A5, B5 i G5, opet petlja s četiri akorda, sada kao power-akordi. Velike, otvorene, pokretačke osminke.

rows.source: B5 is the A5 shape moved up two frets: finger 1 on string 5, fret 2, fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 3 at fret 4.
rows.translation: B5 je oblik A5 pomaknut dva praga naviše: prst 1 na žici 5, pragu 2, prsti 3 i 4 na žicama 4 i 3 na pragu 4.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, open E.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2 dvaput, povišeni F na pragu 2 žice 1, prazni E, G na pragu 3, prazni E.

rows.source: Halogen is desert rock in D minor at 104 beats per minute: a hypnotic riff on strings 4 and 5, a low, steady voice, then F5, C5 and G5 opening up the chorus.
rows.translation: Halogen je pustinjski rock u D-molu pri 104 dobe u minuti: hipnotičan rif na žicama 4 i 5, nizak, postojan glas, pa F5, C5 i G5 koji otvaraju refren.

rows.source: Open string 4 twice, F at fret 3, open D, open string 3, F again, then open D.
rows.translation: Prazna žica 4 dvaput, F na pragu 3, prazni D, prazna žica 3, opet F, pa prazni D.

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, C at fret 1 on string 2, then G at fret 3 on string 1, E and C.
rows.translation: F na pragu 1 žice 1, prazni E, C na pragu 1 žice 2, pa G na pragu 3 žice 1, E i C.

rows.source: Which song's riff starts like this?
A power chord is a root and its fifth, with no third, so it is neither major nor minor.
rows.translation: Power-akord čine osnovni ton i njegova kvinta, bez terce, pa nije ni durski ni molski.
Pjesme s pričom i sporim razvojem

rows.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in A minor.
rows.translation: Balada, morska priča u 6/8, valcer glazbene kutije, vedra folk-pratnja i tamna pjesma u A-molu.

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox tells a story in C at 72 beats per minute. The verse walks C, G, A minor, E minor, F, C, F and G, a chain of chords that has carried ballads for centuries.
rows.translation: Pisma u kutiji za cipele pričaju priču u C pri 72 dobe u minuti. Strofa prolazi kroz C, G, A-mol, E-mol, F, C, F i G, lanac akorda koji stoljećima nosi balade.

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, D at fret 3, open E, F at fret 1 on string 1, G at fret 3, then D again.
rows.translation: C na pragu 1 žice 2, D na pragu 3, prazni E, F na pragu 1 žice 1, G na pragu 3, pa opet D.

rows.source: Keeper's Daughter is a story song in 6/8 at 120 counts a minute: E minor, D, C and B7. Three verses tell the story, and the chorus answers each one.
rows.translation: Čuvarova kći pjesma je s pričom u 6/8 pri 120 brojanja u minuti: E-mol, D, C i B7. Tri strofe pričaju priču, a refren odgovara na svaku.

rows.source: Open B, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, open E, then C at fret 1 on string 2, E and C.
rows.translation: Prazni B, prazni E, G na pragu 3 žice 1, prazni E, pa C na pragu 1 žice 2, E i C.

rows.source: Snow Globe Town is a quick waltz in G at 120 beats per minute, like a music box: one strong beat, two light ones. G, D, E minor and C, with B7 in the bridge.
rows.translation: Grad u snježnoj kugli brzi je valcer u G pri 120 doba u minuti, poput glazbene kutije: jedna snažna doba, dvije lagane. G, D, E-mol i C, s B7 u mostu.

rows.source: Open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, D, C, then open B: a slow fall, like snow.
rows.translation: Prazni E, D na pragu 3 žice 2, C na pragu 1, D, C, pa prazni B: polagan pad, poput snijega.

rows.source: Thistle and Thread is a bright folk strummer in A at 116 beats per minute. Asus4 and Asus2 decorate the A chord: change one finger and the chord sparkles.
rows.translation: Čičak i nit vedra je folk-pjesma s akordskom pratnjom u A pri 116 doba u minuti. Asus4 i Asus2 ukrašavaju akord A: promijeni jedan prst i akord zasja.

rows.source: From A, put finger 4 on string 2, fret 3 for Asus4. Lift the finger off string 2 and let it ring open for Asus2. Both fall back to A.
rows.translation: Iz A stavi prst 4 na žicu 2, prag 3 za Asus4. Makni prst sa žice 2 i pusti je da zvoni prazna za Asus2. Oba se vraćaju na A.

rows.source: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, E twice, C sharp, open B, then A.
rows.translation: Povišeni F na pragu 2 žice 1, prazni E, D na pragu 3 žice 2, E dvaput, povišeni C, prazni B, pa A.

rows.source: Ghost Light is a slow, dark ballad in A minor at 70 beats per minute. The verse sinks from A minor through F and C to E major, which pulls hard back to A minor.
rows.translation: Svjetlo za duhove spora je, tamna balada u A-molu pri 70 doba u minuti. Strofa tone od A-mola preko F i C do E-dura, koji snažno vuče natrag prema A-molu.

rows.source: E major in A minor brings one new note. Which?
rows.translation: E-dur u A-mol donosi jedan novi ton. Koji?

rows.source: A minor's own notes have G. E major needs G sharp, a half step under A, so it leans hard toward home.
rows.translation: Vlastiti tonovi A-mola imaju G. E-dur treba povišeni G, poluton ispod A, pa snažno teži uporištu.

rows.source: F at fret 1 on string 1, open E, G at fret 3, then D at fret 3 on string 2. Hold each long.
rows.translation: F na pragu 1 žice 1, prazni E, G na pragu 3, pa D na pragu 3 žice 2. Drži svaki dugo.

rows.source: How many beats fill a bar of 3/4?
3/4 counts one, two, three, with the weight on one: the waltz.
rows.translation: 3/4 broji jedan, dva, tri, s naglaskom na jedan: valcer.

rows.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change, with F and B minor barres.
rows.translation: Indie pop, snažna rock-balada, highlife, neo-soul i himna s promjenom tonaliteta, uz barre F i B-mola.

rows.source: Late Bus Home is indie pop for the ride back through a sleeping city: D, B minor, G and A at 100 beats per minute. Each line starts just after the beat, so wait a breath.
rows.translation: Kasni autobus kući indie je pop za povratak kroz uspavani grad: D, B-mol, G i A pri 100 doba u minuti. Svaki redak počinje malo nakon dobe, pa pričekaj trenutak.

rows.source: Play the full B minor barre at fret 2 if you can. If not, use the top four strings: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Sviraj puni barre B-mola na pragu 2 ako možeš. Ako ne, koristi četiri najviše žice: prag 4 na žicama 4 i 3, prag 3 na žici 2, prag 2 na žici 1.

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, D at fret 3 on string 2, then open E and F sharp at fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: A na pragu 2 žice 3, D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa prazni E i povišeni F na pragu 2 žice 1.

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a slow, soaring ballad at 76 beats per minute: A minor, F, C and G. Strum big on one and let it ring, then build on three and four.
rows.translation: Stakleni sateliti spora je, uzletna balada pri 76 doba u minuti: A-mol, F, C i G. Snažno odsviraj akord na jedan i pusti da zvoni, pa gradi na tri i četiri.

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1 and build an E shape in front of it. Not there yet? Use the mini F on the top four strings for now.
rows.translation: Položi prst 1 preko svih šest žica na pragu 1 i ispred njega složi oblik E. Još ne ide? Zasad koristi mali F na četiri najviše žice.

rows.source: C at fret 1 on string 2, open E twice, D at fret 3, C again, then A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: C na pragu 1 žice 2, prazni E dvaput, D na pragu 3, opet C, pa A na pragu 2 žice 3.

rows.source: Market Day borrows from highlife, the bright guitar pop of Ghana and Nigeria: G, B minor, C and D at 104 beats per minute. The hook bounces off the beat, so keep your body moving.
rows.translation: Sajmeni dan posuđuje od highlifea, vedrog gitarskog popa Gane i Nigerije: G, B-mol, C i D pri 104 dobe u minuti. Motiv odskače od dobe, pa se nastavi kretati.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, D again, open E, then back to D and B.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, prazni B, opet D, prazni E, pa natrag na D i B.

rows.source: Bar two keeps bar one's rhythm but swaps one note. Why?
rows.translation: Drugi takt zadržava ritam prvoga, ali mijenja jedan ton. Zašto?

rows.source: Bar two moves E up to F sharp, a note of B minor. Same rhythm, new chord, new note.
rows.translation: Drugi takt podiže E do povišenog F, tona B-mola. Isti ritam, novi akord, novi ton.

rows.source: Velvet Hour is neo-soul at 74 beats per minute: four lush seventh chords stepping down, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 and Cmaj7. Strum once on one, then brush soft ups on the ands.
rows.translation: Baršunasti sat je neo-soul pri 74 dobe u minuti: četiri bogata septakorda silaze, Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7 i Cmaj7. Sviraj jednom na jedan, pa nježno trzaj gore na „i”.

rows.source: Fmaj7 is the mini F with string 1 left open. Em7 takes one finger: finger 2 on string 5, fret 2, every other string open. Dm7 and Cmaj7 you know from Rain on the Skylight.
rows.translation: Fmaj7 je mali F s praznom žicom 1. Em7 traži jedan prst: prst 2 na žici 5, pragu 2, sve ostale žice prazne. Dm7 i Cmaj7 znaš iz pjesme Kiša na krovnom prozoru.

rows.source: The chords walk down F, E, D. Where does the loop land?
rows.translation: Akordi silaze F, E, D. Gdje petlja završava?

rows.source: Each chord sits one step below the last, and the walk ends on C, the home chord.
rows.translation: Svaki je akord stupanj ispod prethodnog, a hod završava na C, toničkom akordu.

rows.source: An anthem with a key change
Rooftop Choir is a stadium-sized anthem at 92 beats per minute. You play the chorus in C, then one bar of A lifts everything a whole step, and the chorus returns in D.
rows.translation: Krovni zbor himna je stadionskih razmjera pri 92 dobe u minuti. Sviraš refren u C, pa jedan takt A sve podiže za cijeli ton, a refren se vraća u D.

rows.source: A key change up a whole step moves every note up…
rows.translation: Promjena tonaliteta za cijeli ton naviše pomiče svaki ton za…

rows.source: A whole step is two half steps, and each fret is a half step. C becomes D, and G becomes A.
rows.translation: Cijeli ton čine dva polutona, a svaki prag je poluton. C postaje D, a G postaje A.

rows.source: Which chord lifts Rooftop Choir from C into D?
rows.translation: Koji akord podiže Krovni zbor iz C u D?

rows.source: A leads home to D. Landing on it turns the whole song toward the new key.
rows.translation: A vodi do uporišta D. Dolazak na njega okreće cijelu pjesmu prema novom tonalitetu.

rows.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, with five new barre chords.
rows.translation: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, tamni pop, indie pop i finale u 6/8, uz pet novih barre-akorda.

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is synth-pop at 118 beats per minute: F sharp minor, D, A and E. The strum is pushed: two of its hits land on the and, just before the beat.
rows.translation: Usporeni stroboskop je synth-pop pri 118 doba u minuti: mol na povišenom F, D, A i E. Akordska pratnja prethodi dobi: dva udara padaju na i, neposredno prije dobe.

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across all six strings at fret 2, then put fingers 3 and 4 on strings 5 and 4 at fret 4: the E minor shape, moved up two frets.
rows.translation: Položi prst 1 preko svih šest žica na pragu 2, pa stavi prste 3 i 4 na žice 5 i 4 na pragu 4: oblik E-mola pomaknut dva praga naviše.

rows.source: Bright Side of the Block is a gospel-pop sing-along in D at 100 beats per minute: D, F sharp minor, G and A. Clap on two and four and sing the chorus like the whole street joins in.
rows.translation: Svijetla strana kvarta gospel-pop je za zajedničko pjevanje u D pri 100 doba u minuti: D, mol na povišenom F, G i A. Plješći na dva i četiri i pjevaj refren kao da se pridružuje cijela ulica.

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 2, then build an A minor shape two frets up with fingers 2, 3 and 4. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Položi prst 1 preko žica 5 do 1 na pragu 2, pa prstima 2, 3 i 4 složi oblik A-mola dva praga više. Žica 6 neka šuti.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open E, G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, E, G, then E.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, prazni E, G na pragu 3 žice 1, povišeni F na pragu 2, E, G, pa E.

rows.source: Over You Soon is dark pop in B minor at 84 beats per minute: B minor, G, D and A. Strum once on one, then soft ups on the ands, and keep it hushed.
rows.translation: Uskoro ću te preboljeti tamni je pop u B-molu pri 84 dobe u minuti: B-mol, G, D i A. Sviraj jednom na jedan, pa tihe trzaje gore na „i”, i zadrži prigušen ugođaj.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 1, F sharp at fret 2, D at fret 3 on string 2, then F sharp, open E and D.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 1, povišeni F na pragu 2, D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa povišeni F, prazni E i D.

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.
rows.translation: Zora u spreju indie je pop pri 124 dobe u minuti: E, B, mol na povišenom C i A, petlja s četiri akorda i dva barrea. Pokreni ravnomjerne osminke i pusti da teče.
B i mol na povišenom C

rows.source: B is an A shape barred at fret 2: finger 1 across strings 5 to 1, three fingers at fret 4. C sharp minor is an A minor shape barred at fret 4.
rows.translation: B je oblik A s barreom na pragu 2: prst 1 preko žica 5 do 1, tri prsta na pragu 4. Mol na povišenom C oblik je A-mola s barreom na pragu 4.

rows.source: G sharp at fret 4 on string 1, F sharp, open E, open B, then D sharp at fret 4 on string 2, C sharp, D sharp.
rows.translation: Povišeni G na pragu 4 žice 1, povišeni F, prazni E, prazni B, pa povišeni D na pragu 4 žice 2, povišeni C, povišeni D.

rows.source: Constellation Prize closes the course: an anthem in 6/8 at 126 counts a minute, in F. F and B flat are both barres, with C and D minor between them.
rows.translation: Nagrada zviježđa zatvara tečaj: himna u 6/8 pri 126 brojanja u minuti, u F. F i sniženi B oba su barre-akordi, s C i D-molom između.

rows.source: Barre finger 1 across strings 5 to 1 at fret 1, then put fingers 2, 3 and 4 on strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 3. Leave string 6 silent.
rows.translation: Položi prst 1 preko žica 5 do 1 na pragu 1, pa stavi prste 2, 3 i 4 na žice 4, 3 i 2 na pragu 3. Žica 6 neka šuti.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, F at fret 1 on string 1 twice, G at fret 3, F twice, open E, then F.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, F na pragu 1 žice 1 dvaput, G na pragu 3, F dvaput, prazni E, pa F.

rows.source: F sharp minor is which shape, barred at fret 2?
rows.translation: Koji oblik s barreom na pragu 2 daje mol na povišenom F?

rows.source: Barre at fret 2 and the E minor shape sits in front of your first finger: F sharp minor.
rows.translation: Barre na pragu 2 i oblik E-mola ispred prvog prsta: mol na povišenom F.

rows.source: Famous tunes everyone knows, start to finish
rows.translation: Poznate melodije koje svi znaju, od početka do kraja

rows.source: Folk songs and a spiritual everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
rows.translation: Narodne pjesme i duhovna pjesma koje svi mogu pjevati, uz jednostavne akordske sheme za pratnju.

rows.source: This tune began as a spiritual. In the 1890s railroad crews in the Midwest gave it new words, and Carl Sandburg printed it in 1927. It climbs from low B up to D on string 2.
rows.translation: Ova je melodija počela kao duhovna pjesma. U 1890-ima željezničke ekipe Srednjeg zapada dale su joj nove stihove, a Carl Sandburg tiskao ju je 1927. Penje se od niskog B do D na žici 2.

rows.source: The first line: open D, E, four open Gs, a dip to B on string 5, then home to G.
rows.translation: Prvi redak: prazni D, E, četiri prazna G, spuštanje do B na žici 5, pa natrag do G.

rows.source: The words She'll be come before beat one. What are they?
rows.translation: Riječi „She'll be” dolaze prije prve dobe. Što čine?

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into the first strong beat. Here they run up to the word com-.
rows.translation: Uzmah je nekoliko nota koje vode u prvu naglašenu dobu. Ovdje vode do sloga „com-”.

rows.source: Three chords: G, C and D7
rows.translation: Tri akorda: G, C i D7

rows.source: Most of the song sits on G. D7 comes at the end of the second line, and C colors the fourth. Change on the word that starts the bar.
rows.translation: Većina pjesme ostaje na G. D7 dolazi na kraju drugog retka, a C boji četvrti. Promijeni akord na riječi koja započinje takt.

rows.source: This African American spiritual is older than the Civil War and was first printed in 1918. Its line ain't gonna study war no more became a song of the peace movement.
rows.translation: Ova afroamerička duhovna pjesma starija je od Građanskog rata i prvi je put tiskana 1918. Njezin stih „ain't gonna study war no more” postao je pjesma mirovnog pokreta.

rows.source: Lay down my burden: open B, a drop to open D, then up through E, G and A to B.
rows.translation: Uz „Lay down my burden”: prazni B, pad do praznog D, pa naviše kroz E, G i A do B.

rows.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
rows.translation: Povišeni A je između A i B, na pragu 3 žice 3. Vodi naviše u prazni B, bluesovski uspon koji gospelu daje njegov zvuk.

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp at fret 3, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Uz „Down by the riverside”: B, B, povišeni A na pragu 3, B, pa A i G.

rows.source: The high road and the low road
This Scottish song was first printed in 1841. The low road is often heard as the road a soldier's spirit takes home, faster than the living on the high road.
rows.translation: Ova škotska pjesma prvi je put tiskana 1841. Niski put često se tumači kao put kojim se duh vojnika vraća kući, brže od živih na visokom putu.

rows.source: By yon bonnie banks: open D, then G, G, A, B and back down to G.
rows.translation: Uz „By yon bonnie banks”: prazni D, pa G, G, A, B i natrag naniže do G.

rows.source: This tune moves in quarter notes and pairs of eighths. Count one, two-and, three, four-and, and the lilt comes by itself.
rows.translation: Ova se melodija kreće u četvrtinkama i parovima osminki. Broji jedan, dva-i, tri, četiri-i i njihanje će doći samo.

rows.source: This song was printed in 1876 and credited in 1884 to James Yorkston of Edinburgh. It is now Dublin's unofficial anthem, and Molly and her cart stand as a statue in the city.
rows.translation: Ova je pjesma tiskana 1876., a 1884. pripisana Jamesu Yorkstonu iz Edinburgha. Danas je neslužbena himna Dublina, a Molly i njezina kolica stoje kao kip u gradu.

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open D, four open Gs, up to open B and back to G.
rows.translation: Uz „In Dublin's fair city”: prazni D, četiri prazna G, naviše do praznog B i natrag na G.

rows.source: Count one, two, three and lean on one. In many bars the middle note is long: one, two, and a quick note just before the next one.
rows.translation: Broji jedan, dva, tri i naglasi jedan. U mnogim taktovima srednja je nota duga: jedan, dva i brza nota neposredno prije sljedećeg jedan.

rows.source: Cecil Sharp collected and published this ballad in 1906, from verses that go back to the 1700s. Play it slowly and let every long note ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp prikupio je i objavio ovu baladu 1906., iz stihova koji sežu u stoljeće započeto 1700. Sviraj je polako i pusti svaku dugu notu da zvoni.

rows.source: The water is wide, I cannot get o'er: up from open D to B, then gently back down to D.
rows.translation: Uz „The water is wide, I cannot get o'er”: naviše od praznog D do B, pa nježno natrag naniže do D.

rows.source: Wide rings for two beats and two for two and a half. Keep counting while the string rings, so the next word lands on time.
rows.translation: Riječ „wide” zvoni dvije dobe, a „two” dvije i pol. Nastavi brojiti dok žica zvoni da sljedeća riječ dođe na vrijeme.

rows.source: Which word holds over two notes in the first verse?
rows.translation: Koja se riječ proteže kroz dva tona u prvoj strofi?

rows.source: Fly starts on C and slides down to a long A. Singers call one syllable over several notes a melisma.
rows.translation: „Fly” počinje na C i spušta se na dugi A. Pjevanje jednog sloga preko više tonova zove se melizam.

rows.source: No new notes: the five songs from this unit, one after another, a little faster than before. Name each one from its first notes.
rows.translation: Bez novih tonova: pet pjesama iz ove cjeline, jedna za drugom, malo brže nego prije. Prepoznaj svaku po prvim tonovima.

rows.source: A Welsh lullaby, a Highland boat song and three carols, in German, Latin and English.
rows.translation: Velška uspavanka, gorštačka pjesma o brodu i tri božićne pjesme, na njemačkom, latinskom i engleskom.

rows.source: The tune Ar Hyd y Nos was printed in Wales in 1784, and Harold Boulton wrote these English words in 1884. One phrase comes three times, with a higher one in the middle.
rows.translation: Melodija Ar Hyd y Nos tiskana je u Walesu 1784., a Harold Boulton napisao je ove engleske stihove 1884. Jedna fraza dolazi triput, s višom u sredini.

rows.source: Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee: open G, down to F sharp and E, then G, A, G, F sharp and D.
rows.translation: Uz „Sleep, my child, and peace attend thee”: prazni G, naniže do povišenog F i E, pa G, A, G, povišeni F i D.

rows.source: Which phrase of the verse climbs highest?
rows.translation: Koja se fraza strofe penje najviše?

rows.source: The third phrase, soft the drowsy hours, rises to C, D and E. The other three phrases share one tune.
rows.translation: Treća fraza, „soft the drowsy hours”, penje se do C, D i E. Ostale tri fraze dijele jednu melodiju.

rows.source: Harold Boulton set these words in 1884 to a Highland rowing tune collected by Anne MacLeod. They tell of Bonnie Prince Charlie escaping to the Isle of Skye in 1746.
rows.translation: Harold Boulton postavio je ove stihove 1884. na gorštačku veslačku melodiju koju je prikupila Anne MacLeod. Govore o bijegu princa Bonnieja Charlieja na otok Skye 1746.

rows.source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
rows.translation: Ova se pjesma njiše u šestosminskoj mjeri: dvije velike dobe po taktu, svaka podijeljena na tri. Broji jedan-dva-tri, četiri-pet-šest, poput povlačenja i vraćanja vesala.

rows.source: Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing: open D, E, D, three open Gs, then A, B, A and up to D.
rows.translation: Uz „Speed, bonnie boat, like a bird on the wing”: prazni D, E, D, tri prazna G, pa A, B, A i naviše do D.

rows.source: Ernst Anschütz wrote these words in Leipzig in 1824, to a much older folk tune. You'll sing them in German, the language they were written in.
rows.translation: Ernst Anschütz napisao je ove stihove u Leipzigu 1824. uz mnogo stariju narodnu melodiju. Pjevat ćeš ih na njemačkom, jeziku na kojem su napisani.

rows.source: O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum: open D, three open Gs, then A at fret 2 and three open Bs.
rows.translation: Uz „O Tannenbaum, o Tannenbaum”: prazni D, tri prazna G, pa A na pragu 2 i tri prazna B.

rows.source: Tan-nen is a dotted note and a very short one, then baum rings on. Say the words as you tap, and the rhythm follows.
rows.translation: „Tan-nen” je nota s točkom i vrlo kratka nota, pa „baum” nastavlja zvoniti. Izgovaraj riječi dok tapkaš i ritam će ih pratiti.

rows.source: The Latin hymn Adeste Fideles was printed with this tune in 1751, and Frederick Oakeley's English words followed in 1841. You'll sing a verse in each language.
rows.translation: Latinska himna Adeste Fideles tiskana je uz ovu melodiju 1751., a engleski stihovi Fredericka Oakeleyja slijedili su 1841. Pjevat ćeš po jednu strofu na svakom jeziku.

rows.source: O come, all ye faithful: open G twice, down to open D, back to G, A, and D again.
rows.translation: Uz „O come, all ye faithful”: prazni G dvaput, naniže do praznog D, natrag na G, A i opet D.

rows.source: How many times does the refrain sing O come, let us adore him?
rows.translation: Koliko puta pripjev pjeva „O come, let us adore him”?

rows.source: Three times, each a little higher, before Christ the Lord brings the tune home.
rows.translation: Triput, svaki put malo više, prije nego što „Christ the Lord” vrati melodiju na uporište.

rows.source: Latin hymn (1751); English words Frederick Oakeley (1841)
rows.translation: Latinska himna (1751.); engleski stihovi Frederick Oakeley (1841.)

rows.source: This carol was first printed in 1823, in a collection of old Christmas carols. Its tune walks up the scale and back, which is why it is so easy to remember.
rows.translation: Ova je pjesma prvi put tiskana 1823. u zbirci starih božićnih pjesama. Melodija hoda uz ljestvicu i natrag, zato se tako lako pamti.

rows.source: Up the D scale: F sharp and E, open D, then E, F sharp, open G, A, open B, C sharp at fret 2 and D.
rows.translation: Uz ljestvicu D: povišeni F i E, prazni D, pa E, povišeni F, prazni G, A, prazni B, povišeni C na pragu 2 i D.

rows.source: The tune starts with two quick notes, F sharp and E, before beat one. Then a long D and a run of eighths climb to A.
rows.translation: Melodija počinje dvjema brzim notama, povišenim F i E, prije prve dobe. Zatim dugi D i niz osminki penju se do A.

rows.source: Five songs from this unit: two ballads and three carols. No new notes, just one after another, each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Pet pjesama iz ove cjeline: dvije balade i tri božićne pjesme. Bez novih tonova, samo jedna za drugom, svaka malo brže nego prije.

rows.source: Which of these counts in six?
rows.translation: Koja se od ovih pjesama broji u šest?

rows.source: The Skye Boat Song rocks in six-eight. O Christmas Tree is in three, and All Through the Night in four.
rows.translation: The Skye Boat Song njiše se u šestosminskoj mjeri. O, božićno drvce je u tri, a All Through the Night u četiri.

rows.source: A pipe march, a Russian folk dance, the Blue Danube and the can-can.
rows.translation: Gajdaška koračnica, ruski narodni ples, Na lijepom plavom Dunavu i kankan.

rows.source: This Scottish march was in print by 1878, and pipe bands play it all over the world. Pipers play it without words, and so will you.
rows.translation: Ova škotska koračnica bila je tiskana do 1878., a gajdaški sastavi sviraju je diljem svijeta. Gajdaši je sviraju bez riječi, a tako ćeš i ti.

rows.source: A dotted note and a quick one give a march its snap: long, then short. In the first bar, the second D is long and E slips in just before beat two.
rows.translation: Nota s točkom i brza nota daju koračnici oštrinu: dugo, pa kratko. U prvom taktu drugi D je dug, a E ulazi neposredno prije druge dobe.

rows.source: Up the D chord: open D twice, E, F sharp at fret 4, D, F sharp, A, then D on string 2.
rows.translation: Uz akord D: prazni D dvaput, E, povišeni F na pragu 4, D, povišeni F, A, pa D na žici 2.

rows.source: Nikolay Nekrasov's poem about traveling peddlers was printed in 1861, and this folk tune was published with it in 1898. A video game made it famous worldwide almost a century later.
rows.translation: Pjesma Nikolaja Nekrasova o putujućim trgovcima tiskana je 1861., a ova narodna melodija uz nju je objavljena 1898. Videoigra ju je gotovo stoljeće kasnije proslavila diljem svijeta.

rows.source: The opening: open B, down to F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, up G and A, then G, F sharp, E.
rows.translation: Početak: prazni B, naniže do povišenog F na pragu 4 žice 4, naviše G i A, pa G, povišeni F, E.

rows.source: The second half reaches higher: A, C at fret 1 on string 2, open E, then down D, C, B and G.
rows.translation: Druga polovina seže više: A, C na pragu 1 žice 2, prazni E, pa naniže D, C, B i G.

rows.source: This tune is in E minor. Which note sounds like home?
rows.translation: Ova je melodija u E-molu. Koji ton zvuči kao uporište?

rows.source: Both halves end on E, the home note of E minor. You hear it as the place the tune settles.
rows.translation: Obje polovine završavaju na E, tonu uporišta E-mola. Čuješ ga kao mjesto na kojem se melodija smiruje.

rows.source: Johann Strauss II first performed this waltz in Vienna in 1867, and Vienna still plays it every New Year's Day. Its tune climbs a chord, then answers with two high notes.
rows.translation: Johann Strauss II prvi je put izveo ovaj valcer u Beču 1867., a Beč ga i dalje svira svakog prvog dana Nove godine. Melodija se penje kroz akord, pa odgovara dvama visokim tonovima.

rows.source: G at fret 3 on string 6 twice, B on string 5, open D, then leap up to D at fret 3 on string 2 and down to open B.
rows.translation: G na pragu 3 žice 6 dvaput, B na žici 5, prazni D, pa skok naviše do D na pragu 3 žice 2 i naniže do praznog B.

rows.source: Each phrase starts low on the bass strings and leaps up an octave. Look at the high note before you play the low ones, so your hand knows where it's going.
rows.translation: Svaka fraza počinje nisko na basovskim žicama i skače za oktavu naviše. Pogledaj visoki ton prije sviranja niskih, da šaka zna kamo ide.

rows.source: Jacques Offenbach wrote this galop for his 1858 operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Paris dance halls later made it the music of the can-can.
rows.translation: Jacques Offenbach napisao je ovaj galop za svoju operetu Orfej u podzemlju iz 1858. Pariške plesne dvorane poslije su ga pretvorile u glazbu kankana.

rows.source: A long open G, then A, C, B, A, and two Ds at fret 3 on string 2.
rows.translation: Dugi prazni G, pa A, C, B, A i dva D na pragu 3 žice 2.

rows.source: Most of the tune runs in eighth notes. Keep the pick small and alternate down and up, so you never fall behind.
rows.translation: Većina melodije teče u osminkama. Neka pokret trzalice bude malen i izmjenjuj dolje i gore da nikad ne zaostaneš.

rows.source: The big run: open G, leap to G at fret 3 on string 1, then step all the way down to A.
rows.translation: Veliki niz: prazni G, skok do G na pragu 3 žice 1, pa koracima sasvim naniže do A.

rows.source: Four tunes from this unit: a pipe march, a Russian folk song, a Viennese waltz and a French galop. Each one a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Četiri melodije iz ove cjeline: gajdaška koračnica, ruska narodna pjesma, bečki valcer i francuski galop. Svaka malo brže nego prije.

rows.source: Which of these is a waltz, in three?
rows.translation: Koja je od ovih melodija valcer, u tri?

rows.source: A waltz counts one, two, three. The can-can and the pipe march both count in four.
rows.translation: Valcer broji jedan, dva, tri. Kankan i gajdaška koračnica oboje se broje u četiri.

rows.source: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet and Grieg: syncopation, six-eight and key changes.
rows.translation: Joplin, Sousa, Bizet i Grieg: sinkope, šestosminska mjera i promjene tonaliteta.

rows.source: Scott Joplin published The Entertainer in 1902, and a 1973 film made it famous again. In ragtime the tune leans off the beat while the bass keeps steady time.
rows.translation: Scott Joplin objavio je The Entertainer 1902., a film iz 1973. ponovno ga je proslavio. U ragtimeu melodija teži izvan dobe, dok bas održava ravnomjeran puls.

rows.source: Open D, D sharp at fret 1, E at fret 2 on string 4, then leap to C at fret 1 on string 2 and back, three times.
rows.translation: Prazni D, povišeni D na pragu 1, E na pragu 2 žice 4, pa skok do C na pragu 1 žice 2 i natrag, triput.

rows.source: Syncopation puts the accent between the beats. In the opening, each C lands on an and. Count one-and-two-and and feel the C pull ahead.
rows.translation: Sinkopa smješta naglasak između doba. Na početku svaki C pada na i. Broji jedan-i-dva-i i osjeti kako C vuče naprijed.

rows.source: The ending run circles C, D and E on strings 2 and 1, then lands through B and D on C.
rows.translation: Završni niz kruži oko C, D i E na žicama 2 i 1, pa preko B i D slijeće na C.

rows.source: John Philip Sousa published The Liberty Bell in 1893, and a British TV comedy later made it its theme. It's in six-eight: two big beats a bar, like left, right.
rows.translation: John Philip Sousa objavio je Zvono slobode 1893., a britanska TV-komedija poslije ga je uzela za svoju temu. U šestosminskoj je mjeri: dvije velike dobe po taktu, poput lijeva, desna.

rows.source: Many beats start with a short silence. Stop the string with your fretting hand, then come back in on the next eighth.
rows.translation: Mnoge dobe počinju kratkom tišinom. Zaustavi žicu rukom na hvataljci, pa ponovno uđi na sljedeću osminku.

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then up to G on string 1 and down D, D, B.
rows.translation: Prazni B triput, povišeni A na pragu 3 žice 3, opet B, pa naviše do G na žici 1 i naniže D, D, B.

rows.source: Georges Bizet's opera Carmen opened in Paris in 1875. Its prelude starts with this festive march, then plays the tune of the famous Toreador Song.
rows.translation: Opera Carmen Georgesa Bizeta premijerno je izvedena u Parizu 1875. Preludij počinje ovom svečanom koračnicom, pa svira melodiju poznate Toreadorove pjesme.

rows.source: Four As at fret 2 on string 3, then down to E at fret 2 on string 4, open D and E.
rows.translation: Četiri tona A na pragu 2 žice 3, pa naniže do E na pragu 2 žice 4, prazni D i E.

rows.source: The march is in A major, with C sharp and G sharp. The Toreador tune moves to F major, with B flat at fret 3 on string 3. Watch for the change.
rows.translation: Koračnica je u A-duru, s povišenim C i G. Toreadorova melodija prelazi u F-dur, sa sniženim B na pragu 3 žice 3. Pazi na promjenu.

rows.source: What happens at the end of the Toreador tune?
rows.translation: Što se događa na kraju Toreadorove melodije?

rows.source: It climbs to a long E
It climbs to a long high E, the note that leads back home to A major for the march.
rows.translation: Penje se do dugog visokog E, tona koji vodi natrag u A-dur za koračnicu.

rows.source: Edvard Grieg wrote Morning Mood in 1875 for the play Peer Gynt. The flute plays the theme, the oboe answers, and the music climbs like the rising sun.
rows.translation: Edvard Grieg napisao je Jutarnje raspoloženje 1875. za dramu Peer Gynt. Flauta svira temu, oboa odgovara, a glazba se penje poput sunca na izlasku.

rows.source: The theme uses just G, A, B, D and E. A five-note scale like this is called pentatonic, and it sounds calm and open.
rows.translation: Tema koristi samo G, A, B, D i E. Takva ljestvica od pet tonova zove se pentatonika i zvuči mirno i otvoreno.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then back up A and B.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, prazni B, A na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni G, pa natrag naviše A i B.

rows.source: How many different notes does the theme use?
G, A, B, D and E: a pentatonic scale. There is no C and no F sharp in the whole theme.
rows.translation: G, A, B, D i E: pentatonska ljestvica. U cijeloj temi nema C ni povišenog F.

rows.source: The four pieces from this unit, back to back: ragtime, a march, an opera prelude and a sunrise. Each a little faster than before.
rows.translation: Četiri skladbe iz ove cjeline, jedna za drugom: ragtime, koračnica, operni preludij i izlazak sunca. Svaka malo brže nego prije.

rows.source: Which of these pieces uses only five notes in its theme?
rows.translation: Koja od ovih skladbi koristi samo pet tonova u temi?

rows.source: Morning Mood's theme is pentatonic: G, A, B, D and E. The others use many more.
rows.translation: Tema Jutarnjeg raspoloženja pentatonska je: G, A, B, D i E. Ostale koriste mnogo više.

rows.source: Four Christmas carols to sing by candlelight: Wesley and Mendelssohn, a lullaby, and two tunes from America.
rows.translation: Četiri božićne pjesme za pjevanje uz svijeće: Wesley i Mendelssohn, uspavanka i dvije melodije iz Amerike.

rows.source: Charles Wesley wrote the words in 1739. In 1856 an English organist set them to a tune from a choral piece by Felix Mendelssohn, and the carol has been sung that way since.
rows.translation: Charles Wesley napisao je stihove 1739. Godine 1856. engleski orguljaš spojio ih je s melodijom iz zborske skladbe Felixa Mendelssohna i od tada se pjesma tako pjeva.

rows.source: Open D, open G twice, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, then open B twice and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Prazni D, prazni G dvaput, povišeni F na pragu 4 žice 4, G, pa prazni B dvaput i A na pragu 2 žice 3.

rows.source: Her-ald is long-short: her- lands on three and holds, and -ald slips in on the and of four. Count one, two, three, four-and.
rows.translation: „Her-ald” ide dugo-kratko: „her-” pada na tri i drži se, a „-ald” ulazi na i nakon četiri. Broji jedan, dva, tri, četiri-i.

rows.source: The chorus moves C, A minor, D7 and G. Change on the word that starts each half bar, and keep the strum light under the high E.
rows.translation: Refren ide C, A-mol, D7 i G. Mijenjaj akord na riječi koja započinje svaku polovinu takta i sviraj lagano ispod visokog E.
Charles Wesley (1739.), prema tiskanom izdanju iz 1861.

rows.source: These words first appeared in an American children's book in 1885, and James R. Murray gave them this gentle tune in 1887. It rocks in three, like a cradle.
rows.translation: Ovi su se stihovi prvi put pojavili u američkoj dječjoj knjizi 1885., a James R. Murray dao im je ovu nježnu melodiju 1887. Njiše se u tri, poput kolijevke.

rows.source: It starts high: D at fret 3 on string 2, then steps down C, B, A, G and F sharp all the way to open D.
rows.translation: Počinje visoko: D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa koracima naniže C, B, A, G i povišeni F sve do praznog D.

rows.source: The first line walks down from high D to low D. How far is that?
rows.translation: Prvi redak silazi od visokog D do niskog D. Koliki je to razmak?

rows.source: D down to D is an octave: eight steps of the scale, the same note name, one register lower.
rows.translation: Od D naniže do D je oktava: osam stupnjeva ljestvice, isti naziv tona, jedan registar niže.

rows.source: Hold G for most of a line, C for crib for a bed, and D7 to lead home. In three, strum down on one and lightly on two and three.
rows.translation: Drži G većinu retka, C uz „crib for a bed”, a D7 za povratak uporištu. U tri sviraj dolje na jedan, a lagano na dva i tri.

rows.source: Phillips Brooks wrote these words in 1868 for the children of his Philadelphia church, and its organist, Lewis Redner, wrote the tune for their Christmas service.
rows.translation: Phillips Brooks napisao je ove stihove 1868. za djecu svoje crkve u Philadelphiji, a orguljaš Lewis Redner napisao je melodiju za njihovo božićno bogoslužje.

rows.source: Open B three times, A sharp at fret 3 on string 3, B again, then D, C and a drop to E on string 4.
rows.translation: Prazni B triput, povišeni A na pragu 3 žice 3, opet B, pa D, C i pad do E na žici 4.

rows.source: A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 leans into open B, a half step up. It gives O little town its gentle sway.
rows.translation: Povišeni A na pragu 3 žice 3 teži u prazni B, poluton naviše. Riječima „O little town” daje nježno njihanje.

rows.source: Which word dips down to the low D in the first verse?
rows.translation: Koja se riječ spušta do niskog D u prvoj strofi?

rows.source: Thee, in how still we see thee lie
rows.translation: Thee, u „how still we see thee lie”

rows.source: How still we see thee lie: the tune falls to open D on thee, then lifts to B on lie.
rows.translation: Uz „How still we see thee lie” melodija pada na prazni D na „thee”, pa se podiže do B na „lie”.

rows.source: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear
rows.translation: It Came Upon the Midnight Clear

rows.source: Edmund Sears wrote these words in Massachusetts in 1849, and Richard Storrs Willis wrote the tune a year later. It swings in two big beats a bar, each split in three.
rows.translation: Edmund Sears napisao je ove stihove u Massachusettsu 1849., a Richard Storrs Willis melodiju godinu kasnije. Njiše se u dvije velike dobe po taktu, svaka podijeljena na tri.

rows.source: In six-eight a quarter and an eighth make one big beat: long, short. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, and play on one, three, four and six.
rows.translation: U šestosminskoj mjeri četvrtinka i osminka čine jednu veliku dobu: dugo, kratko. Broji jedan-dva-tri, četiri-pet-šest i sviraj na jedan, tri, četiri i šest.

rows.source: Open G, a leap to open E on string 1, then B, D, C, A, and back to G with a turn through A.
rows.translation: Prazni G, skok do praznog E na žici 1, pa B, D, C, A i natrag do G s obratom preko A.

rows.source: The middle of the verse drops to low E and climbs through G sharp, at fret 1 on string 3, to A. Under it the chord moves from E7 to A minor.
rows.translation: Sredina strofe pada do niskog E i penje se preko povišenog G, na pragu 1 žice 3, do A. Ispod nje akord prelazi iz E7 u A-mol.

rows.source: The four carols from this unit, one after another, each a little faster. Keep the chords soft and let the tune sing.
rows.translation: Četiri božićne pjesme iz ove cjeline, jedna za drugom, svaka malo brže. Neka akordi budu tihi i pusti melodiju da pjeva.

rows.source: Which of these carols counts in three?
rows.translation: Koja se od ovih božićnih pjesama broji u tri?

rows.source: Away in a Manger is a waltz: one, two, three. The other two count in four.
rows.translation: Away in a Manger je valcer: jedan, dva, tri. Druge dvije broje se u četiri.

rows.source: King's College's opening carol, Holst's midwinter carol, a folk carol and a grand processional.
rows.translation: Uvodna pjesma King's Collegea, Holstova pjesma usred zime, narodna božićna pjesma i svečana procesijska.

rows.source: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote these words for children in 1848. Since 1919 a single young voice has sung the first verse to open the Christmas Eve carols at King's College, Cambridge.
rows.translation: Cecil Frances Alexander napisala je ove stihove za djecu 1848. Od 1919. jedan mladi glas pjeva prvu strofu za otvorenje božićnih pjesama na Badnjak u King's Collegeu u Cambridgeu.

rows.source: Open D, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, open G, then a turn: G, F sharp, G, A, A, G.
rows.translation: Prazni D, povišeni F na pragu 4 žice 4, prazni G, pa obrat: G, povišeni F, G, A, A, G.

rows.source: Da-vid's spreads each syllable over two eighth notes. Play both, but sing them as one smooth sound.
rows.translation: „Da-vid's” proteže svaki slog preko dviju osminki. Odsviraj obje, ali otpjevaj ih kao jedan gladak zvuk.

rows.source: Where is the highest note of the carol?
rows.translation: Gdje je najviši ton božićne pjesme?

rows.source: Mary was that mother mild starts on open E, the top of the tune.
rows.translation: „Mary was that mother mild” počinje na praznom E, vrhu melodije.

rows.source: A poem and a quiet tune
Christina Rossetti wrote this poem in 1872, and Gustav Holst set it to music for a hymn book in 1906. Its lines are short and calm, like snow falling.
rows.translation: Christina Rossetti napisala je ovu pjesmu 1872., a Gustav Holst uglazbio ju je za pjesmaricu himni 1906. Redci su kratki i mirni, poput padanja snijega.

rows.source: Open B twice, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back down B, A and G.
rows.translation: Prazni B dvaput, C na pragu 1 i D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa natrag naniže B, A i G.

rows.source: Many words land on half notes: -ter in mid-winter, i-ron. Let each ring for two full beats before you move on.
rows.translation: Mnoge riječi padaju na polovinke: „-ter” u „mid-winter”, „i-ron”. Pusti da svaka zvoni pune dvije dobe prije nastavka.

rows.source: Long ago stretches three syllables over how many notes?
rows.translation: Preko koliko tonova „Long ago” proteže tri sloga?

rows.source: Long takes two notes, a- takes two, and go takes one: five notes for three syllables.
rows.translation: „Long” uzima dva tona, „a-” dva, a „go” jedan: pet tonova za tri sloga.

rows.source: Under frost-y wind made moan the chords move A minor to D7, a lean that pulls the line back to G.
rows.translation: Ispod „frost-y wind made moan” akordi prelaze iz A-mola u D7, stvarajući težnju koja vraća redak na G.

rows.source: This carol is centuries old. The song collector Cecil Sharp heard it sung in a Cotswold town and printed this tune in 1911. It dances in three.
rows.translation: Ova je božićna pjesma stara stoljećima. Sakupljač pjesama Cecil Sharp čuo ju je u jednom gradiću Cotswoldsa i tiskao ovu melodiju 1911. Pleše u tri.

rows.source: Four open Gs, then a leap to open E on string 1, down to D at fret 3 on string 2 and open B.
rows.translation: Četiri prazna G, pa skok do praznog E na žici 1, naniže do D na pragu 3 žice 2 i praznog B.

rows.source: From open G to open E is a sixth. Keep your pick close to the strings and cross from string 3 to string 1 in one move.
rows.translation: Od praznog G do praznog E je seksta. Drži trzalicu blizu žica i prijeđi sa žice 3 na žicu 1 jednim pokretom.

rows.source: Angels from the Realms of Glory
rows.translation: Angels from the Realms of Glory

rows.source: James Montgomery printed these words in his Sheffield newspaper on Christmas Eve, 1816. Henry Smart's tune, from 1867, gives it a grand, marching sound.
rows.translation: James Montgomery tiskao je ove stihove u svojim sheffieldskim novinama na Badnjak 1816. Melodija Henryja Smarta iz 1867. daje im veličanstven, koračnički zvuk.

rows.source: A on string 3, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, D at fret 3 on string 2, A, then F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, E and D.
rows.translation: A na žici 3, povišeni F na pragu 4 žice 4, D na pragu 3 žice 2, A, pa povišeni F na pragu 2 žice 1, E i D.

rows.source: This key has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. C sharp sits at fret 2 on string 2.
rows.translation: Ovaj tonalitet ima dvije povisilice, povišeni F i C. Povišeni C je na pragu 2 žice 2.

rows.source: Where is the highest note of the chorus?
Worship Christ starts on G at fret 3 on string 1, the top of the whole carol.
rows.translation: „Worship Christ” počinje na G na pragu 3 žice 1, vrhu cijele božićne pjesme.

rows.source: The carols from this unit, back to back. Most move in long notes: let each one ring full length before the next.
rows.translation: Božićne pjesme iz ove cjeline, jedna za drugom. Većina se kreće dugim notama: neka svaka odzvoni puno trajanje prije sljedeće.

rows.source: Which of these counts in three?
rows.translation: Koja se od ovih pjesama broji u tri?

rows.source: The Holly and the Ivy is in three. The other two count in four.
rows.translation: The Holly and the Ivy je u tri. Druge dvije broje se u četiri.

rows.source: Five great hymns in long, singing notes, from 1708 to 1861.
rows.translation: Pet velikih himni u dugim, pjevnim notama, od 1708. do 1861.

rows.source: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
rows.translation: O God, Our Help in Ages Past

rows.source: William Croft wrote this tune, St Anne, in 1708, and Isaac Watts's words were first printed in 1719. Each verse is four short lines, the plainest hymn shape there is.
rows.translation: William Croft napisao je ovu melodiju, St Anne, 1708., a stihovi Isaaca Wattsa prvi su put tiskani 1719. Svaka strofa ima četiri kratka retka, najjednostavniji oblik himne.

rows.source: Open G, E at fret 2 on string 4, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2, C, open B and C.
rows.translation: Prazni G, E na pragu 2 žice 4, A na pragu 2 žice 3, G, pa C na pragu 1 žice 2, C, prazni B i C.

rows.source: Every line starts on the beat before the bar: O, our, our, and. Count four, then sing the first word on it.
rows.translation: Svaki redak počinje na dobi prije takta: „O”, „our”, „our”, „and”. Broji četiri, pa na toj dobi otpjevaj prvu riječ.

rows.source: The chart leans on A minor, F and G7. God, our sits on A minor, and a-ges past moves from G7 to C.
rows.translation: Akordska shema oslanja se na A-mol, F i G7. „God, our” je na A-molu, a „a-ges past” prelazi iz G7 u C.

rows.source: Reginald Heber wrote these words, printed in 1826, and John Bacchus Dykes wrote the tune in 1861. Its first line climbs the notes of a G major chord.
rows.translation: Reginald Heber napisao je ove stihove, tiskane 1826., a John Bacchus Dykes napisao je melodiju 1861. Prvi se redak penje kroz tonove akorda G-dura.

rows.source: Up the G chord: open G twice, open B twice, then D at fret 3 on string 2, held long.
rows.translation: Uz akord G: prazni G dvaput, prazni B dvaput, pa D na pragu 3 žice 2, dugo držan.

rows.source: Holy, holy, holy climbs which notes?
rows.translation: Kroz koje se tonove penje „Holy, holy, holy”?

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G major chord, so the tune climbs the chord itself.
rows.translation: G, B i D tonovi su akorda G-dura, pa se melodija penje kroz sam akord.

rows.source: This hymn moves in long notes: halves of two beats and a whole note of four at the end. Count every beat, even while a note rings.
rows.translation: Ova se himna kreće dugim notama: polovinkama od dvije dobe i cijelom notom od četiri na kraju. Broji svaku dobu, čak i dok ton zvoni.

rows.source: Henry Francis Lyte wrote these words in 1847, and William Henry Monk wrote the tune Eventide for them in 1861. Football crowds in England have sung it before the cup final since 1927.
rows.translation: Henry Francis Lyte napisao je ove stihove 1847., a William Henry Monk melodiju Eventide za njih 1861. Nogometno mnoštvo u Engleskoj pjeva je prije finala kupa od 1927.

rows.source: Open B twice, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G, then D at fret 3 and E on string 1, back through D and C to B.
rows.translation: Prazni B dvaput, A na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni G, pa D na pragu 3 i E na žici 1, natrag preko D i C do B.

rows.source: Every note here is a quarter, a half or a whole. Count four steady beats a bar and let the long notes ring.
rows.translation: Svaka je nota ovdje četvrtinka, polovinka ili cijela nota. Broji četiri ravnomjerne dobe po taktu i pusti duge note da zvone.

rows.source: Which note leads into the D at the end of the second line?
rows.translation: Koji ton vodi u D na kraju drugog retka?

rows.source: C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2, rises a half step into D, the way a leading note does.
rows.translation: Povišeni C na pragu 2 žice 2 penje se za poluton u D, kao vođica.

rows.source: Sarah Flower Adams wrote these words in London in 1841, and Lowell Mason, an American music teacher, gave them this tune in 1856.
rows.translation: Sarah Flower Adams napisala je ove stihove u Londonu 1841., a Lowell Mason, američki učitelj glazbe, dao im je ovu melodiju 1856.

rows.source: Open B, A at fret 2 on string 3, open G twice, then E at fret 2 on string 4 twice.
rows.translation: Prazni B, A na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni G dvaput, pa E na pragu 2 žice 4 dvaput.

rows.source: Each line has a long-short pair: a dotted quarter, then a quick eighth, as in -er, my and God, to. Let the long note lean into the short one.
rows.translation: Svaki redak ima par dugo-kratko: četvrtinku s točkom, pa brzu osminku, kao u „-er, my” i „God, to”. Neka duga nota vodi u kratku.

rows.source: For the Beauty of the Earth
rows.translation: For the Beauty of the Earth

rows.source: Folliott Pierpoint wrote these words in 1864, on a spring day in the English countryside. They are sung to Dix, a German tune from 1838.
rows.translation: Folliott Pierpoint napisao je ove stihove 1864., proljetnog dana na engleskom selu. Pjevaju se uz Dix, njemačku melodiju iz 1838.

rows.source: Open G, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, G, A at fret 2 on string 3, G, then C at fret 1 on string 2 twice and open B.
rows.translation: Prazni G, povišeni F na pragu 4 žice 4, G, A na pragu 2 žice 3, G, pa C na pragu 1 žice 2 dvaput i prazni B.

rows.source: For the starts with two eighth notes on the: F sharp and G, one syllable sung over both. Play them evenly inside one beat.
rows.translation: „For the” počinje dvjema osminkama na „the”: povišeni F i G, jedan slog otpjevan preko oba tona. Odsviraj ih ravnomjerno unutar jedne dobe.

rows.source: The hymns from this unit, back to back, from the oldest tune to the newest. Let the long notes ring and the chords change on the word.
rows.translation: Himne iz ove cjeline, jedna za drugom, od najstarije do najnovije melodije. Pusti duge note da zvone i mijenjaj akorde na riječi.

rows.source: Which of these tunes is the oldest?
rows.translation: Koja je od ovih melodija najstarija?

rows.source: William Croft wrote St Anne in 1708, almost 150 years before the other two.
rows.translation: William Croft napisao je St Anne 1708., gotovo 150 godina prije ostalih dviju.

rows.source: Three songs families sang around the piano, then Holst's Jupiter.
rows.translation: Tri pjesme koje su obitelji pjevale uz klavir, pa Holstov Jupiter.

rows.source: Henry Bishop wrote this tune for a London opera in 1823, to words by the American actor John Howard Payne. Within a few years it was one of the best-loved songs in the world.
rows.translation: Henry Bishop napisao je ovu melodiju za londonsku operu 1823., na stihove američkog glumca Johna Howarda Paynea. Za nekoliko godina postala je jedna od najomiljenijih pjesama na svijetu.

rows.source: Open G, A at fret 2 on string 3, open B, C at fret 1 and D at fret 3 on string 2, then back to B.
rows.translation: Prazni G, A na pragu 2 žice 3, prazni B, C na pragu 1 i D na pragu 3 žice 2, pa natrag na B.

rows.source: The verse starts just before beat one, on a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Count four-e-and-a: 'Mid lands on four, and its short turn on a.
rows.translation: Strofa počinje neposredno prije prve dobe, osminkom s točkom i šesnaestinkom. Broji četiri-e-i-a: „'Mid” pada na četiri, a njegov kratki obrat na a.

rows.source: The chorus begins on one long note. How long is it?
rows.translation: Refren počinje jednom dugom notom. Koliko traje?

rows.source: Home! is a whole note: hold D at fret 3 on string 2 for the whole bar.
rows.translation: „Home!” je cijela nota: drži D na pragu 3 žice 2 cijeli takt.

rows.source: Hard Times Come Again No More
rows.translation: Hard Times Come Again No More

rows.source: Stephen Foster published this song in 1854. It asks the listener to stop and think of people who have less, and singers still return to it today.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster objavio je ovu pjesmu 1854. Poziva slušatelja da zastane i pomisli na ljude koji imaju manje, a pjevači joj se i danas vraćaju.

rows.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, three more F sharps, then A at fret 2 on string 3 and back to F sharp.
rows.translation: Prazni D, E i povišeni F na žici 4, još tri povišena F, pa A na pragu 2 žice 3 i natrag na povišeni F.

rows.source: The verse sings several words on one note. Keep each F sharp short and even, and let the words carry the line.
rows.translation: Strofa pjeva nekoliko riječi na jednom tonu. Neka svaki povišeni F bude kratak i jednak, a riječi neka nose redak.

rows.source: The chorus lifts to G under the long note on wear-y, then rests on D for hard times. A7 brings each line home.
rows.translation: Refren se podiže na G ispod duge note na „wear-y”, pa se smiruje na D uz „hard times”. A7 vraća svaki redak na uporište.

rows.source: Thomas Moore set these words to an old Irish air and printed them in 1813. Later, Mendelssohn wrote a fantasia on the tune, and Flotow put it in his opera Martha.
rows.translation: Thomas Moore postavio je ove stihove na stari irski napjev i tiskao ih 1813. Poslije je Mendelssohn napisao fantaziju na tu melodiju, a Flotow ju je uvrstio u operu Martha.

rows.source: Open D, E and F sharp on string 4, then a leap to D at fret 3 on string 2, and down C sharp, B and A.
rows.translation: Prazni D, E i povišeni F na žici 4, pa skok do D na pragu 3 žice 2 i naniže povišeni C, B i A.

rows.source: Most beats split long-short: a dotted eighth and a sixteenth. Play the long note full and let the short one lead into the next beat.
rows.translation: Većina doba dijeli se dugo-kratko: osminka s točkom i šesnaestinka. Odsviraj dugu notu u punom trajanju i pusti kratku da vodi u sljedeću dobu.

rows.source: In the middle, no rosebud is nigh climbs through A sharp to B. The chord turns to B minor there, the saddest moment of the song.
rows.translation: U sredini se „no rosebud is nigh” penje preko povišenog A do B. Akord ondje prelazi u B-mol, najtužniji trenutak pjesme.

rows.source: Gustav Holst wrote The Planets between 1914 and 1916. This broad tune is the heart of Jupiter. In 1921 he made it a hymn tune and named it Thaxted, after the town where he lived.
rows.translation: Gustav Holst napisao je Planete između 1914. i 1916. Ova široka melodija srce je Jupitera. Godine 1921. pretvorio ju je u melodiju himne i nazvao Thaxted, po gradu u kojem je živio.

rows.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, open G, A at fret 2, then C at fret 1 on string 2, open B, G, and up C, D, C, B.
rows.translation: E na pragu 2 žice 4, prazni G, A na pragu 2, pa C na pragu 1 žice 2, prazni B, G i naviše C, D, C, B.

rows.source: The middle of the tune dips to C at fret 3 on string 5. Reach for it with your third finger, then come straight back up to string 4.
rows.translation: Sredina melodije silazi do C na pragu 3 žice 5. Dosegni ga trećim prstom, pa se odmah vrati naviše na žicu 4.

rows.source: Like a slow waltz: one, two, three. Each phrase starts with two eighth notes before beat one.
rows.translation: Poput sporog valcera: jedan, dva, tri. Svaka fraza počinje dvjema osminkama prije prve dobe.

rows.source: Before records, families sang these songs around the piano at home. Here they are back to back, with Holst's big tune to finish.
rows.translation: Prije gramofonskih ploča obitelji su ove pjesme pjevale kod kuće uz klavir. Ovdje su jedna za drugom, s velikom Holstovom melodijom za kraj.

rows.source: Which two of these count in three?
rows.translation: Koje se dvije od ovih melodija broje u tri?

rows.source: The Last Rose of Summer and Jupiter
rows.translation: The Last Rose of Summer i Jupiter

rows.source: Hard Times and The Last Rose of Summer
rows.translation: Hard Times i The Last Rose of Summer

rows.source: The Last Rose of Summer and Jupiter are both in three. Home! Sweet Home! and Hard Times count in four.
rows.translation: The Last Rose of Summer i Jupiter obje su u tri. Home! Sweet Home! i Hard Times broje se u četiri.

rows.source: Vivaldi's Spring, Mozart's Turkish rondo and Sousa's best-known march.
rows.translation: Vivaldijevo Proljeće, Mozartov Turski rondo i Sousina najpoznatija koračnica.

rows.source: Antonio Vivaldi published four violin concertos called The Four Seasons in 1725. Spring opens with this bright tune, then the solo violin plays birdsong and running brooks.
rows.translation: Antonio Vivaldi objavio je četiri violinska koncerta nazvana Četiri godišnja doba 1725. Proljeće počinje ovom vedrom melodijom, pa solo violina svira pjev ptica i žubor potoka.

rows.source: E at fret 2 on string 4, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3 three times, F sharp at fret 4 on string 4, E, then open B.
rows.translation: E na pragu 2 žice 4, povišeni G na pragu 1 žice 3 triput, povišeni F na pragu 4 žice 4, E, pa prazni B.

rows.source: The key of E has four sharps. In first position G sharp is at fret 1 on string 3, D sharp at fret 1 on string 4, and C sharp at fret 2 on string 2.
rows.translation: Tonalitet E ima četiri povisilice. U prvoj poziciji povišeni G je na pragu 1 žice 3, povišeni D na pragu 1 žice 4 i povišeni C na pragu 2 žice 2.

rows.source: Each beat can split into four sixteenths. In the theme, the quick F sharp, E pair falls in the second half of beat two.
rows.translation: Svaka doba može se podijeliti na četiri šesnaestinke. U temi brzi par povišeni F, E pada u drugu polovinu druge dobe.

rows.source: Mozart published this rondo in 1784 as the last movement of a piano sonata. Its march copies the sound of Turkish military bands, which Vienna loved at the time.
rows.translation: Mozart je objavio ovaj rondo 1784. kao posljednji stavak klavirske sonate. Koračnica oponaša zvuk turskih vojnih orkestara, koji je Beč tada volio.

rows.source: B at fret 2 on string 5, open A, G sharp at fret 4 on string 6, A, then C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, C, B and C.
rows.translation: B na pragu 2 žice 5, prazni A, povišeni G na pragu 4 žice 6, A, pa C na pragu 3 žice 5, prazni D, C, B i C.

rows.source: The theme circles A: B, A, G sharp, A. Each circle is four sixteenths. Then it climbs a step and circles again.
rows.translation: Tema kruži oko A: B, A, povišeni G, A. Svaki krug čine četiri šesnaestinke. Zatim se penje za stupanj i ponovno kruži.

rows.source: The march moves from A minor to A major: C becomes C sharp, at fret 2 on string 2. The tune sounds suddenly bright.
rows.translation: Koračnica prelazi iz A-mola u A-dur: C postaje povišeni C, na pragu 2 žice 2. Melodija odjednom zvuči vedro.

rows.source: John Philip Sousa wrote this march at the end of 1896, and it was published in 1897. It is the official national march of the United States. This is its big trio tune.
rows.translation: John Philip Sousa napisao je ovu koračnicu krajem 1896., a objavljena je 1897. Službena je nacionalna koračnica Sjedinjenih Država. Ovo je njezina velika melodija trija.

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, C at fret 1, open B, then a dip to A sharp at fret 3 on string 3 and back to B.
rows.translation: D na pragu 3 žice 2, C na pragu 1, prazni B, pa spuštanje do povišenog A na pragu 3 žice 3 i natrag do B.

rows.source: The trio holds notes across the bar line. Keep counting through them: one, two, three, four, then on into the next bar.
rows.translation: Trio drži note preko taktne crte. Nastavi brojiti kroz njih: jedan, dva, tri, četiri, pa dalje u sljedeći takt.

rows.source: The tune keeps dipping a half step below B. Which note is that?
rows.translation: Melodija se stalno spušta poluton ispod B. Koji je to ton?

rows.source: A sharp, at fret 3 on string 3, sits a half step below open B and leans right back into it.
rows.translation: Povišeni A na pragu 3 žice 3 nalazi se poluton ispod praznog B i teži ravno natrag u njega.

rows.source: Vivaldi, Mozart and Sousa, back to back: a violin concerto, a piano rondo and a band march, each arranged for your guitar.
rows.translation: Vivaldi, Mozart i Sousa, jedan za drugim: violinski koncert, klavirski rondo i koračnica za orkestar, svaki obrađen za tvoju gitaru.

rows.source: Which of these pieces was written for a band?
rows.translation: Koja je od ovih skladbi napisana za puhački orkestar?

rows.source: Sousa wrote his marches for a military band. Spring is for violin and strings, and the rondo is for piano.
rows.translation: Sousa je svoje koračnice pisao za vojni orkestar. Proljeće je za violinu i gudače, a rondo za klavir.

rows.source: The whole songbook in ukulele keys, start to finish
rows.translation: Cijela pjesmarica u tonalitetima za ukulele, od početka do kraja

rows.source: The tunes everyone learns first: slow tempos, short phrases, big wins.
rows.translation: Melodije koje svi prvo uče: spori tempo, kratke fraze, veliki uspjesi.

rows.source: This edition is in C. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u C. Četvrta ti je žica ugođena visoko, pa melodija ostaje na žicama 1 do 3, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za ukulele.

rows.source: This edition is in F. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u F. Četvrta ti je žica ugođena visoko, pa melodija ostaje na žicama 1 do 3, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za ukulele.

rows.source: Campfire and folk songs with easy chord charts, to play or to sing over.
rows.translation: Pjesme uz vatru i narodne pjesme s jednostavnim akordskim shemama, za sviranje ili pjevanje uz pratnju.

rows.source: This edition is in G. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u G. Četvrta ti je žica ugođena visoko, pa melodija ostaje na žicama 1 do 3, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za ukulele.

rows.source: New songs on open chords: campfire pop, a ballad, stomp-folk, reggae and country.
rows.translation: Nove pjesme s otvorenim akordima: pop uz vatru, balada, folk uz udarce nogama, reggae i country.

rows.source: This edition is in D minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u D-molu. Četvrta ti je žica ugođena visoko, pa melodija ostaje na žicama 1 do 3, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za ukulele.

rows.source: Campfire folk songs everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
rows.translation: Narodne pjesme uz vatru koje svi mogu pjevati, s jednostavnim akordskim shemama za pratnju.

rows.source: This edition is in A. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u A. Četvrta ti je žica ugođena visoko, pa melodija ostaje na žicama 1 do 3, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za ukulele.

rows.source: This edition is in D. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u D. Četvrta ti je žica ugođena visoko, pa melodija ostaje na žicama 1 do 3, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za ukulele.

rows.source: Old favorites from America's songbook, to strum and to sing.
rows.translation: Stari favoriti iz američke pjesmarice, za akordsku pratnju i pjevanje.

rows.source: This edition is in A minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u A-molu. Četvrta ti je žica ugođena visoko, pa melodija ostaje na žicama 1 do 3, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za ukulele.

rows.source: Lullabies, ballads and carols to play slowly and let ring.
rows.translation: Uspavanke, balade i božićne pjesme za polagano sviranje i dugo odzvanjanje.

rows.source: Famous classical themes, from a Baroque canon to a Romantic lullaby.
rows.translation: Poznate klasične teme, od baroknog kanona do romantičarske uspavanke.

rows.source: Punk-pop, riff rock, dark 6/8 rock, an indie anthem and desert rock, on power chords.
rows.translation: Punk-pop, rock s rifovima, tamni rock u 6/8, indie himna i pustinjski rock, uz power-akorde.

rows.source: Two Mozart themes and two old airs, with minor keys and a wide range.
rows.translation: Dvije Mozartove teme i dva stara napjeva, s molskim tonalitetima i širokim rasponom.

rows.source: This edition is in E minor. Your fourth string is tuned high, so the tune stays on strings 1 to 3, and every chord in the chart is a ukulele shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u E-molu. Četvrta ti je žica ugođena visoko, pa melodija ostaje na žicama 1 do 3, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za ukulele.

rows.source: A ballad, a sea story in 6/8, a music-box waltz, a bright folk strummer and a dark song in a minor key.
rows.translation: Balada, morska priča u 6/8, valcer glazbene kutije, vedra folk-pratnja i tamna pjesma u molskom tonalitetu.

rows.source: Indie pop, a power ballad, highlife, neo-soul and an anthem with a key change.
rows.translation: Indie pop, snažna rock-balada, highlife, neo-soul i himna s promjenom tonaliteta.

rows.source: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, dark pop, indie pop and a 6/8 finale, full of syncopation.
rows.translation: Synth-pop, gospel-pop, tamni pop, indie pop i finale u 6/8, puno sinkopa.

rows.source: Folk songs, carols and classical themes in mandolin keys
rows.translation: Narodne pjesme, božićne pjesme i klasične teme u tonalitetima za mandolinu

rows.source: This edition is in C, in first position: two frets to a finger across the four pairs, and every chord in the chart is a mandolin shape.
rows.translation: Ovo je izdanje u C, u prvoj poziciji: dva praga po prstu preko četiriju parova, a svaki je akord u shemi oblik za mandolinu.

rows.source: Roots and fifths under every song in the book
rows.translation: Osnovni tonovi i kvinte ispod svake pjesme u zbirci

rows.source: Roots and fifths, as a bass player first backs a band: the chord's root where it starts, its fifth between, low in first position. The song stays in C, where the band plays it.
rows.translation: Osnovni tonovi i kvinte, kao kad basist prvi put prati sastav: osnovni ton akorda na njegovu početku, kvinta između, nisko u prvoj poziciji. Pjesma ostaje u C, gdje je sastav svira.
